desc.en-US: Controls the movement of the node. This is the most basic action for controlling the acceleration of nodes.
desc.zh-CN: 控制节点的移动。这是控制节点加速度的最基本动作。

desc.en-US: Controls the speed of the node along its Z-axis.
desc.zh-CN: 控制节点沿其 Z 轴的速度。

desc.en-US: Controls the acceleration of the node along its Z-axis. This value cannot be negative.
desc.zh-CN: 控制节点沿其 Z 轴的加速度。此值不能为负。

desc.en-US: Controls the acceleration of the node along its Y-axis.
desc.zh-CN: 控制节点沿其 Y 轴的加速度。

desc.en-US: This is replaces [unkAlignWithMotion](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#NodeAcceleration.unkAlignWithMotion) in DS3 and Sekiro only. When set to 1, this seems to just stop the positional motion from this action entirely.

When set to 1, this makes the node align with the direction it's moving. Setting it to higher values seems to do the same as setting it to 0, which means it's probably not a boolean, but what those values do exactly is unknown.
desc.zh-CN: 当设置为 1 时，使节点与移动方向对齐。设置为更高的值似乎与设置为 0 的效果相同，这意味着它可能不是布尔值，但这些值的具体作用未知。

desc.en-US: Translates the node using a property, meaning it can be animated. This can be useful if you need the node to follow a specific path.
desc.zh-CN: 使用属性来平移节点，意味着它可以被动画化。如果需要节点沿着特定路径移动，这很有用。

desc.en-US: An offset for the position of the node.

When set to 1, this makes the node align with the direction it's moving. There are cases of this being set to 2 in vanilla, and it seems to behave similarly to when it is set to 0, so this is not a boolean. The actual differences between 0 and 2 are unknown.
desc.zh-CN: 当设置为 1 时，使节点与移动方向对齐。原版游戏中有设置为 2 的情况，其表现似乎与设置为 0 时相似，因此这不是一个布尔值。0 和 2 之间的实际差异未知。

desc.en-US: Controls the angular speed of the node.
The node's angular speed around its local X-axis in degrees per second.
desc.zh-CN: 节点绕其局部 X 轴的角速度（度/秒）。

desc.en-US: The node's angular speed around its local Y-axis in degrees per second.
desc.zh-CN: 节点绕其局部 Y 轴的角速度（度/秒）。

desc.en-US: The node's angular speed around its local Z-axis in degrees per second.
desc.zh-CN: 节点绕其局部 Z 轴的角速度（度/秒）。

desc.en-US: Controls the translation and rotation of a node.
desc.zh-CN: 控制节点的平移和旋转。

desc.en-US:
Translation of the node.

This translation happens after all [rotations](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#StaticNodeTransform.rotation), meaning the rotations will not affect the translation.
desc.zh-CN:
节点的平移。

此平移发生在所有 [旋转](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#StaticNodeTransform.rotation)之后，意味着旋转不会影响平移。

desc.en-US:
The rotation of the node.

The order the rotations happen in is Z -> X -> Y, and the translation from [offset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#StaticNodeTransform.offset) happens after all rotations.
desc.zh-CN:
节点的旋转。

旋转顺序为 Z -> X -> Y，且 [offset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#StaticNodeTransform.offset) 的平移发生在所有旋转之后。

desc.en-US: Controls the translation and rotation of a node, and can also randomize them.
desc.zh-CN: 控制节点的平移和旋转，并可以使它们随机化。

desc.en-US:
Translation of the node.

This translation happens after all [rotations](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RandomNodeTransform.rotation), meaning the rotations will not affect the translation.
desc.zh-CN:
节点的平移。

此平移发生在所有 [旋转](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RandomNodeTransform.rotation)之后，意味着旋转不会影响平移。

desc.en-US:
The rotation of the node.

The order the rotations happen in is Z -> X -> Y, and the translation from [offset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RandomNodeTransform.offset) happens after all rotations.
desc.zh-CN:
节点的旋转。

旋转顺序为 Z -> X -> Y，且 [offset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RandomNodeTransform.offset) 的平移发生在所有旋转之后。

desc.en-US: The maximum random change in translation of the node. A random value between the [base value](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RandomNodeTransform.offset) minus this and the base value plus this will be the final offset used.
desc.zh-CN: 节点平移的最大随机变化量。将在 [基础值](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RandomNodeTransform.offset) 减去此值与基础值加上此值之间取一个随机值作为最终使用的平移偏移。

desc.en-US: The maximum random change in rotation of the node. A random value between the [base value](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RandomNodeTransform.rotation) minus this and the base value plus this will be the final rotation used.
desc.zh-CN: 节点旋转的最大随机变化量。将在 [基础值](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RandomNodeTransform.rotation) 减去此值与基础值加上此值之间取一个随机值作为最终使用的旋转。

desc.en-US: Attaches the node to the camera.
Disable this to stop the node from following the rotation of the camera.
desc.zh-CN: 禁用此项以停止节点跟随摄像机的旋转。

desc.en-US: Controls the movement of particles. This is the most basic action for controlling the acceleration of particles.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子的移动。这是控制粒子加速度最基本的行为。

desc.en-US:
Controls the acceleration of the particle along the global Y-axis. Positive values will make the particles go down, and negative values will go up.

Unless it's left at 0, this changes the current direction of the particles, which can affect various other things, for example the rotation of [Line](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionType.Line) and [QuadLine](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionType.QuadLine) particles, and the direction of this action's [acceleration](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleAcceleration.acceleration). It does not affect the particles' [initial direction](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection).
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子沿全局 Y 轴的加速度。正值使粒子下降，负值使粒子上升。

除非保持为 0，否则这会改变粒子的当前方向，这可能会影响其他方面，例如 [Line](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionType.Line) 和 [QuadLine](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionType.QuadLine) 粒子的旋转，以及此动作 [加速度](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleAcceleration.acceleration) 的方向。它不影响粒子的 [初始方向](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection)。

desc.en-US: The particles' acceleration in their current direction, which is usually their [initial direction](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection), but can be changed over time by other things, for example this action's [gravity](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleAcceleration.gravity).
desc.zh-CN: 粒子在当前方向上的加速度。通常是它们的 [初始方向](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection)，但也可能随时间被其他因素改变，例如此动作的 [重力](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleAcceleration.gravity)。

desc.en-US: Controls the movement of particles. This is the most basic action for controlling the speed of particles.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子的移动。这是控制粒子速度最基本的行为。

desc.en-US:
Controls the acceleration of the particle along the global Y-axis. Positive values will make the particles go down, and negative values will go up.

It does not affect the particles' [initial direction](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection).
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子沿全局 Y 轴的加速度。正值使粒子下降，负值使粒子上升。

除非保持为 0，否则这会改变粒子的当前方向，这可能会影响其他方面，例如 [Line](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionType.Line) 和 [QuadLine](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionType.QuadLine) 粒子的旋转，以及此动作 [速度](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleSpeed.speed) 的方向。它不影响粒子的 [初始方向](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection)。

desc.en-US: The particles' speed in their current direction, which is usually their [initial direction](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection), but can be changed over time by other things, for example this action's [gravity](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleSpeed.gravity).
desc.zh-CN: 粒子在当前方向上的速度。通常是它们的 [初始方向](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection)，但也可能随时间被其他因素改变，例如此动作的 [重力](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleSpeed.gravity)。

desc.en-US: Controls the movement of particles. This extends [ParticleSpeed](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionType.ParticleSpeed) with the ability to make particles make random turns at a fixed interval.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子的移动。扩展了 [ParticleSpeed](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionType.ParticleSpeed)，增加了使粒子以固定间隔进行随机转向的能力。

desc.en-US:
Controls the acceleration of the particle along the global Y-axis. Positive values will make the particles go down, and negative values will go up.

Unless it's left at 0, this changes the current direction of the particles, which can affect various other things, for example the rotation of [Line](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionType.Line) and [QuadLine](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionType.QuadLine) particles, and the direction of this action's [speed](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleSpeedRandomTurns.speed). It does not affect the particles' [initial direction](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection).
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子沿全局 Y 轴的加速度。正值使粒子下降，负值使粒子上升。

除非保持为 0，否则这会改变粒子的当前方向，这可能会影响其他方面，例如 [Line](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionType.Line) 和 [QuadLine](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionType.QuadLine) 粒子的旋转，以及此动作 [速度](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleSpeedRandomTurns.speed) 的方向。它不影响粒子的 [初始方向](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection)。

desc.en-US: The particles' speed in their current direction, which is usually their [initial direction](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection), but can be changed over time by other things, for example this action's [gravity](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleSpeedRandomTurns.gravity).
desc.zh-CN: 粒子在当前方向上的速度。通常是它们的 [初始方向](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection)，但也可能随时间被其他因素改变，例如此动作的 [重力](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleSpeedRandomTurns.gravity)。

desc.en-US:
The particles will turn a random amount based on this value at intervals defined by [turnInterval](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleSpeedRandomTurns.turnInterval).

This turning affects the particles' current direction, which can affect various other things, for example this action's [speed](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleSpeedRandomTurns.speed).
desc.zh-CN:
粒子将根据 [turnInterval](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleSpeedRandomTurns.turnInterval) 定义的间隔，基于此值随机转向一定角度。

此转向会影响粒子的当前方向，进而影响其他方面，例如此动作的 [速度](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleSpeedRandomTurns.speed)。

desc.en-US:
The particles will turn a random amount based on [maxTurnAngle](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleSpeedRandomTurns.maxTurnAngle) at this interval. The units are seconds, but due to how the field that stores this value works, the value will be rounded to the nearest 0.02 seconds.

This turning affects the particles' current direction, which can affect various other things, for example this action's [speed](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleSpeedRandomTurns.speed).
desc.zh-CN:
粒子将以此间隔基于 [maxTurnAngle](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleSpeedRandomTurns.maxTurnAngle) 随机转向。单位为秒，但由于存储此值的字段的工作方式，该值将四舍五入到最接近的 0.02 秒。

此转向会影响粒子的当前方向，进而影响其他方面，例如此动作的 [速度](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleSpeedRandomTurns.speed)。

desc.en-US: Controls the movement of particles. This extends [ParticleSpeedRandomTurns](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionType.ParticleSpeedRandomTurns) with the ability to make particles partially follow the parent node.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子的移动。扩展了 [ParticleSpeedRandomTurns](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionType.ParticleSpeedRandomTurns)，增加了使粒子部分跟随父节点的能力。

desc.en-US:
Controls the acceleration of the particle along the global Y-axis. Positive values will make the particles go down, and negative values will go up.

Unless it's left at 0, this changes the current direction of the particles, which can affect various other things, for example the rotation of [Line](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionType.Line) and [QuadLine](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionType.QuadLine) particles, and the direction of this action's [speed](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleSpeedPartialFollow.speed). It does not affect the particles' [initial direction](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection).

控制粒子沿全局 Y 轴的加速度。正值使粒子下降，负值使粒子上升。

desc.en-US:
The particles will turn a random amount based on this value at intervals defined by [turnInterval](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleSpeedPartialFollow.turnInterval).

This turning affects the particles' current direction, which can affect various other things, for example this action's [speed](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleSpeedPartialFollow.speed).
desc.zh-CN:
粒子将根据 [turnInterval](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleSpeedPartialFollow.turnInterval) 定义的间隔，基于此值随机转向一定角度。

此转向会影响粒子的当前方向，进而影响其他方面，例如此动作的 [速度](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleSpeedPartialFollow.speed)。

desc.en-US: Controls how well the particles should follow the parent node if they are not attached. At 0, the particles will not follow at all. At 1, the particles will follow perfectly, as if attached to the parent node. Negative values will make the particles move in the opposite direction compared to the parent node. Values greater than 1 will make the particles exaggerate the parent node's movement.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子在未附着时跟随父节点的程度。0 为完全不跟随。1 为完全跟随（如同附着到父节点）。负值使粒子向父节点相反的方向移动。大于 1 的值使粒子夸大父节点的移动。

desc.en-US:
The particles will turn a random amount based on [maxTurnAngle](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleSpeedPartialFollow.maxTurnAngle) at this interval. The units are seconds, but due to how the field that stores this value works, the value will be rounded to the nearest 0.02 seconds.

This turning affects the particles' current direction, which can affect various other things, for example this action's [speed](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleSpeedPartialFollow.speed).
desc.zh-CN:
粒子将以此间隔基于 [maxTurnAngle](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleSpeedPartialFollow.maxTurnAngle) 随机转向。单位为秒，但由于存储此值的字段的工作方式，该值将四舍五入到最接近的 0.02 秒。

此转向会影响粒子的当前方向，进而影响其他方面，例如此动作的 [速度](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleSpeedPartialFollow.speed)。

desc.en-US: Disabling this will make [followFactor](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleSpeedPartialFollow.followFactor) only affect translation and not rotation.
desc.zh-CN: 禁用此项将使 [followFactor](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleSpeedPartialFollow.followFactor) 仅影响平移而不影响旋转。

desc.en-US: Plays a sound effect when the node activates.
desc.zh-CN: 当节点激活时播放音效。

desc.en-US: The ID of the sound event to play.
desc.zh-CN: 要播放的声音事件 ID。

desc.en-US: Volume multiplier in Dark Souls 3 and possibly Sekiro, and seemingly does nothing in later games.
desc.zh-CN: 《黑暗之魂 3》和《只狼》中的音量乘数，在后续游戏中似乎没有任何作用。

desc.en-US: Controls whether the sound will repeat or not in Dark Souls 3 and possibly Sekiro, and seemingly does nothing in later games.
desc.zh-CN: 控制《黑暗之魂 3》和《只狼》中声音是否会重复，在后续游戏中似乎没有任何作用。

desc.en-US: Plays a sound effect every time the node emits particles. It only plays the sound once per emission, not once per particle.
desc.zh-CN: 每次节点发射粒子时播放音效。每次发射只播放一次，而不是每个粒子播放一次。

desc.en-US: The ID of the sound event to play.
desc.zh-CN: 要播放的声音事件 ID。

desc.en-US: Controls the speed of the node along its Z-axis.

此转向会影响粒子的当前方向，进而影响其他方面，例如此动作的 [加速度](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleAccelerationRandomTurns.acceleration)。

desc.en-US:
Controls the acceleration of the particle along the global Y-axis. Positive values will make the particles go down, and negative values will go up.

Unless it's left at 0, this changes the current direction of the particles, which can affect various other things, for example the rotation of [Line](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionType.Line) and [QuadLine](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionType.QuadLine) particles, and the direction of this action's [acceleration](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleAccelerationPartialFollow.acceleration). It does not affect the particles' [initial direction](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection).

控制粒子沿全局 Y 轴的加速度。正值使粒子下降，负值使粒子上升。

除非保持为 0，否则这会改变粒子的当前方向，这可能会影响其他方面，例如 [Line](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionType.Line) 和 [QuadLine](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionType.QuadLine) 粒子的旋转，以及此动作 [加速度](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleAccelerationPartialFollow.acceleration) 的方向。它不影响粒子的 [初始方向](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection)。

desc.en-US: The particles' acceleration in their current direction, which is usually their [initial direction](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection), but can be changed over time by other things, for example this action's [gravity](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleAccelerationPartialFollow.gravity).

desc.zh-CN: 节点持续时间（秒）。设置为 -1 可以使节点永久存在。

desc.en-US:
Controls the rendering order of this node. Lower values will cause the node to be drawn in front of nodes with a higher value. This only affects the node with this action, it is not inherited by descendant nodes.

This does not affect the actual depth of the node in the scene. It will still draw behind other objects even with a big negative bias. It only affects the order it is rendered in relative to other effects.

Model particles and light sources are not affected by this in any way. Most, if not all, other types of appearances are affected by it, even GPU particles and lens flares.
desc.zh-CN:
控制此节点的渲染顺序。较低的值会导致节点在较高值的节点之前绘制。这只影响具有此动作的节点，不会被后代节点继承。

这并不影响节点在场景中的实际深度。即使有很大的负偏差，它仍然会绘制在其他物体后面。它只影响相对于其他特效的渲染顺序。

模型粒子和光源不受此影响。大多数（如果不是全部）其他类型的外观都会受其影响，甚至包括 GPU 粒子和镜头光晕。

desc.zh-CN:
从该节点发射的粒子沿 X 轴缩放的乘数。

如果启用了 [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleModifier.uniformScale)，这也会影响 Y 和 Z 轴。

desc.en-US:
Multiplier for the scale along the Y-axis for the particles emitted from this node.

If [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleModifier.uniformScale) is enabled, [scaleX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleModifier.scaleX) also affects the Y-axis, and this property is ignored.
desc.zh-CN:
从该节点发射的粒子沿 Y 轴缩放的乘数。

如果启用了 [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleModifier.uniformScale)，[scaleX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleModifier.scaleX) 也会影响 Y 轴，此属性将被忽略。

desc.en-US:
Multiplier for the scale along the Z-axis for the particles emitted from this node.

If [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleModifier.uniformScale) is enabled, [scaleX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleModifier.scaleX) also affects the Z-axis, and this property is ignored.
desc.zh-CN:
从该节点发射的粒子沿 Z 轴缩放的乘数。

如果启用了 [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleModifier.uniformScale)，[scaleX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleModifier.scaleX) 也会影响 Z 轴，此属性将被忽略。

desc.en-US:
Color multiplier for the particles emitted from this node.

Values in this are unrestricted and can go above 1.
desc.zh-CN:
从该节点发射的粒子的颜色乘数。

此处的数值不设限，可以超过 1。

desc.en-US: Scales the particles emitted from this node uniformly based on [scaleX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleModifier.scaleX). The other scale properties in this action have no effect when this is enabled.
desc.zh-CN: 基于 [scaleX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleModifier.scaleX) 均匀缩放从该节点发射的粒子。启用此项时，此动作中的其他缩放属性无效。

desc.en-US: References another SFX by its ID.
desc.zh-CN: 通过 ID 引用另一个 SFX。

desc.en-US: The ID of the referenced SFX.
desc.zh-CN: 引用的 SFX 的 ID。

desc.en-US: Used in the [levels of detail config](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ConfigType.LevelsOfDetail) to manage the duration and thresholds for the [levels of detail node](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#NodeType.LevelsOfDetail).
desc.zh-CN: 用于 [多细节层次配置](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ConfigType.LevelsOfDetail) 中，管理 [多细节层次节点](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#NodeType.LevelsOfDetail) 的持续时间和阈值。

desc.en-US: The node duration in seconds. Can be set to -1 to make the node last forever.
desc.zh-CN: 节点持续时间（秒）。设置为 -1 可以使节点永久存在。
子节点 0 的距离阈值。
子节点 1 的距离阈值。
子节点 2 的距离阈值。
子节点 3 的距离阈值。
子节点 4 的距离阈值。

desc.en-US: Maps states to configs in the parent node.
desc.zh-CN: 将状态映射到父节点中的配置。

desc.en-US:
A list of config indices.

The index of each value represents the index of the state, and the value represents the index of the config that should be active when the state is active.
desc.zh-CN:
配置索引列表。

每个值的索引代表状态的索引，而值代表该状态激活时应激活的配置索引。

desc.en-US: Used in [NodeEmitter configs](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ConfigType.NodeEmitter) to emit all child nodes every emission.
desc.zh-CN: 用于 [NodeEmitter 配置](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ConfigType.NodeEmitter)，每次发射时发射所有子节点。

desc.en-US: Used in [NodeEmitter configs](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ConfigType.NodeEmitter) to emit a random child node every emission.
desc.zh-CN: 用于 [NodeEmitter 配置](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ConfigType.NodeEmitter)，每次发射时发射一个随机子节点。

desc.en-US:
Probability weights for each child node to be selected for emission.

The weights are stored as integers, so non-integer values in this list will be truncated.
desc.zh-CN:
每个子节点被选中发射的概率权重。

权重以整数存储，因此列表中的非整数值将被截断。

desc.en-US: Time between emitting new particles in seconds.
desc.zh-CN: 发射新粒子的时间间隔（秒）。

desc.en-US: The number of particles or nodes to emit per emission.
desc.zh-CN: 每次发射的粒子或节点数量。

desc.en-US:
The total number of emissions. Once this limit is reached, the branch will be *removed from the effect*. The node and all of its descendants will be destroyed, and there are no ways to re-enable them without respawning the entire effect as they no longer exist.

Can be set to `-1` to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN:
总发射次数。一旦达到此限制，该分支将*从效果中移除*。该节点及其所有后代将被销毁，除非重新生成整个效果，否则无法重新启用它们，因为它们已不复存在。

可以设置为 `-1` 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US: Maximum number of concurrent emitted particles or nodes. Can be set to `-1` to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 同时存在的发射粒子或节点的最大数量。可以设置为 `-1` 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US: Emits particles once it has moved a certain distance from where it last emitted particles.
desc.zh-CN: 当发射器移动了距离上次发射位置一定距离后发射粒子。

desc.en-US: How much the emitter must move to trigger emission.
desc.zh-CN: 触发发射需要移动的距离。

desc.en-US:
The total number of emissions. Once this limit is reached, the branch will be *removed from the effect*. The node and all of its descendants will be destroyed, and there are no ways to re-enable them without respawning the entire effect as they no longer exist.

Can be set to `-1` to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN:
总发射次数。一旦达到此限制，该分支将*从效果中移除*。该节点及其所有后代将被销毁，除非重新生成整个效果，否则无法重新启用它们，因为它们已不复存在。

可以设置为 `-1` 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US: Maximum number of concurrent emitted particles or nodes. Can be set to `-1` to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 同时存在的发射粒子或节点的最大数量。可以设置为 `-1` 以禁用限制。
未知 标量 属性。

desc.en-US: Makes the emitter a single point.
Controls the initial direction for particles. See [InitialDirection](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection) for more information.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子的初始方向。有关更多信息，请参阅 [InitialDirection](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection)。

desc.en-US:
Controls how the random emission points are distributed within the disk.
- At 0, particles are equally likely to emit from anywhere inside the disk.
- At 1, particles have a 100% chance of being emitted from the center point.
- At -1, particles have a 100% chance of being emitted from the perimeter circle of the disk.
- Values between these smoothly blend between them.
desc.zh-CN:
控制随机发射点在圆盘内的分布方式。
- 值为 0 时，粒子从圆盘内任何位置发射的几率相等。
- 值为 1 时，粒子有 100% 的几率从中心点发射。
- 值为 -1 时，粒子有 100% 的几率从圆盘周长圆发射。
- 这些值之间的值会平滑过渡。

desc.en-US: Controls the initial direction for particles. See [InitialDirection](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection) for more information.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子的初始方向。有关更多信息，请参阅 [InitialDirection](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection)。

desc.en-US:
Controls how the random emission points are distributed within the rectangle.
- At 0, particles are equally likely to emit from anywhere inside the rectangle.
- At 1, particles have a 100% chance of being emitted from the center point.
- At -1, particles have a 100% chance of being emitted from the perimeter of the rectangle.
- Values between these smoothly blend between them.
desc.zh-CN:
控制随机发射点在矩形内的分布方式。
- 值为 0 时，粒子从矩形内任何位置发射的几率相等。
- 值为 1 时，粒子有 100% 的几率从中心点发射。
- 值为 -1 时，粒子有 100% 的几率从矩形周边发射。
- 这些值之间的值会平滑过渡。

desc.en-US: Controls the initial direction for particles. See [InitialDirection](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection) for more information.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子的初始方向。有关更多信息，请参阅 [InitialDirection](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection)。

desc.en-US: If true, particles will be emitted from anywhere within the sphere. Otherwise the particles will be emitted only from the surface of the sphere.
desc.zh-CN: 如果为真，粒子将从球体内的任何位置发射。否则，粒子将仅从球体表面发射。

desc.en-US: Controls the initial direction for particles. See [InitialDirection](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection) for more information.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子的初始方向。有关更多信息，请参阅 [InitialDirection](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection)。

desc.en-US: If true, particles will be emitted from anywhere within the cuboid. Otherwise the particles will be emitted only from the surface of the cuboid.
desc.zh-CN: 如果为真，粒子将从长方体内的任何位置发射。否则，粒子将仅从长方体表面发射。

desc.en-US: Controls the initial direction for particles. See [InitialDirection](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection) for more information.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子的初始方向。有关更多信息，请参阅 [InitialDirection](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection)。

desc.en-US: If true, particles will be emitted from anywhere within the cylinder. Otherwise the particles will be emitted only from the surface of the cylinder, excluding the ends.
desc.zh-CN: 如果为真，粒子将从圆柱体内的任何位置发射。否则，粒子将仅从圆柱体表面发射，不包括两端。

desc.en-US: If true, the cylinder will be aligned with the Y-axis instead of the Z-axis.
desc.zh-CN: 如果为真，圆柱体将与 Y 轴对齐，而不是 Z 轴。

desc.en-US: Makes all emitted instances have the default initial direction from the emitter. See [InitialDirection](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection) for more information.
desc.zh-CN: 使所有发射的实例具有来自发射器的默认初始方向。有关更多信息，请参阅 [InitialDirection](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection)。

desc.en-US: Gives each emitted instance a random initial direction offset within a circular cone. See [InitialDirection](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection) for more information.
desc.zh-CN: 使每个发射的实例在圆锥体内具有随机的初始方向偏移。有关更多信息，请参阅 [InitialDirection](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection)。

desc.en-US: The maximum change in direction in degrees, the angle of the cone.
desc.zh-CN: 方向的最大变化角度（度），即锥体的角度。

desc.en-US:
Controls the distribution of the random directions that can be chosen.
- At 0, all directions within the cone have an equal chance of being chosen.
- At 1, the default direction is guaranteed to be chosen.
- At -1, the maximum change in direction is guaranteed, meaning the chosen direction will always be a fixed number of degrees away from the default direction based on [angle](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#CircularSpread.angle).
- Values between these values smoothly blend between them.
- Values outside of the -1 to 1 range also work, but may do some unexpected things.
desc.zh-CN:
控制可选随机方向的分布。
- 值为 0 时，锥体内所有方向被选中的几率相等。
- 值为 1 时，保证选中默认方向。
- 值为 -1 时，保证选中最大变化方向，这意味着根据 [angle](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#CircularSpread.angle)，所选方向将始终偏离默认方向固定度数。
- 这些值之间的值会平滑过渡。
- 超出 -1 到 1 范围的值也可以工作，但可能会产生意想不到的效果。

desc.en-US: No so much unknown, just unnamed. If enabled, this limits the possible directions to only positive values on one axis, effectively cutting the cone of possible directions in half.
desc.zh-CN: 与其说是未知，不如说是未命名。如果启用，这会将可能的方向限制为仅在一个轴上的正值，实际上是将可能的方向锥体切成一半。

desc.en-US: Gives each emitted instance a random initial direction offset within an elliptical cone. See [InitialDirection](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection) for more information.
desc.zh-CN: 使每个发射的实例在椭圆锥体内具有随机的初始方向偏移。有关更多信息，请参阅 [InitialDirection](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection)。

desc.en-US: The maximum change in direction in degrees, one of the angles of the elliptical cone.
desc.zh-CN: 方向的最大变化角度（度），椭圆锥体的一个角度。

desc.en-US: The maximum change in direction in degrees, one of the angles of the elliptical cone.
desc.zh-CN: 方向的最大变化角度（度），椭圆锥体的一个角度。

desc.en-US:
Controls the distribution of the random directions that can be chosen.
- At 0, all directions within the cone have an equal chance of being chosen.
- At 1, the default direction is guaranteed to be chosen.
- At -1, the maximum change in direction is guaranteed, meaning the chosen direction will always be a fixed number of degrees away from the default direction based on [angleX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EllipticalSpread.angleX) and [angleY](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EllipticalSpread.angleY).
- Values between these values smoothly blend between them.
- Values outside of the -1 to 1 range also work, but may do some unexpected things.
desc.zh-CN:
控制可选随机方向的分布。
- 值为 0 时，锥体内所有方向被选中的几率相等。
- 值为 1 时，保证选中默认方向。
- 值为 -1 时，保证选中最大变化方向，这意味着根据 [angleX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EllipticalSpread.angleX) 和 [angleY](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EllipticalSpread.angleY)，所选方向将始终偏离默认方向固定度数。
- 这些值之间的值会平滑过渡。
- 超出 -1 到 1 范围的值也可以工作，但可能会产生意想不到的效果。

desc.en-US: No so much unknown, just unnamed. If enabled, this limits the possible directions to only positive values on one axis, effectively cutting the cone of possible directions in half.
desc.zh-CN: 与其说是未知，不如说是未命名。如果启用，这会将可能的方向限制为仅在一个轴上的正值，实际上是将可能的方向锥体切成一半。

desc.en-US: Gives each emitted instance a random initial direction offset within a rectangular cone. See [InitialDirection](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection) for more information.
desc.zh-CN: 使每个发射的实例在矩形锥体内具有随机的初始方向偏移。有关更多信息，请参阅 [InitialDirection](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#InitialDirection)。

desc.en-US: The maximum change in direction in degrees, one of the angles of the elliptical cone.
desc.zh-CN: 方向的最大变化角度（度），椭圆锥体的一个角度。

desc.en-US: The maximum change in direction in degrees, one of the angles of the elliptical cone.
desc.zh-CN: 方向的最大变化角度（度），椭圆锥体的一个角度。

desc.en-US:
Controls the distribution of the random directions that can be chosen.
- At 0, all directions within the cone have an equal chance of being chosen.
- At 1, the default direction is guaranteed to be chosen.
- At -1, the maximum change in direction is guaranteed, meaning the chosen direction will always be a fixed number of degrees away from the default direction based on [angleX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RectangularSpread.angleX) and [angleY](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RectangularSpread.angleY).
- Values between these values smoothly blend between them.
- Values outside of the -1 to 1 range also work, but may do some unexpected things.
desc.zh-CN:
控制可选随机方向的分布。
- 值为 0 时，锥体内所有方向被选中的几率相等。
- 值为 1 时，保证选中默认方向。
- 值为 -1 时，保证选中最大变化方向，这意味着根据 [angleX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RectangularSpread.angleX) 和 [angleY](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RectangularSpread.angleY)，所选方向将始终偏离默认方向固定度数。
- 这些值之间的值会平滑过渡。
- 超出 -1 到 1 范围的值也可以工作，但可能会产生意想不到的效果。

desc.en-US:
Defines a very basic point sprite particle. Similar to [BillboardEx](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx), but far simpler.

The name is from Elden Ring's RTTI, where it is named "GXFXCGAppearancePointSprite".
desc.zh-CN:
定义一个非常基础的点精灵粒子。类似于 [BillboardEx](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx)，但要简单得多。

名称来自《艾尔登法环》的 RTTI，其中被命名为 "GXFXCGAppearancePointSprite"。

desc.en-US:
Color multiplier.

Values in this will be clamped to the 0-1 range. To use values outside of this range, see [color3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.color3).
desc.zh-CN:
颜色乘数。

此处的数值将被限制在 0-1 范围内。要使用超出此范围的值，请参阅 [color3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.color3)。

desc.en-US:
Color multiplier.

Values in this will be clamped to the 0-1 range. There is no equivalent property with unrestricted values based on the emission time of the particle, but [color3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.color3) is still multiplicative with this and can be used to scale the values indirectly.
desc.zh-CN:
颜色乘数。

此处的数值将被限制在 0-1 范围内。虽然没有基于粒子发射时间的不受限制值的等效属性，但 [color3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.color3) 仍可与其相乘，并可用于间接缩放数值。

desc.en-US:
Color multiplier.

Values in this are unrestricted and can go above 1. If you want values to be clamped to the 0-1 range, see [color1](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.color1).
desc.zh-CN:
颜色乘数。

此处的数值不设限，可以超过 1。如果希望将数值限制在 0-1 范围内，请参阅 [color1](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.color1)。

desc.en-US: Scalar multiplier for the color that does not affect the alpha. Effectively a brightness multiplier.
desc.zh-CN: 不影响 Alpha 的颜色标量乘数。实际上是亮度乘数。
未知 标量 属性。
未知 四维向量 属性。
未知 四维向量 属性。
未知 四维向量 属性。

desc.en-US:
Parts of the particle with less opacity than this threshold will be invisible. The range is 0-255.

This threshold creates a hard cut-off between visible and not visible, which is unlike the alpha *fade* threshold properties in some similar actions.
desc.zh-CN:
不透明度低于此阈值的粒子部分将不可见。范围是 0-255。

此阈值在可见和不可见之间创建一个硬性截止，这与某些类似动作中的 alpha *淡入淡出* 阈值属性不同。

desc.en-US:
Controls whether or not the particles have an additional bloom effect controlled by [bloomColor](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.bloomColor).

When enabled, this also allows bloom from other particles to be seen through this particle.

Note:
- This has no effect if the "Effects Quality" setting is set to "Low".
- This does not affect the natural bloom effect from high color values.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子是否具有由 [bloomColor](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.bloomColor) 控制的额外泛光效果。

启用时，这也允许透过此粒子看到其他粒子的泛光。

注意：
- 如果“特效质量”设置设为“低”，则此项无效。
- 这不影响高颜色值产生的自然泛光效果。

desc.en-US:
Controls the color of the additional bloom effect. The colors of the particle will be multiplied with this color to get the final color of the bloom effect.

Note:
- This has no effect if the "Effects Quality" setting is set to "Low".
- This does not affect the natural bloom effect from high color values.
desc.zh-CN:
控制额外泛光效果的颜色。粒子的颜色将与此颜色相乘，以获得泛光效果的最终颜色。

注意：
- 如果“特效质量”设置设为“低”，则此项无效。
- 这不影响高颜色值产生的自然泛光效果。

desc.en-US:
This controls a point where the opacity of a particle will start to fade to 0 near the [minimum view distance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.minDistance). At [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.minDistance), the opacity will be 0, and it will linearly approach 1 as the distance between the camera and the particle approaches this distance.

This requires [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.minDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0. This distance limit can be disabled by setting this and minDistance to -1.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子不透明度开始在 [最小视图距离](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.minDistance) 附近衰减为 0 的点。在 [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.minDistance) 处，不透明度为 0，随着摄像机与粒子之间的距离接近此距离，不透明度将线性接近 1。

这要求 [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.minDistance) 设置为正值或 0。可以通过将此值和 minDistance 设置为 -1 来禁用此距离限制。

desc.en-US:
Minimum view distance. If a particle is closer than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.

This requires [minFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.minFadeDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0.

This is different from [minDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.minDistanceThreshold), as this controls the start of a distance range that has smooth transitions at each end, while the threshold value is a hard cut-off.
desc.zh-CN:
最小视图距离。如果粒子与摄像机的距离小于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

这要求 [minFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.minFadeDistance) 设置为正值或 0。

这与 [minDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.minDistanceThreshold) 不同，因为此项控制的是两端具有平滑过渡的距离范围的起点，而阈值是硬性截止。

desc.en-US:
This controls a point where the opacity of a particle will start to fade to 0 near the [maximum view distance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.maxDistance). At [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.maxDistance), the opacity will be 0, and it will linearly approach 1 as the distance between the camera and the particle approaches this distance.

This requires [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.maxDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0. This distance limit can be disabled by setting this and maxDistance to -1.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子不透明度开始在 [最大视图距离](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.maxDistance) 附近衰减为 0 的点。在 [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.maxDistance) 处，不透明度为 0，随着摄像机与粒子之间的距离接近此距离，不透明度将线性接近 1。

这要求 [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.maxDistance) 设置为正值或 0。可以通过将此值和 maxDistance 设置为 -1 来禁用此距离限制。

desc.en-US:
Minimum view distance. If a particle is farther away than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.

This requires [maxFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.maxFadeDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0.

This is different from [maxDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.maxDistanceThreshold), as this controls the start of a distance range that has smooth transitions at each end, while the threshold value is a hard cut-off.
desc.zh-CN:
最小视图距离。如果粒子与摄像机的距离大于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

这要求 [maxFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.maxFadeDistance) 设置为正值或 0。

这与 [maxDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.maxDistanceThreshold) 不同，因为此项控制的是两端具有平滑过渡的距离范围的起点，而阈值是硬性截止。

desc.en-US: A hard cut-off point for the distance between the camera and the particle. If a particle is closer than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 摄像机与粒子之间距离的硬性截止点。如果粒子与摄像机的距离小于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US: A hard cut-off point for the distance between the camera and the particle. If a particle is farther away than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 摄像机与粒子之间距离的硬性截止点。如果粒子与摄像机的距离大于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US:
Unknown float.

This seems to be some sort of distance threshold. When the camera is within this distance, some things will look different in some ways. For example, when within the distance and the [blend mode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.blendMode) is set to [BlendMode.Subtract](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BlendMode.Subtract), the opacity doesn't work the way it normally does. Other effects have been found as well, but what exactly this threshold is for is unknown.
desc.zh-CN:
未知浮点数。

这似乎是某种距离阈值。当摄像机在此距离内时，某些东西看起来会有所不同。例如，当在距离内且 [混合模式](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.blendMode) 设置为 [减去](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BlendMode.Subtract) 时，不透明度不会按正常方式工作。还发现了其他影响，但此阈值的具体作用未知。

desc.en-US:
Unknown boolean.

When enabled, it seems to stop [unk_ds3_f2_29](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.unk_ds3_f2_29) from doing whatever it is doing, and it can also cause some ugly "outline" effects on things seen through particles, but it also fixes an issue where some other particles can be seen through this particle.
desc.zh-CN:
未知布尔值。

当启用时，它似乎会停止 [unk_ds3_f2_29](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite.unk_ds3_f2_29) 的作用，并且可能会对透过粒子看到的内容产生一些难看的“轮廓”效果，但它也修复了某些其他粒子可以透过此粒子看到的问题。

desc.en-US:

desc.en-US:

desc.en-US:
Parts of the particle with less opacity than this threshold will be invisible. The range is 0-255.

This threshold creates a hard cut-off between visible and not visible, which is unlike the alpha *fade* threshold properties in some similar actions.

desc.en-US:
Controls whether or not the particles have an additional bloom effect controlled by [bloomColor](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Line.bloomColor).

When enabled, this also allows bloom from other particles to be seen through this particle.

Note:
- This has no effect if the "Effects Quality" setting is set to "Low".
- This does not affect the natural bloom effect from high color values.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子是否具有由 [bloomColor](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Line.bloomColor) 控制的额外泛光效果。

注意：
- 如果“特效质量”设置设为“低”，则此项无效。
- 这不影响高颜色值产生的自然泛光效果。

desc.en-US:
Controls the color of the additional bloom effect. The colors of the particle will be multiplied with this color to get the final color of the bloom effect.

Note:
- This has no effect if the "Effects Quality" setting is set to "Low".
- This does not affect the natural bloom effect from high color values.
desc.zh-CN:

注意：
- 如果“特效质量”设置设为“低”，则此项无效。
- 这不影响高颜色值产生的自然泛光效果。

控制额外泛光效果的颜色。粒子的颜色将与此颜色相乘，以获得泛光效果的最终颜色。

注意：
- 如果“特效质量”设置设为“低”，则此项无效。
- 这不影响高颜色值产生的自然泛光效果。

desc.en-US:
This controls a point where the opacity of a particle will start to fade to 0 near the [minimum view distance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#QuadLine.minDistance). At [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#QuadLine.minDistance), the opacity will be 0, and it will linearly approach 1 as the distance between the camera and the particle approaches this distance.

This requires [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#QuadLine.minDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0. This distance limit can be disabled by setting this and minDistance to -1.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子不透明度开始在 [最小视图距离](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#QuadLine.minDistance) 附近衰减为 0 的点。在 [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#QuadLine.minDistance) 处，不透明度为 0，随着摄像机与粒子之间的距离接近此距离，不透明度将线性接近 1。

这要求 [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#QuadLine.minDistance) 设置为正值或 0。可以通过将此值和 minDistance 设置为 -1 来禁用此距离限制。

desc.en-US:
Minimum view distance. If a particle is closer than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.

This requires [minFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#QuadLine.minFadeDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0.

This is different from [minDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#QuadLine.minDistanceThreshold), as this controls the start of a distance range that has smooth transitions at each end, while the threshold value is a hard cut-off.
desc.zh-CN:
最小视图距离。如果粒子与摄像机的距离小于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

这要求 [minFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#QuadLine.minFadeDistance) 设置为正值或 0。

这与 [minDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#QuadLine.minDistanceThreshold) 不同，因为此项控制的是两端具有平滑过渡的距离范围的起点，而阈值是硬性截止。

desc.en-US:
This controls a point where the opacity of a particle will start to fade to 0 near the [maximum view distance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#QuadLine.maxDistance). At [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#QuadLine.maxDistance), the opacity will be 0, and it will linearly approach 1 as the distance between the camera and the particle approaches this distance.

This requires [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#QuadLine.maxDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0. This distance limit can be disabled by setting this and maxDistance to -1.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子不透明度开始在 [最大视图距离](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#QuadLine.maxDistance) 附近衰减为 0 的点。在 [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#QuadLine.maxDistance) 处，不透明度为 0，随着摄像机与粒子之间的距离接近此距离，不透明度将线性接近 1。

这要求 [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#QuadLine.maxDistance) 设置为正值或 0。可以通过将此值和 maxDistance 设置为 -1 来禁用此距离限制。

desc.en-US:
Minimum view distance. If a particle is farther away than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.

This requires [maxFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#QuadLine.maxFadeDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0.

This is different from [maxDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#QuadLine.maxDistanceThreshold), as this controls the start of a distance range that has smooth transitions at each end, while the threshold value is a hard cut-off.
desc.zh-CN:
最小视图距离。如果粒子与摄像机的距离大于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

这要求 [maxFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#QuadLine.maxFadeDistance) 设置为正值或 0。

这与 [maxDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#QuadLine.maxDistanceThreshold) 不同，因为此项控制的是两端具有平滑过渡的距离范围的起点，而阈值是硬性截止。

desc.en-US: A hard cut-off point for the distance between the camera and the particle. If a particle is closer than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 摄像机与粒子之间距离的硬性截止点。如果粒子与摄像机的距离小于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US: A hard cut-off point for the distance between the camera and the particle. If a particle is farther away than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 摄像机与粒子之间距离的硬性截止点。如果粒子与摄像机的距离大于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US:
Unknown float.

This seems to be some sort of distance threshold. When the camera is within this distance, some things will look different in some ways. For example, when within the distance and the [blend mode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#QuadLine.blendMode) is set to [BlendMode.Subtract](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BlendMode.Subtract), the opacity doesn't work the way it normally does. Other effects have been found as well, but what exactly this threshold is for is unknown.
desc.zh-CN:
未知浮点数。

这似乎是某种距离阈值。当摄像机在此距离内时，某些东西看起来会有所不同。例如，当在距离内且 [混合模式](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#QuadLine.blendMode) 设置为 [减去](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BlendMode.Subtract) 时，不透明度不会按正常方式工作。还发现了其他影响，但此阈值的具体作用未知。

desc.en-US:
Unknown boolean.

When enabled, it seems to stop [unk_ds3_f2_29](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#QuadLine.unk_ds3_f2_29) from doing whatever it is doing, and it can also cause some ugly "outline" effects on things seen through particles, but it also fixes an issue where some other particles can be seen through this particle.
desc.zh-CN:
未知布尔值。

当启用时，它似乎会停止 [unk_ds3_f2_29](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#QuadLine.unk_ds3_f2_29) 的作用，并且可能会对透过粒子看到的内容产生一些难看的“轮廓”效果，但它也修复了某些其他粒子可以透过此粒子看到的问题。

desc.en-US:
Defines a simple, flat, textured particle. Similar to [PointSprite](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite), but with far more options. This is the most common type of particle in the supported games.

The name is from Elden Ring's RTTI, where it is named "GXFfxAppearanceBillboardEx". The "Ex" suffix refers to it being an extended version of a base class named "Billboard", but this seems to just be an inconsistency in naming some of the appearance classes. Most other appearance classes extend some base class, but the base class either has a "Base" suffix, or the extended and base share the same name.
desc.zh-CN:
定义一个简单的、扁平的、带纹理的粒子。与 [PointSprite](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointSprite) 相似，但选项要多得多。这是所支持游戏中最常见的粒子类型。

该名称源自《艾尔登法环》的 RTTI，其中被称为 "GXFfxAppearanceBillboardEx"。"Ex" 后缀指的是它是一个名为 "Billboard" 的基类的扩展版本，但这似乎只是某些外观类命名上的不一致。大多数其他外观类都扩展了某个基类，但基类要么带有 "Base" 后缀，要么扩展类和基类共享相同的名称。

desc.en-US:
The width of the particle.

If [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.uniformScale) is enabled, this also controls the height.
desc.zh-CN:
粒子的宽度。

如果启用了 [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.uniformScale)，这也会控制高度。

desc.en-US:
The height of the particle.

If [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.uniformScale) is enabled, [width](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.width) also controls the height, and this property is ignored.
desc.zh-CN:
粒子的高度。

如果启用了 [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.uniformScale)，[width](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.width) 也会控制高度，此属性将被忽略。

desc.en-US:
Color multiplier.

Values in this will be clamped to the 0-1 range. To use values outside of this range, see [color3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.color3).
desc.zh-CN:
颜色乘数。

此处的数值将被限制在 0-1 范围内。要使用超出此范围的值，请参阅 [color3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.color3)。

desc.en-US:
Color multiplier.

Values in this will be clamped to the 0-1 range. There is no equivalent property with unrestricted values based on the emission time of the particle, but [color3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.color3) is still multiplicative with this and can be used to scale the values indirectly.
desc.zh-CN:
颜色乘数。

此处的数值将被限制在 0-1 范围内。虽然没有基于粒子发射时间的不受限制值的等效属性，但 [color3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.color3) 仍可与其相乘，并可用于间接缩放数值。

desc.en-US:
Color multiplier.

Values in this are unrestricted and can go above 1. If you want values to be clamped to the 0-1 range, see [color1](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.color1).
desc.zh-CN:
颜色乘数。

此处的数值不设限，可以超过 1。如果希望将数值限制在 0-1 范围内，请参阅 [color1](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.color1)。

desc.en-US:
Parts of the particle with less opacity than this threshold will be invisible. The range is 0-255.

Values above this threshold will be stretched to fill the alpha range, so values near the threshold will be less visible, creating a smooth transition between the parts that have been hidden by the threshold and the ones that are still visible.
desc.zh-CN:
不透明度低于此阈值的粒子部分将不可见。范围是 0-255。

高于此阈值的值将被拉伸以填充 Alpha 范围，因此接近阈值的值将不太明显，从而在被阈值隐藏的部分和仍然可见的部分之间创建平滑过渡。

desc.en-US: Rotation around the X-axis in degrees.
desc.zh-CN: 绕 X 轴的旋转角度（度）。

desc.en-US: Rotation around the Y-axis in degrees.
desc.zh-CN: 绕 Y 轴的旋转角度（度）。

desc.en-US: Rotation around the Z-axis in degrees.
desc.zh-CN: 绕 Z 轴的旋转角度（度）。

desc.en-US: Angular speed around the X-axis in degrees per second.
desc.zh-CN: 绕 X 轴的角速度（度/秒）。

desc.en-US: Angular speed around the Y-axis in degrees per second.
desc.zh-CN: 绕 Y 轴的角速度（度/秒）。

desc.en-US: Angular speed around the Z-axis in degrees per second.
desc.zh-CN: 绕 Z 轴的角速度（度/秒）。

desc.en-US: Positive values will make the particle draw in front of objects closer to the camera, while negative values will make it draw behind objects farther away from the camera.
desc.zh-CN: 正值将使粒子绘制在靠近摄像机的物体前面，而负值将使粒子绘制在远离摄像机的物体后面。

desc.en-US:
The index of the frame to show from the texture atlas. Can be animated using a [linear property](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PropertyFunction.Linear) or similar.

Seemingly identical to [frameIndexOffset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.frameIndexOffset)? The sum of these two properties is the actual frame index that gets used.
desc.zh-CN:
要从纹理图集中显示的帧索引。可以使用 [线性属性](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PropertyFunction.Linear)或类似属性进行动画处理。

似乎与 [frameIndexOffset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.frameIndexOffset) 相同？这两个属性的总和是实际使用的帧索引。

desc.en-US: Seemingly identical to [frameIndex](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.frameIndex)? The sum of these two properties is the actual frame index that gets used.
desc.zh-CN: 似乎与 [frameIndex](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.frameIndex) 相同？这两个属性的总和是实际使用的帧索引。
未知 标量 属性。
未知 标量 属性。

desc.en-US: Scalar multiplier for the color that does not affect the alpha. Effectively a brightness multiplier.
desc.zh-CN: 不影响 Alpha 的颜色标量乘数。实际上是亮度乘数。
未知 标量 属性。
未知 四维向量 属性。
未知 四维向量 属性。
未知 四维向量 属性。

desc.en-US:
Parts of the particle with less opacity than this threshold will be invisible. The range is 0-255.

This threshold creates a hard cut-off between visible and not visible, which is unlike the [alphaFadeThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.alphaFadeThreshold).
desc.zh-CN:
不透明度低于此阈值的粒子部分将不可见。范围是 0-255。

此阈值在可见和不可见之间创建一个硬性截止，这与 [alphaFadeThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.alphaFadeThreshold) 不同。

desc.en-US: Controls the orientation mode for the particles. See [OrientationMode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#OrientationMode) for more information.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子的朝向模式。有关更多信息，请参阅 [OrientationMode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#OrientationMode)。

desc.en-US:
Each particle will pick a random number between this value and 1, and the width of the particle will be multiplied by this number. For example, setting this to 0.5 will make the particles randomly thinner, down to half width. Setting it to 2 will make them randomly wider, up to double width.

If [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.uniformScale) is enabled, this also affects the height.
desc.zh-CN:
每个粒子将在此值和 1 之间选取一个随机数，粒子的宽度将乘以该数。例如，将其设置为 0.5 将使粒子随机变细，最细为一半宽度。将其设置为 2 将使它们随机变宽，最宽为两倍宽度。

如果启用了 [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.uniformScale)，这也会影响高度。

desc.en-US:
Each particle will pick a random number between this value and 1, and the height of the particle will be multiplied by this number. For example, setting this to 0.5 will make the particles randomly shorter, down to half height. Setting it to 2 will make them randomly taller, up to double height.

If [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.uniformScale) is enabled, [scaleVariationX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.scaleVariationX) also affects the height, and this field is ignored.
desc.zh-CN:
每个粒子将在此值和 1 之间选取一个随机数，粒子的高度将乘以该数。例如，将其设置为 0.5 将使粒子随机变矮，最矮为一半高度。将其设置为 2 将使它们随机变高，最高为两倍高度。

如果启用了 [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.uniformScale)，[scaleVariationX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.scaleVariationX) 也会影响高度，此字段将被忽略。

desc.en-US: If enabled, the particle width-related properties and fields will control both the width and height of the particles, and the height counterparts will be ignored.
desc.zh-CN: 如果启用，粒子宽度相关的属性和字段将同时控制粒子的宽度和高度，而高度对应的属性将被忽略。

desc.en-US: When `true`, scaling is applied before rotation for the particle, which allows non-square particles to maintain their shape when rotated. When `false`, scaling is applied after rotation, which allows particles to be skewed, for example a square rotated 45 degrees and then made thinner will turn into a diamond shape.
desc.zh-CN: 当为 `true` 时，缩放应用于粒子旋转之前，这允许非正方形粒子在旋转时保持其形状。当为 `false` 时，缩放应用于旋转之后，这允许粒子倾斜，例如旋转 45 度的正方形变细后会变成菱形。

desc.en-US: To split the texture into multiple animation frames, this value must be set to the number of columns in the texture. It should equal `textureWidth / frameWidth`.
desc.zh-CN: 要将纹理分割成多个动画帧，必须将此值设置为纹理中的列数。它应等于 `textureWidth / frameWidth`。

desc.en-US: To split the texture into multiple animation frames, this value must be set to the total number of frames in the texture.
desc.zh-CN: 要将纹理分割成多个动画帧，必须将此值设置为纹理中的总帧数。

desc.en-US:
If enabled, the texture animation will use linear interpolation to mix frames when the frame index is not a whole number. For example, if the frame index is 0.5, enabling this will cause the average of the first two frames to be shown instead of just the first frame.

If disabled, the frame index will be truncated to get a whole number.
desc.zh-CN:
如果启用，纹理动画将在帧索引不是整数时使用线性插值混合帧。例如，如果帧索引为 0.5，启用此项将显示前两帧的平均值，而不仅仅是第一帧。

如果禁用，帧索引将被截断为整数。

desc.en-US: Controls how the particles should render when behind something else. If disabled, the particles will simply be drawn behind anything they are behind in the world. If enabled, they will instead display in front of the object if they are close enough, and will fade out with distance from the object's surface that is blocking the view of the particle.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子在其他物体后面时的渲染方式。如果禁用，粒子将简单地绘制在世界中任何遮挡它的物体后面。如果启用，如果它们足够近，它们将显示在物体前面，并随着与阻挡粒子视线的物体表面的距离增加而淡出。

desc.en-US: Controls the shape of the particles. If disabled, the particles will be rectangular. If enabled, they will be octagonal.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子的形状。如果禁用，粒子将是矩形的。如果启用，它们将是八角形的。
未知整数。可能是布尔值？

desc.en-US:
Controls whether or not the particles have an additional bloom effect controlled by [bloomColor](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.bloomColor).

When enabled, this also allows bloom from other particles to be seen through this particle.

Note:
- This has no effect if the "Effects Quality" setting is set to "Low".
- This does not affect the natural bloom effect from high color values.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子是否具有由 [bloomColor](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.bloomColor) 控制的额外泛光效果。

启用时，这也允许透过此粒子看到其他粒子的泛光。

注意：
- 如果“特效质量”设置设为“低”，则此项无效。
- 这不影响高颜色值产生的自然泛光效果。

desc.en-US:
Controls the color of the additional bloom effect. The colors of the particle will be multiplied with this color to get the final color of the bloom effect.

Note:
- This has no effect if the "Effects Quality" setting is set to "Low".
- This does not affect the natural bloom effect from high color values.
desc.zh-CN:
控制额外泛光效果的颜色。粒子的颜色将与此颜色相乘，以获得泛光效果的最终颜色。

注意：
- 如果“特效质量”设置设为“低”，则此项无效。
- 这不影响高颜色值产生的自然泛光效果。
