Minimum view distance. If a particle is farther away than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.

This requires [maxFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.maxFadeDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0.

This is different from [maxDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.maxDistanceThreshold), as this controls the start of a distance range that has smooth transitions at each end, while the threshold value is a hard cut-off.
desc.zh-CN:
最小视图距离。如果粒子与摄像机的距离大于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

这要求 [maxFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.maxFadeDistance) 设置为正值或 0。

这与 [maxDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.maxDistanceThreshold) 不同，因为此项控制的是两端具有平滑过渡的距离范围的起点，而阈值是硬性截止。

desc.en-US: A hard cut-off point for the distance between the camera and the particle. If a particle is closer than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 摄像机与粒子之间距离的硬性截止点。如果粒子与摄像机的距离小于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US: A hard cut-off point for the distance between the camera and the particle. If a particle is farther away than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 摄像机与粒子之间距离的硬性截止点。如果粒子与摄像机的距离大于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US: If enabled, the texture's color will be multiplied by its alpha value, making more transparent parts of the texture darker.
desc.zh-CN: 如果启用，纹理的颜色将乘以其 Alpha 值，使纹理更透明的部分变暗。

desc.en-US:
Unknown float.

This seems to be some sort of distance threshold. When the camera is within this distance, some things will look different in some ways. For example, when within the distance and the [blend mode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.blendMode) is set to [BlendMode.Subtract](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BlendMode.Subtract), the opacity doesn't work the way it normally does. Other effects have been found as well, but what exactly this threshold is for is unknown.
desc.zh-CN:
未知浮点数。

这似乎是某种距离阈值。当摄像机在此距离内时，某些东西看起来会有所不同。例如，当在距离内且 [混合模式](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.blendMode) 设置为 [减去](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BlendMode.Subtract) 时，不透明度不会按正常方式工作。还发现了其他影响，但此阈值的具体作用未知。

desc.en-US: Controls how dark shaded parts of the particle are.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子阴影部分的暗度。

desc.en-US:
When set to 1, this stops the particles from being shown indoors.

Other values are used in AC6, but what they do is unknown.
desc.zh-CN:
当设置为 1 时，这将停止粒子在室内显示。

AC6 中使用了其他值，但具体作用未知。

desc.en-US:
Unknown boolean.

When enabled, it seems to stop [unk_ds3_f2_29](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.unk_ds3_f2_29) from doing whatever it is doing, and it can also cause some ugly "outline" effects on things seen through particles, but it also fixes an issue where some other particles can be seen through this particle.
desc.zh-CN:
未知布尔值。

当启用时，它似乎会停止 [unk_ds3_f2_29](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx.unk_ds3_f2_29) 的作用，并且可能会对透过粒子看到的内容产生一些难看的“轮廓”效果，但它也修复了某些其他粒子可以透过此粒子看到的问题。

desc.en-US: Controls how sharp the specular highlights are.
desc.zh-CN: 控制高光亮点的清晰度。

desc.en-US: Controls how the particles are lit. See [LightingMode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LightingMode) for more information.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子的光照方式。有关更多信息，请参阅 [LightingMode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LightingMode)。

desc.en-US: Controls how bright the specular highlights are.

Defines a particle appearance with multiple textured layers. This is overall pretty similar to [BillboardEx](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx), but the ability to layer multiple textures in different ways allows you to apply masks, overlay random noise to increase variance, and so on.

The name is from Elden Ring's RTTI, where it is named "GXFfxAppearanceMultiTextureBillboardEx". The "Ex" suffix refers to it being an extended version of a base class named "MultiTextureBillboard", but this seems to just be an inconsistency in naming some of the appearance classes. Most other appearance classes extend some base class, but the base class either has a "Base" suffix, or the extended and base share the same name.
desc.zh-CN:
定义一个具有多层纹理的粒子外观。这总体上与 [BillboardEx](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BillboardEx) 非常相似，但能够以不同方式叠加多层纹理，使其可以应用遮罩、叠加随机噪声以增加变化性，等等。

该名称来自《艾尔登法环》的 RTTI，其中它被命名为 "GXFfxAppearanceMultiTextureBillboardEx"。"Ex" 后缀指的是它是一个名为 "MultiTextureBillboard" 的基类的扩展版本，但这似乎只是某些外观类命名上的一种不一致。大多数其他外观类都扩展了某个基类，但基类要么带有 "Base" 后缀，要么扩展类和基类共享相同的名称。

desc.en-US:
The width of the particle.

If [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.uniformScale) is enabled, this also controls the height.
desc.zh-CN:
粒子的宽度。

如果启用了 [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.uniformScale)，这也会控制高度。

desc.en-US:
The height of the particle.

If [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.uniformScale) is enabled, [width](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.width) also controls the height, and this property is ignored.
desc.zh-CN:
粒子的高度。

如果启用了 [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.uniformScale)，[width](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.width) 也会控制高度，此属性将被忽略。

desc.en-US: Rotation around the X-axis in degrees.
desc.zh-CN: 绕 X 轴的旋转角度（度）。

desc.en-US: Rotation around the Y-axis in degrees.
desc.zh-CN: 绕 Y 轴的旋转角度（度）。

desc.en-US: Rotation around the Z-axis in degrees.
desc.zh-CN: 绕 Z 轴的旋转角度（度）。

desc.en-US: Angular speed around the X-axis in degrees per second.
desc.zh-CN: 绕 X 轴的角速度（度/秒）。

desc.en-US: Angular speed around the Y-axis in degrees per second.
desc.zh-CN: 绕 Y 轴的角速度（度/秒）。

desc.en-US: Angular speed around the Z-axis in degrees per second.
desc.zh-CN: 绕 Z 轴的角速度（度/秒）。

desc.en-US:
Color multiplier for the particle.

Values in this will be clamped to the 0-1 range. To use values outside of this range, see [color3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.color3).
desc.zh-CN:
粒子的颜色乘数。

此处的数值将被限制在 0-1 范围内。要使用超出此范围的值，请参阅 [color3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.color3)。

desc.en-US:
Color multiplier for the particle.

Values in this will be clamped to the 0-1 range. There is no equivalent property with unrestricted values based on the emission time of the particle, but [color3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.color3) is still multiplicative with this and can be used to scale the values indirectly.
desc.zh-CN:
粒子的颜色乘数。

此处的数值将被限制在 0-1 范围内。虽然没有基于粒子发射时间的不受限制值的等效属性，但 [color3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.color3) 仍可与其相乘，并可用于间接缩放数值。

desc.en-US:
Color multiplier for the particle.

Values in this are unrestricted and can go above 1. If you want values to be clamped to the 0-1 range, see [color1](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.color1).
desc.zh-CN:
粒子的颜色乘数。

此处的数值不设限，可以超过 1。如果希望将数值限制在 0-1 范围内，请参阅 [color1](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.color1)。

desc.en-US:
Color multiplier for Layer 1.

Values in this will be clamped to the 0-1 range.
desc.zh-CN:
第 1 层的颜色乘数。

此处的数值将被限制在 0-1 范围内。

desc.en-US:
Color multiplier for Layer 2.

Values in this will be clamped to the 0-1 range.
desc.zh-CN:
第 2 层的颜色乘数。

此处的数值将被限制在 0-1 范围内。

desc.en-US:
Color multiplier for Layer 3.

Values in this will be clamped to the 0-1 range.
desc.zh-CN:
第 3 层的颜色乘数。

此处的数值将被限制在 0-1 范围内。

desc.en-US:
Parts of the particle with less opacity than this threshold will be invisible. The range is 0-255.

Values above this threshold will be stretched to fill the alpha range, so values near the threshold will be less visible, creating a smooth transition between the parts that have been hidden by the threshold and the ones that are still visible.
desc.zh-CN:
不透明度低于此阈值的粒子部分将不可见。范围是 0-255。

高于此阈值的值将被拉伸以填充 Alpha 范围，因此接近阈值的值将不太明显，从而在被阈值隐藏的部分和仍然可见的部分之间创建平滑过渡。

desc.en-US:
The index of the frame to show from the texture atlas. Can be animated using a [linear property](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PropertyFunction.Linear) or similar.

Seemingly identical to [frameIndexOffset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.frameIndexOffset)? The sum of these two properties is the actual frame index that gets used.
desc.zh-CN:
要从纹理图集中显示的帧索引。可以使用 [线性属性](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PropertyFunction.Linear)或类似属性进行动画处理。

似乎与 [frameIndexOffset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.frameIndexOffset) 相同？这两个属性的总和是实际使用的帧索引。

desc.en-US: Seemingly identical to [frameIndex](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.frameIndex)? The sum of these two properties is the actual frame index that gets used.
desc.zh-CN: 似乎与 [frameIndex](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.frameIndex) 相同？这两个属性的总和是实际使用的帧索引。
第 1 层的水平滚动速度。
第 1 层的垂直滚动速度。

desc.en-US: Horizontal offset for the UV coordinates of Layer 1.
desc.zh-CN: 第 1 层 UV 坐标的水平偏移。

desc.en-US: Vertical offset for the UV coordinates of Layer 1.
desc.zh-CN: 第 1 层 UV 坐标的垂直偏移。

desc.en-US: Horizontal scale for the UV coordinates of Layer 1.
desc.zh-CN: 第 1 层 UV 坐标的水平缩放。

desc.en-US: Vertical scale for the UV coordinates of Layer 1.
desc.zh-CN: 第 1 层 UV 坐标的垂直缩放。
第 2 层的水平滚动速度。
第 2 层的垂直滚动速度。

desc.en-US: Horizontal offset for the UV coordinates of Layer 2.
desc.zh-CN: 第 2 层 UV 坐标的水平偏移。

desc.en-US: Vertical offset for the UV coordinates of Layer 2.
desc.zh-CN: 第 2 层 UV 坐标的垂直偏移。

desc.en-US: Horizontal scale for the UV coordinates of Layer 2.
desc.zh-CN: 第 2 层 UV 坐标的水平缩放。

desc.en-US: Vertical scale for the UV coordinates of Layer 2.
desc.zh-CN: 第 2 层 UV 坐标的垂直缩放。
第 3 层的水平滚动速度。
第 3 层的垂直滚动速度。

desc.en-US: Horizontal offset for the UV coordinates of Layer 3.
desc.zh-CN: 第 3 层 UV 坐标的水平偏移。

desc.en-US: Vertical offset for the UV coordinates of Layer 3.
desc.zh-CN: 第 3 层 UV 坐标的垂直偏移。

desc.en-US: Horizontal scale for the UV coordinates of Layer 3.
desc.zh-CN: 第 3 层 UV 坐标的水平缩放。

desc.en-US: Vertical scale for the UV coordinates of Layer 3.
desc.zh-CN: 第 3 层 UV 坐标的垂直缩放。

desc.en-US: Scalar multiplier for the color that does not affect the alpha. Effectively a brightness multiplier.
desc.zh-CN: 不影响 Alpha 的颜色标量乘数。实际上是亮度乘数。
未知 标量 属性。
未知 四维向量 属性。
未知 四维向量 属性。
未知 四维向量 属性。

desc.en-US:
Parts of the particle with less opacity than this threshold will be invisible. The range is 0-255.

This threshold creates a hard cut-off between visible and not visible, which is unlike the [alphaFadeThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.alphaFadeThreshold).
desc.zh-CN:
不透明度低于此阈值的粒子部分将不可见。范围是 0-255。

此阈值在可见和不可见之间创建一个硬性截止，这与 [alphaFadeThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.alphaFadeThreshold) 不同。

desc.en-US: Controls the orientation mode for the particles. See [OrientationMode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#OrientationMode) for more information.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子的朝向模式。有关更多信息，请参阅 [OrientationMode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#OrientationMode)。

desc.en-US: If enabled, the particle width-related properties and fields will control both the width and height of the particles, and the height counterparts will be ignored.
desc.zh-CN: 如果启用，粒子宽度相关的属性和字段将同时控制粒子的宽度和高度，而高度对应的属性将被忽略。

desc.en-US: When `true`, scaling is applied before rotation for the particle, which allows non-square particles to maintain their shape when rotated. When `false`, scaling is applied after rotation, which allows particles to be skewed, for example a square rotated 45 degrees and then made thinner will turn into a diamond shape.
desc.zh-CN: 当为 `true` 时，缩放应用于粒子旋转之前，这允许非正方形粒子在旋转时保持其形状。当为 `false` 时，缩放应用于旋转之后，这允许粒子倾斜，例如旋转 45 度的正方形变细后会变成菱形。

desc.en-US: To split the texture into multiple animation frames, this value must be set to the number of columns in the texture. It should equal `textureWidth / frameWidth`.
desc.zh-CN: 要将纹理分割成多个动画帧，必须将此值设置为纹理中的列数。它应等于 `textureWidth / frameWidth`。

desc.en-US: To split the texture into multiple animation frames, this value must be set to the total number of frames in the texture.
desc.zh-CN: 要将纹理分割成多个动画帧，必须将此值设置为纹理中的总帧数。

desc.en-US:
If enabled, the texture animation will use linear interpolation to mix frames when the frame index is not a whole number. For example, if the frame index is 0.5, enabling this will cause the average of the first two frames to be shown instead of just the first frame.

If disabled, the frame index will be truncated to get a whole number.
desc.zh-CN:
如果启用，纹理动画将在帧索引不是整数时使用线性插值混合帧。例如，如果帧索引为 0.5，启用此项将显示前两帧的平均值，而不仅仅是第一帧。

如果禁用，帧索引将被截断为整数。

desc.en-US: Controls how the particles should render when behind something else. If disabled, the particles will simply be drawn behind anything they are behind in the world. If enabled, they will instead display in front of the object if they are close enough, and will fade out with distance from the object's surface that is blocking the view of the particle.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子在其他物体后面时的渲染方式。如果禁用，粒子将简单地绘制在世界中任何遮挡它的物体后面。如果启用，如果它们足够近，它们将显示在物体前面，并随着与阻挡粒子视线的物体表面的距离增加而淡出。

desc.en-US: Controls the shape of the particles. If disabled, the particles will be rectangular. If enabled, they will be octagonal.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子的形状。如果禁用，粒子将是矩形的。如果启用，它们将是八角形的。

desc.en-US:
Controls whether or not the particles have an additional bloom effect controlled by [bloomColor](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.bloomColor).

When enabled, this also allows bloom from other particles to be seen through this particle.

Note:
- This has no effect if the "Effects Quality" setting is set to "Low".
- This does not affect the natural bloom effect from high color values.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子是否具有由 [bloomColor](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.bloomColor) 控制的额外泛光效果。

启用时，这也允许透过此粒子看到其他粒子的泛光。

注意：
- 如果“特效质量”设置设为“低”，则此项无效。
- 这不影响高颜色值产生的自然泛光效果。

desc.en-US:
Controls the color of the additional bloom effect. The colors of the particle will be multiplied with this color to get the final color of the bloom effect.

Note:
- This has no effect if the "Effects Quality" setting is set to "Low".
- This does not affect the natural bloom effect from high color values.
desc.zh-CN:
控制额外泛光效果的颜色。粒子的颜色将与此颜色相乘，以获得泛光效果的最终颜色。

注意：
- 如果“特效质量”设置设为“低”，则此项无效。
- 这不影响高颜色值产生的自然泛光效果。

desc.en-US:
| Value | Behavior |
|-|-|
| 0 | All layers may have colors, and the layer textures are all multiplied when blending. The opacity is based only on the alpha of the [layer1](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.layer1) texture. |
| 1 | Removes all color from layers [2](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.layer2) and [3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.layer3), and makes the brightness of the pixels in the texture of those layers affect the opacity. |
| 2 | Removes all color from [layer 2](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.layer2) only, and makes the brightness of the pixels in the texture of that layer affect the opacity. |
desc.zh-CN:
| 值 | 行为 |
|-|-|
| 0 | 所有层都可以有颜色，并且在混合时所有层纹理相乘。不透明度仅基于 [layer1](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.layer1) 纹理的 Alpha。 |
| 1 | 移除层 [2](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.layer2) 和 [3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.layer3) 的所有颜色，并使这些层纹理中像素的亮度影响不透明度。 |
| 2 | 仅移除 [第 2 层](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.layer2) 的所有颜色，并使该层纹理中像素的亮度影响不透明度。 |

desc.en-US: Unknown integer, however it seems to affect the blending of the layers and color multipliers in some way.
desc.zh-CN: 未知整数，但它似乎以某种方式影响层的混合和颜色乘数。

desc.en-US:
This controls a point where the opacity of a particle will start to fade to 0 near the [minimum view distance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.minDistance). At [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.minDistance), the opacity will be 0, and it will linearly approach 1 as the distance between the camera and the particle approaches this distance.

This requires [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.minDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0. This distance limit can be disabled by setting this and minDistance to -1.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子不透明度开始在 [最小视图距离](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.minDistance) 附近衰减为 0 的点。在 [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.minDistance) 处，不透明度为 0，随着摄像机与粒子之间的距离接近此距离，不透明度将线性接近 1。

这要求 [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.minDistance) 设置为正值或 0。可以通过将此值和 minDistance 设置为 -1 来禁用此距离限制。

desc.en-US:
Minimum view distance. If a particle is closer than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.

This requires [minFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.minFadeDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0.

This is different from [minDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.minDistanceThreshold), as this controls the start of a distance range that has smooth transitions at each end, while the threshold value is a hard cut-off.
desc.zh-CN:
最小视图距离。如果粒子与摄像机的距离小于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

这要求 [minFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.minFadeDistance) 设置为正值或 0。

这与 [minDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.minDistanceThreshold) 不同，因为此项控制的是两端具有平滑过渡的距离范围的起点，而阈值是硬性截止。

desc.en-US:
This controls a point where the opacity of a particle will start to fade to 0 near the [maximum view distance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.maxDistance). At [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.maxDistance), the opacity will be 0, and it will linearly approach 1 as the distance between the camera and the particle approaches this distance.

This requires [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.maxDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0. This distance limit can be disabled by setting this and maxDistance to -1.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子不透明度开始在 [最大视图距离](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.maxDistance) 附近衰减为 0 的点。在 [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.maxDistance) 处，不透明度为 0，随着摄像机与粒子之间的距离接近此距离，不透明度将线性接近 1。

这要求 [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.maxDistance) 设置为正值或 0。可以通过将此值和 maxDistance 设置为 -1 来禁用此距离限制。

desc.en-US:
Minimum view distance. If a particle is farther away than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.

This requires [maxFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.maxFadeDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0.

This is different from [maxDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.maxDistanceThreshold), as this controls the start of a distance range that has smooth transitions at each end, while the threshold value is a hard cut-off.
desc.zh-CN:
最小视图距离。如果粒子与摄像机的距离大于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

这要求 [maxFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.maxFadeDistance) 设置为正值或 0。

这与 [maxDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.maxDistanceThreshold) 不同，因为此项控制的是两端具有平滑过渡的距离范围的起点，而阈值是硬性截止。

desc.en-US: A hard cut-off point for the distance between the camera and the particle. If a particle is closer than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 摄像机与粒子之间距离的硬性截止点。如果粒子与摄像机的距离小于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US: A hard cut-off point for the distance between the camera and the particle. If a particle is farther away than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 摄像机与粒子之间距离的硬性截止点。如果粒子与摄像机的距离大于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US: If enabled, the texture's color will be multiplied by its alpha value, making more transparent parts of the texture darker.
desc.zh-CN: 如果启用，纹理的颜色将乘以其 Alpha 值，使纹理更透明的部分变暗。

desc.en-US:
Unknown float.

This seems to be some sort of distance threshold. When the camera is within this distance, some things will look different in some ways. For example, when within the distance and the [blend mode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.blendMode) is set to [BlendMode.Subtract](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BlendMode.Subtract), the opacity doesn't work the way it normally does. Other effects have been found as well, but what exactly this threshold is for is unknown.
desc.zh-CN:
未知浮点数。

这似乎是某种距离阈值。当摄像机在此距离内时，某些东西看起来会有所不同。例如，当在距离内且 [混合模式](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.blendMode) 设置为 [减去](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BlendMode.Subtract) 时，不透明度不会按正常方式工作。还发现了其他影响，但此阈值的具体作用未知。

desc.en-US: Controls how dark shaded parts of the particle are.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子阴影部分的暗度。

desc.en-US:
Unknown boolean.

When enabled, it seems to stop [unk_ds3_f2_29](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.unk_ds3_f2_29) from doing whatever it is doing, and it can also cause some ugly "outline" effects on things seen through particles, but it also fixes an issue where some other particles can be seen through this particle.
desc.zh-CN:
未知布尔值。

当启用时，它似乎会停止 [unk_ds3_f2_29](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#MultiTextureBillboardEx.unk_ds3_f2_29) 的作用，并且可能会对透过粒子看到的内容产生一些难看的“轮廓”效果，但它也修复了某些其他粒子可以透过此粒子看到的问题。

desc.en-US: Controls how sharp the specular highlights are.
desc.zh-CN: 控制高光亮点的清晰度。

desc.en-US: Controls how the particles are lit. See [LightingMode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LightingMode) for more information.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子的光照方式。有关更多信息，请参阅 [LightingMode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LightingMode)。

desc.en-US:
Defines a particle with a 3D model.

Some models don't work properly with this action for some reason. For example, the Carian greatsword model in Elden Ring (88300), gets horribly stretched and distorted when used with this action. If you find a model like this that you want to use, try using the [RichModel](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel) action instead.

The name is from Elden Ring's RTTI, where it is named "GXFfxAppearanceModel".
desc.zh-CN:
定义一个带有3D模型的粒子。

由于某些原因，某些模型无法与此行为正常配合使用。例如，《艾尔登法环》中的卡利亚大剑模型（88300），在使用此行为时会变得严重拉伸和变形。如果发现一个想用的类似模型，请尝试使用 [RichModel](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel) 行为代替。

该名称来自《艾尔登法环》的RTTI，其中它被命名为“GXFfxAppearanceModel”。

desc.en-US:
The width of the particle.

If [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.uniformScale) is enabled, this also controls the height and depth.
desc.zh-CN:
粒子的宽度。

如果启用了 [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.uniformScale)，这也会控制高度和深度。

desc.en-US:
The height of the particle.

If [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.uniformScale) is enabled, [sizeX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.sizeX) also controls the height, and this property is ignored.
desc.zh-CN:
粒子的高度。

如果启用了 [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.uniformScale)，[sizeX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.sizeX) 也会控制高度，此属性将被忽略。

desc.en-US:
The depth of the particle.

If [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.uniformScale) is enabled, [sizeX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.sizeX) also controls the depth, and this property is ignored.
desc.zh-CN:
粒子的深度。

如果启用了 [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.uniformScale)，[sizeX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.sizeX) 也会控制深度，此属性将被忽略。

desc.en-US: Rotation around the X-axis in degrees.
desc.zh-CN: 绕 X 轴的旋转角度（度）。

desc.en-US: Rotation around the Y-axis in degrees.
desc.zh-CN: 绕 Y 轴的旋转角度（度）。

desc.en-US: Rotation around the Z-axis in degrees.
desc.zh-CN: 绕 Z 轴的旋转角度（度）。

desc.en-US: Angular speed around the X-axis in degrees per second.
desc.zh-CN: 绕 X 轴的角速度（度/秒）。

desc.en-US: Angular speed around the Y-axis in degrees per second.
desc.zh-CN: 绕 Y 轴的角速度（度/秒）。

desc.en-US: Angular speed around the Z-axis in degrees per second.
desc.zh-CN: 绕 Z 轴的角速度（度/秒）。

desc.en-US:
Blend mode.

Note that the materials used by the model may affect how the different blend modes work. Don't expect the blend modes to always work exactly like they do in other types of instances.
desc.zh-CN:
混合模式。

请注意，模型使用的材质可能会影响不同混合模式的工作方式。不要期望混合模式总是像在其他类型的实例中那样完全相同地工作。

desc.en-US:
Color multiplier.

Values in this will be clamped to the 0-1 range. To use values outside of this range, see [color3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.color3).
desc.zh-CN:
颜色乘数。

此处的数值将被限制在 0-1 范围内。要使用超出此范围的值，请参阅 [color3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.color3)。

desc.en-US:
Color multiplier.

Values in this will be clamped to the 0-1 range. There is no equivalent property with unrestricted values based on the emission time of the particle, but [color3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.color3) is still multiplicative with this and can be used to scale the values indirectly.
desc.zh-CN:
颜色乘数。

此处的数值将被限制在 0-1 范围内。虽然没有基于粒子发射时间的不受限制值的等效属性，但 [color3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.color3) 仍可与其相乘，并可用于间接缩放数值。

desc.en-US:
Color multiplier.

Values in this are unrestricted and can go above 1. If you want values to be clamped to the 0-1 range, see [color1](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.color1).
desc.zh-CN:
颜色乘数。

此处的数值不设限，可以超过 1。如果希望将数值限制在 0-1 范围内，请参阅 [color1](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.color1)。
未知 标量 属性。

desc.en-US:
The index of the frame to show from the texture atlas. Can be animated using a [linear property](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PropertyFunction.Linear) or similar.

Seemingly identical to [frameIndexOffset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.frameIndexOffset)? The sum of these two properties is the actual frame index that gets used.
desc.zh-CN:
要从纹理图集中显示的帧索引。可以使用 [线性属性](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PropertyFunction.Linear)或类似属性进行动画处理。

似乎与 [frameIndexOffset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.frameIndexOffset) 相同？这两个属性的总和是实际使用的帧索引。

desc.en-US: Seemingly identical to [frameIndex](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.frameIndex)? The sum of these two properties is the actual frame index that gets used.
desc.zh-CN: 似乎与 [frameIndex](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.frameIndex) 相同？这两个属性的总和是实际使用的帧索引。

desc.en-US:
Horizontal offset for the UV coordinates of the model.

If the texture is an animation sheet that is split up into multiple frames using [columns](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.columns) and/or [totalFrames](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.totalFrames), this property has no effect.
desc.zh-CN:
模型 UV 坐标的水平偏移。

如果纹理是使用 [columns](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.columns) 和/或 [totalFrames](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.totalFrames) 分割成多个帧的动画表，则此属性无效。

desc.en-US:
Vertical offset for the UV coordinates of the model.

If the texture is an animation sheet that is split up into multiple frames using [columns](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.columns) and/or [totalFrames](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.totalFrames), this property has no effect.
desc.zh-CN:
模型 UV 坐标的垂直偏移。

如果纹理是使用 [columns](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.columns) 和/或 [totalFrames](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.totalFrames) 分割成多个帧的动画表，则此属性无效。

desc.en-US:
Horiztonal scroll speed for the model's texture.

If the texture is an animation sheet that is split up into multiple frames using [columns](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.columns) and/or [totalFrames](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.totalFrames), this property has no effect.
desc.zh-CN:
模型纹理的水平滚动速度。

如果纹理是使用 [columns](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.columns) 和/或 [totalFrames](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.totalFrames) 分割成多个帧的动画表，则此属性无效。

desc.en-US:
Vertical scroll speed for the model's texture.

If the texture is an animation sheet that is split up into multiple frames using [columns](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.columns) and/or [totalFrames](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.totalFrames), this property has no effect.
desc.zh-CN:
模型纹理的垂直滚动速度。

如果纹理是使用 [columns](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.columns) 和/或 [totalFrames](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.totalFrames) 分割成多个帧的动画表，则此属性无效。
未知 标量 属性。

desc.en-US: Scalar multiplier for the color that does not affect the alpha. Effectively a brightness multiplier.
desc.zh-CN: 不影响 Alpha 的颜色标量乘数。实际上是亮度乘数。
未知 标量 属性。
未知 四维向量 属性。
未知 四维向量 属性。
未知 四维向量 属性。
未知 标量 属性。
未知 标量 属性。

desc.en-US: Model orientation mode. See [ModelOrientationMode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ModelOrientationMode) for more information.
desc.zh-CN: 模型朝向模式。有关更多信息，请参阅 [ModelOrientationMode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ModelOrientationMode)。

desc.en-US:
Each particle will pick a random number between this value and 1, and the width of the particle will be multiplied by this number. For example, setting this to 0.5 will make the particles randomly thinner, down to half width. Setting it to 2 will make them randomly wider, up to double width.

If [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.uniformScale) is enabled, this also affects the height.
desc.zh-CN:
每个粒子将在此值和 1 之间选取一个随机数，粒子的宽度将乘以该数。例如，将其设置为 0.5 将使粒子随机变细，最细为一半宽度。将其设置为 2 将使它们随机变宽，最宽为两倍宽度。

如果启用了 [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.uniformScale)，这也会影响高度。

desc.en-US:
Each particle will pick a random number between this value and 1, and the height of the particle will be multiplied by this number. For example, setting this to 0.5 will make the particles randomly shorter, down to half height. Setting it to 2 will make them randomly taller, up to double height.

If [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.uniformScale) is enabled, [scaleVariationX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.scaleVariationX) also affects the height, and this field is ignored.
desc.zh-CN:
每个粒子将在此值和 1 之间选取一个随机数，粒子的高度将乘以该数。例如，将其设置为 0.5 将使粒子随机变矮，最矮为一半高度。将其设置为 2 将使它们随机变高，最高为两倍高度。

如果启用了 [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.uniformScale)，[scaleVariationX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.scaleVariationX) 也会影响高度，此字段将被忽略。

desc.en-US:
Each particle will pick a random number between this value and 1, and the depth of the particle will be multiplied by this number. For example, setting this to 0.5 will make the particles randomly shallower, down to half depth. Setting it to 2 will make them randomly deeper, up to double depth. 

If [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.uniformScale) is enabled, [scaleVariationX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.scaleVariationX) also affects the depth, and this field is ignored.
desc.zh-CN:
每个粒子将在此值和 1 之间选取一个随机数，粒子的深度将乘以该数。例如，将其设置为 0.5 将使粒子随机变浅，最浅为一半深度。将其设置为 2 将使它们随机变深，最深为两倍深度。

如果启用了 [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.uniformScale)，[scaleVariationX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.scaleVariationX) 也会影响深度，此字段将被忽略。

desc.en-US: If enabled, the particle X scale-related properties and fields will control the scale in all axes, and the Y and Z counterparts will be ignored.
desc.zh-CN: 如果启用，粒子 X 轴缩放相关的属性和字段将控制所有轴的缩放，Y 和 Z 轴对应的属性将被忽略。

desc.en-US: To split the texture into multiple animation frames, this value must be set to the number of columns in the texture. It should equal `textureWidth / frameWidth`.
desc.zh-CN: 要将纹理分割成多个动画帧，必须将此值设置为纹理中的列数。它应等于 `textureWidth / frameWidth`。

desc.en-US: To split the texture into multiple animation frames, this value must be set to the total number of frames in the texture.
desc.zh-CN: 要将纹理分割成多个动画帧，必须将此值设置为纹理中的总帧数。

desc.en-US: Controls which animation in the [anibnd](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.anibnd) to play.
desc.zh-CN: 控制播放 [anibnd](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.anibnd) 中的哪个动画。

desc.en-US: If disabled, the [animation](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.animation) will only play once and then freeze on the last frame. If enabled, the animation will loop.
desc.zh-CN: 如果禁用，[animation](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.animation) 只会播放一次，然后冻结在最后一帧。如果启用，动画将循环播放。

desc.en-US: Controls the speed at which the [animation](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.animation) plays.

Controls the color of the additional bloom effect. The colors of the particle will be multiplied with this color to get the final color of the bloom effect.

Note:
- This has no effect if the "Effects Quality" setting is set to "Low".
- This does not affect the natural bloom effect from high color values.
desc.zh-CN:
控制额外泛光效果的颜色。粒子的颜色将与此颜色相乘，以获得泛光效果的最终颜色。

注意：
- 如果“特效质量”设置设为“低”，则此项无效。
- 这不影响高颜色值产生的自然泛光效果。

desc.en-US:
This controls a point where the opacity of a particle will start to fade to 0 near the [minimum view distance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.minDistance). At [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.minDistance), the opacity will be 0, and it will linearly approach 1 as the distance between the camera and the particle approaches this distance.

This requires [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.minDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0. This distance limit can be disabled by setting this and minDistance to -1.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子不透明度开始在 [最小视图距离](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.minDistance) 附近衰减为 0 的点。在 [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.minDistance) 处，不透明度为 0，随着摄像机与粒子之间的距离接近此距离，不透明度将线性接近 1。

这要求 [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.minDistance) 设置为正值或 0。可以通过将此值和 minDistance 设置为 -1 来禁用此距离限制。

desc.en-US:
Minimum view distance. If a particle is closer than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.

This requires [minFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.minFadeDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0.

This is different from [minDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.minDistanceThreshold), as this controls the start of a distance range that has smooth transitions at each end, while the threshold value is a hard cut-off.

这要求 [minFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.minFadeDistance) 设置为正值或 0。

这与 [minDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.minDistanceThreshold) 不同，因为此项控制的是两端具有平滑过渡的距离范围的起点，而阈值是硬性截止。

desc.en-US:
This controls a point where the opacity of a particle will start to fade to 0 near the [maximum view distance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.maxDistance). At [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.maxDistance), the opacity will be 0, and it will linearly approach 1 as the distance between the camera and the particle approaches this distance.

This requires [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.maxDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0. This distance limit can be disabled by setting this and maxDistance to -1.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子不透明度开始在 [最大视图距离](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.maxDistance) 附近衰减为 0 的点。在 [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.maxDistance) 处，不透明度为 0，随着摄像机与粒子之间的距离接近此距离，不透明度将线性接近 1。

这要求 [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.maxDistance) 设置为正值或 0。可以通过将此值和 maxDistance 设置为 -1 来禁用此距离限制。

desc.en-US:
Minimum view distance. If a particle is farther away than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.

This requires [maxFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.maxFadeDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0.

This is different from [maxDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model.maxDistanceThreshold), as this controls the start of a distance range that has smooth transitions at each end, while the threshold value is a hard cut-off.

desc.en-US: A hard cut-off point for the distance between the camera and the particle. If a particle is closer than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 摄像机与粒子之间距离的硬性截止点。如果粒子与摄像机的距离小于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US: A hard cut-off point for the distance between the camera and the particle. If a particle is farther away than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 摄像机与粒子之间距离的硬性截止点。如果粒子与摄像机的距离大于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US:
Unknown boolean.

When enabled, it can cause some ugly "outline" effects on things seen through particles.
desc.zh-CN:
未知布尔值。

当启用时，可能会对透过粒子看到的内容产生一些难看的“轮廓”效果。

desc.en-US:
Defines a tracer particle, which leaves a textured trail where it moves.

This is an older version of [Tracer](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer) with fewer features.

The name is from Elden Ring's RTTI, where it is named "GXFXCGAppearanceTracer".
desc.zh-CN:
定义一个追踪粒子，它会在移动时留下纹理轨迹。

这是 [Tracer](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer) 的旧版本，功能较少。

该名称来自《艾尔登法环》的 RTTI，其中它被命名为“GXFXCGAppearanceTracer”。

desc.en-US:
Percentage along the trail from the start of the trail where the trail's opacity will start fading out towards the start. The trail will have 0 opacity at the start, and it will linearly increase towards full opacity at the point represented by this percentage.

The percentage is of the way from the start of the trail to the end of it, so if the trail gets longer or shorter, this point will move with it.

Values greater than 100 will make the trail never reach full opacity. For example, a value of 200 will make the trail fade from 0 opacity at the start to 50% (100% / 200%) at the end of the trail.

If this value and [endFadeEndpoint](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.endFadeEndpoint) sum to a value greater than 100, the trail will be "split" at the point controlled by this value and each part will fade separately based on the repsective value. For example, if this is set to 50 and [endFadeEndpoint](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.endFadeEndpoint) is 1000, the first half of the trail will fade normally from 0 opacity at the start to full opacity at the mid point, but the other half will fade from 5% opacity ((100% - 50%) / 1000%) at the mid point to 0 at the end. Where the two parts meet, the opacity will fade from one to the other across a single segment of the trail.
desc.zh-CN:
沿拖尾从起点开始的百分比，拖尾的不透明度将在此处开始向起点衰减。拖尾在起点的透明度为 0，并将在该百分比代表的点线性增加到完全不透明。

该百分比是从拖尾起点到终点的路程，因此如果拖尾变长或变短，该点也会随之移动。

大于 100 的值将使拖尾永远无法达到完全不透明。例如，值为 200 将使拖尾从起点的 0 不透明度淡化到终点的 50% (100% / 200%)。

如果此值与 [endFadeEndpoint](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.endFadeEndpoint) 之和大于 100，拖尾将在此值控制的点处“分裂”，每部分将根据各自的值单独衰减。例如，如果此值设置为 50 而 [endFadeEndpoint](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.endFadeEndpoint) 为 1000，则拖尾的前半部分将正常地从起点的 0 不透明度淡化到中点的完全不透明，但另一半将从中点的 5% 不透明度 ((100% - 50%) / 1000%) 淡化到终点的 0。在两部分相遇的地方，不透明度将在拖尾的单个段上从一个过渡到另一个。

desc.en-US:
Percentage along the trail from the end of the trail where the trail's opacity will start fading out towards the end. The trail will have full opacity at the point represented by this percentage, and it will linearly decrease towards 0 opacity at the end.

The percentage is of the way from the end of the trail to the start of it, so if the trail gets longer or shorter, this point will move with it.

Values greater than 100 will make the trail never reach full opacity. For example, a value of 200 will make the trail fade from 0 opacity at the end to 50% (100% / 200%) at the start of the trail.

If this value and [startFadeEndpoint](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.startFadeEndpoint) sum to a value greater than 100, the trail will be "split" at the point controlled by [startFadeEndpoint](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.startFadeEndpoint) and each part will fade separately based on the repsective value. For example, if [startFadeEndpoint](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.startFadeEndpoint) is set to 50 and this is 1000, the first half of the trail will fade normally from 0 opacity at the start to full opacity at the mid point, but the other half will fade from 5% opacity ((100% - 50%) / 1000%) at the mid point to 0 at the end. Where the two parts meet, the opacity will fade from one to the other across a single segment of the trail.
desc.zh-CN:
沿拖尾从终点开始的百分比，拖尾的不透明度将在此处开始向终点衰减。拖尾在该百分比代表的点处将完全不透明，并在终点处线性减少到 0 不透明度。

该百分比是从拖尾终点到起点的路程，因此如果拖尾变长或变短，该点也会随之移动。

大于 100 的值将使拖尾永远无法达到完全不透明。例如，值为 200 将使拖尾从终点的 0 不透明度淡化到起点的 50% (100% / 200%)。

如果此值与 [startFadeEndpoint](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.startFadeEndpoint) 之和大于 100，拖尾将在 [startFadeEndpoint](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.startFadeEndpoint) 控制的点处“分裂”，每部分将根据各自的值单独衰减。例如，如果 [startFadeEndpoint](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.startFadeEndpoint) 设置为 50 而此值为 1000，则拖尾的前半部分将正常地从起点的 0 不透明度淡化到中点的完全不透明，但另一半将从中点的 5% 不透明度 ((100% - 50%) / 1000%) 淡化到终点的 0。在两部分相遇的地方，不透明度将在拖尾的单个段上从一个过渡到另一个。

desc.en-US:
Color multiplier.

Values in this will be clamped to the 0-1 range. To use values outside of this range, see [color3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.color3).
desc.zh-CN:
颜色乘数。

此处的数值将被限制在 0-1 范围内。要使用超出此范围的值，请参阅 [color3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.color3)。

desc.en-US:
Color multiplier.

Values in this will be clamped to the 0-1 range. There is no equivalent property with unrestricted values based on the emission time of the particle, but [color3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.color3) is still multiplicative with this and can be used to scale the values indirectly.
desc.zh-CN:
颜色乘数。

此处的数值将被限制在 0-1 范围内。虽然没有基于粒子发射时间的不受限制值的等效属性，但 [color3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.color3) 仍可与其相乘，并可用于间接缩放数值。

desc.en-US:
Color multiplier.

Values in this are unrestricted and can go above 1. If you want values to be clamped to the 0-1 range, see [color1](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.color1).
desc.zh-CN:
颜色乘数。

此处的数值不设限，可以超过 1。如果希望将数值限制在 0-1 范围内，请参阅 [color1](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.color1)。

desc.en-US:
Parts of the particle with less opacity than this threshold will be invisible. The range is 0-255.

Values above this threshold will be stretched to fill the alpha range, so values near the threshold will be less visible, creating a smooth transition between the parts that have been hidden by the threshold and the ones that are still visible.
desc.zh-CN:
不透明度低于此阈值的粒子部分将不可见。范围是 0-255。

高于此阈值的值将被拉伸以填充 Alpha 范围，因此接近阈值的值将不太明显，从而在被阈值隐藏的部分和仍然可见的部分之间创建平滑过渡。

desc.en-US:
The index of the frame to show from the texture atlas. Can be animated using a [linear property](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PropertyFunction.Linear) or similar.

Seemingly identical to [frameIndexOffset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.frameIndexOffset)? The sum of these two properties is the actual frame index that gets used.
desc.zh-CN:
要从纹理图集中显示的帧索引。可以使用 [线性属性](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PropertyFunction.Linear)或类似属性进行动画处理。

似乎与 [frameIndexOffset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.frameIndexOffset) 相同？这两个属性的总和是实际使用的帧索引。

desc.en-US: Seemingly identical to [frameIndex](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.frameIndex)? The sum of these two properties is the actual frame index that gets used.
desc.zh-CN: 似乎与 [frameIndex](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.frameIndex) 相同？这两个属性的总和是实际使用的帧索引。

desc.en-US: Controls how much of the texture's width is used per segment. If [attachedUV](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.attachedUV) is enabled, this instead controls how much of the texture's width to use for the entire trail.
desc.zh-CN: 控制每一段使用的纹理宽度比例。如果启用了 [attachedUV](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.attachedUV)，则改为控制整个拖尾使用的纹理宽度比例。

desc.en-US: Controls how fast the UV coordinates should move horizontally.
desc.zh-CN: 控制 UV 坐标水平移动的速度。

desc.en-US: Controls how much the UV coordinates should be randomly offset by per segment.
desc.zh-CN: 控制每段 UV 坐标随机偏移的量。
未知 标量 属性。

desc.en-US: Scalar multiplier for the color that does not affect the alpha. Effectively a brightness multiplier.
desc.zh-CN: 不影响 Alpha 的颜色标量乘数。实际上是亮度乘数。

desc.en-US: Controls the intensity of the distortion effect. At 0, there is no distortion at all.
desc.zh-CN: 控制扭曲效果的强度。为 0 时，完全没有扭曲。
未知 四维向量 属性。
未知 四维向量 属性。
未知 四维向量 属性。

desc.en-US:
Parts of the particle with less opacity than this threshold will be invisible. The range is 0-255.

This threshold creates a hard cut-off between visible and not visible, which is unlike the [alphaFadeThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.alphaFadeThreshold).
desc.zh-CN:
不透明度低于此阈值的粒子部分将不可见。范围是 0-255。

此阈值在可见和不可见之间创建一个硬性截止，这与 [alphaFadeThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.alphaFadeThreshold) 不同。

desc.en-US: Tracer orientation mode. See [TracerOrientationMode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TracerOrientationMode) for more information.
desc.zh-CN: 拖尾朝向模式。有关更多信息，请参阅 [TracerOrientationMode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TracerOrientationMode)。

desc.en-US:
Normal map texture ID.

This is used to control the distortion effect of the trail.
desc.zh-CN:
法线贴图纹理 ID。

这用于控制拖尾的扭曲效果。

desc.en-US: The trail is made up of multiple quads, or *segments*. This controls how many seconds to wait between new segments being created. Lower values produce a smoother trail.
desc.zh-CN: 拖尾由多个四边形或*段*组成。此项控制创建新段之间等待的秒数。较低的值会产生更平滑的拖尾。

desc.en-US: The trail is made up of multiple quads, or *segments*. This controls how long each segment should last in seconds.
desc.zh-CN: 拖尾由多个四边形或*段*组成。此项控制每个段应持续的秒数。

desc.en-US: The trail is made up of multiple quads, or *segments*. This controls how many segments may exist at the same time.
desc.zh-CN: 拖尾由多个四边形或*段*组成。此项控制同一时间可能存在的段数。

desc.en-US:
The trail is made up of multiple quads, or *segments*. This controls how many times each completed segment should be subdivided. Higher values makes the trail look smoother.

A "completed" segment is any segment that is not the leading one. The leading segment has one side attached to the end of the previous segment and the other attached to the tracer source, and is always a simple quad.
desc.zh-CN:
拖尾由多个四边形或*段*组成。此项控制每个完成的段应细分的次数。较高的值使拖尾看起来更平滑。

“完成”的段是指除引导段以外的任何段。引导段的一侧连接到前一段的末端，另一侧连接到拖尾源，并且始终是一个简单的四边形。

desc.en-US: When the particle is meant to terminate, the trail will linger for this many seconds and its opacity will fade to 0 in that time.
desc.zh-CN: 当粒子即将终止时，拖尾将停留这么多秒，并且其不透明度将在这段时间内衰减为 0。

desc.en-US: To split the texture into multiple animation frames, this value must be set to the number of columns in the texture. It should equal `textureWidth / frameWidth`.
desc.zh-CN: 要将纹理分割成多个动画帧，必须将此值设置为纹理中的列数。它应等于 `textureWidth / frameWidth`。

desc.en-US: To split the texture into multiple animation frames, this value must be set to the total number of frames in the texture.
desc.zh-CN: 要将纹理分割成多个动画帧，必须将此值设置为纹理中的总帧数。

desc.en-US: Controls whether or not the UV of the trail should be attached to the node or not. If it is attached, the texture will slide along the segments to follow the source wherever it moves, as if it was a flag attached to a pole. If it is not attached, the texture will stay where it was when the segment was created, like a skid mark on a road where the road is the segments and the mark is the texture, it wouldn't follow the car/node that made it.
desc.zh-CN: 控制拖尾的 UV 是否应附着到节点。如果附着，纹理将沿着段滑动以跟随源的移动，就像旗帜附着在旗杆上一样。如果不附着，纹理将停留在创建段时的位置，就像道路上的刹车痕迹，道路是段，痕迹是纹理，它不会跟随制造它的汽车/节点。
未知整数。可能是布尔值？

desc.en-US:
Controls whether or not the particles have an additional bloom effect controlled by [bloomColor](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.bloomColor).

When enabled, this also allows bloom from other particles to be seen through this particle.

Note:
- This has no effect if the "Effects Quality" setting is set to "Low".
- This does not affect the natural bloom effect from high color values.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子是否具有由 [bloomColor](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.bloomColor) 控制的额外泛光效果。

启用时，这也允许透过此粒子看到其他粒子的泛光。

注意：
- 如果“特效质量”设置设为“低”，则此项无效。
- 这不影响高颜色值产生的自然泛光效果。

desc.en-US:
Controls the color of the additional bloom effect. The colors of the particle will be multiplied with this color to get the final color of the bloom effect.

Note:
- This has no effect if the "Effects Quality" setting is set to "Low".
- This does not affect the natural bloom effect from high color values.
desc.zh-CN:
控制额外泛光效果的颜色。粒子的颜色将与此颜色相乘，以获得泛光效果的最终颜色。

注意：
- 如果“特效质量”设置设为“低”，则此项无效。
- 这不影响高颜色值产生的自然泛光效果。

desc.en-US:
This controls a point where the opacity of a particle will start to fade to 0 near the [minimum view distance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.minDistance). At [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.minDistance), the opacity will be 0, and it will linearly approach 1 as the distance between the camera and the particle approaches this distance.

This requires [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.minDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0. This distance limit can be disabled by setting this and minDistance to -1.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子不透明度开始在 [最小视图距离](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.minDistance) 附近衰减为 0 的点。在 [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.minDistance) 处，不透明度为 0，随着摄像机与粒子之间的距离接近此距离，不透明度将线性接近 1。

这要求 [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.minDistance) 设置为正值或 0。可以通过将此值和 minDistance 设置为 -1 来禁用此距离限制。

desc.en-US:
Minimum view distance. If a particle is closer than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.

This requires [minFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.minFadeDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0.

This is different from [minDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.minDistanceThreshold), as this controls the start of a distance range that has smooth transitions at each end, while the threshold value is a hard cut-off.
desc.zh-CN:
最小视图距离。如果粒子与摄像机的距离小于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

这要求 [minFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.minFadeDistance) 设置为正值或 0。

这与 [minDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.minDistanceThreshold) 不同，因为此项控制的是两端具有平滑过渡的距离范围的起点，而阈值是硬性截止。

desc.en-US:
This controls a point where the opacity of a particle will start to fade to 0 near the [maximum view distance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.maxDistance). At [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.maxDistance), the opacity will be 0, and it will linearly approach 1 as the distance between the camera and the particle approaches this distance.

This requires [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.maxDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0. This distance limit can be disabled by setting this and maxDistance to -1.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子不透明度开始在 [最大视图距离](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.maxDistance) 附近衰减为 0 的点。在 [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.maxDistance) 处，不透明度为 0，随着摄像机与粒子之间的距离接近此距离，不透明度将线性接近 1。

这要求 [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.maxDistance) 设置为正值或 0。可以通过将此值和 maxDistance 设置为 -1 来禁用此距离限制。

desc.en-US:
Minimum view distance. If a particle is farther away than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.

This requires [maxFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.maxFadeDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0.

This is different from [maxDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.maxDistanceThreshold), as this controls the start of a distance range that has smooth transitions at each end, while the threshold value is a hard cut-off.
desc.zh-CN:
最小视图距离。如果粒子与摄像机的距离大于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

这要求 [maxFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.maxFadeDistance) 设置为正值或 0。

这与 [maxDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.maxDistanceThreshold) 不同，因为此项控制的是两端具有平滑过渡的距离范围的起点，而阈值是硬性截止。

desc.en-US: A hard cut-off point for the distance between the camera and the particle. If a particle is closer than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 摄像机与粒子之间距离的硬性截止点。如果粒子与摄像机的距离小于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US: A hard cut-off point for the distance between the camera and the particle. If a particle is farther away than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 摄像机与粒子之间距离的硬性截止点。如果粒子与摄像机的距离大于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US: If enabled, the texture's color will be multiplied by its alpha value, making more transparent parts of the texture darker.
desc.zh-CN: 如果启用，纹理的颜色将乘以其 Alpha 值，使纹理更透明的部分变暗。

desc.en-US:
Unknown float.

This seems to be some sort of distance threshold. When the camera is within this distance, some things will look different in some ways. For example, when within the distance and the [blend mode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.blendMode) is set to [BlendMode.Subtract](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BlendMode.Subtract), the opacity doesn't work the way it normally does. Other effects have been found as well, but what exactly this threshold is for is unknown.
desc.zh-CN:
未知浮点数。

这似乎是某种距离阈值。当摄像机在此距离内时，某些东西看起来会有所不同。例如，当在距离内且 [混合模式](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.blendMode) 设置为 [减去](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BlendMode.Subtract) 时，不透明度不会按正常方式工作。还发现了其他影响，但此阈值的具体作用未知。

desc.en-US: Controls how dark shaded parts of the trail are.
desc.zh-CN: 控制拖尾阴影部分的暗度。

desc.en-US:
Unknown boolean.

When enabled, it seems to stop [unk_ds3_f2_29](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.unk_ds3_f2_29) from doing whatever it is doing, and it can also cause some ugly "outline" effects on things seen through particles, but it also fixes an issue where some other particles can be seen through this particle.
desc.zh-CN:
未知布尔值。

当启用时，它似乎会停止 [unk_ds3_f2_29](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer.unk_ds3_f2_29) 的作用，并且可能会对透过粒子看到的内容产生一些难看的“轮廓”效果，但它也修复了某些其他粒子可以透过此粒子看到的问题。

desc.en-US: Controls how sharp the specular highlights are.
desc.zh-CN: 控制高光亮点的清晰度。

desc.en-US: Controls how the trail is lit. See [LightingMode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LightingMode) for more information.
desc.zh-CN: 控制拖尾的光照方式。有关更多信息，请参阅 [LightingMode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LightingMode)。

desc.en-US: Controls how bright the specular highlights are.

Defines a particle that distorts anything seen through it.

Note: This particle is not visible if the "Effects" setting is set to "Low".

The name is from Elden Ring's RTTI, where it is named "GXFfxAppearanceDistortion".
desc.zh-CN:
定义一个粒子，它会对透过它看到的任何物体应用扭曲。

注意：如果“效果”设置为“低”，则此粒子不可见。

该名称来自《艾尔登法环》的 RTTI，其中它被命名为 "GXFfxAppearanceDistortion"。

desc.en-US:
The width of the particle.

If [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.uniformScale) is enabled, this also controls the height and depth.
desc.zh-CN:
粒子的宽度。

如果启用了 [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.uniformScale)，这也会控制高度和深度。

desc.en-US:
The height of the particle.

If [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.uniformScale) is enabled, [sizeX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.sizeX) also controls the height, and this property is ignored.
desc.zh-CN:
粒子的高度。

如果启用了 [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.uniformScale)，[sizeX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.sizeX) 也会控制高度，此属性将被忽略。

desc.en-US:
The depth of the particle.

If [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.uniformScale) is enabled, [sizeX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.sizeX) also controls the depth, and this property is ignored.

If the distortion [shape](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.shape) is set to [Rectangle](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#DistortionShape.Rectangle), this property won't have any effect since the rectangle is 2-dimensional.
desc.zh-CN:
粒子的深度。

如果启用了 [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.uniformScale)，[sizeX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.sizeX) 也会控制深度，此属性将被忽略。

如果扭曲 [形状](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.shape) 设置为 [矩形](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#DistortionShape.Rectangle)，此属性将不会产生任何效果，因为矩形是二维的。

desc.en-US:
Color multiplier.

Values in this will be clamped to the 0-1 range. There are no unrestricted color properties in this action, but [rgbMultiplier](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.rgbMultiplier) and [alphaMultiplier](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.alphaMultiplier) can be used to scale the colors.
desc.zh-CN:
颜色乘数。

此处的数值将被限制在 0-1 范围内。此动作中没有不受限制的颜色属性，但可以使用 [rgbMultiplier](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.rgbMultiplier) 和 [alphaMultiplier](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.alphaMultiplier) 来缩放颜色。
未知 四维向量 属性。

desc.en-US: Controls the intensity of the distortion effect. At 0, there is no distortion at all.
desc.zh-CN: 控制扭曲效果的强度。为 0 时，完全没有扭曲。
未知 标量 属性。

desc.en-US: Controls the speed of the stirring effect in degrees per second. Requires [mode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.mode) to be set to [DistortionMode.Stir](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#DistortionMode.Stir).
desc.zh-CN: 控制搅动效果的速度（度/秒）。需要将 [mode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.mode) 设置为 [DistortionMode.Stir](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#DistortionMode.Stir)。

desc.en-US: The distortion effect is only applied to an ellipse inside the particle. This property controls how large this ellipse is. At 1, it inscribes the particle's rectangle. At values greater than 1, it is the same size as 1, but there might be strange artifacts around the edges of the distortion.
desc.zh-CN: 扭曲效果仅应用于粒子内部的一个椭圆。此属性控制该椭圆的大小。为 1 时，它内切于粒子的矩形。值大于 1 时，其大小与 1 相同，但扭曲边缘可能会出现奇怪的伪影。
[法线贴图](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.normalMap)的水平 UV 偏移。
[法线贴图](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.normalMap)的垂直 UV 偏移。

desc.en-US: Horizontal UV offset speed for the [normal map](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.normalMap).
desc.zh-CN: [法线贴图](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.normalMap)的水平 UV 偏移速度。

desc.en-US: Vertical UV offset speed for the [normal map](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.normalMap).
desc.zh-CN: [法线贴图](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.normalMap)的垂直 UV 偏移速度。

desc.en-US: Scalar multiplier for the color that does not affect the alpha. Effectively a brightness multiplier.
desc.zh-CN: 不影响 Alpha 的颜色标量乘数。实际上是亮度乘数。
未知 标量 属性。
未知 四维向量 属性。
未知 四维向量 属性。
未知 四维向量 属性。

desc.en-US:
Parts of the particle with less opacity than this threshold will be invisible. The range is 0-255.

This threshold creates a hard cut-off between visible and not visible, which is unlike the alpha *fade* threshold properties in some similar actions.
desc.zh-CN:
不透明度低于此阈值的粒子部分将不可见。范围是 0-255。

此阈值在可见和不可见之间创建一个硬性截止，这与某些类似动作中的 alpha *淡入淡出* 阈值属性不同。
[法线贴图](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.normalMap)的水平 UV 缩放。
[法线贴图](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.normalMap)的垂直 UV 缩放。

desc.en-US: Controls what type of distortion to apply. See [DistortionMode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#DistortionMode) for more details.
desc.zh-CN: 控制应用的扭曲类型。有关更多详细信息，请参阅 [DistortionMode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#DistortionMode)。

desc.en-US: Controls the shape of the particle. See [DistortionShape](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#DistortionShape) for more information.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子的形状。有关更多信息，请参阅 [DistortionShape](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#DistortionShape)。

desc.en-US: Controls the orientation mode for the particles. See [OrientationMode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#OrientationMode) for more information.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子的朝向模式。有关更多信息，请参阅 [OrientationMode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#OrientationMode)。

desc.en-US:
Texture ID.

This texture seems to completely hide the distortion effect. It's probably best to just leave it at 0 unless you are trying to figure out how to use it properly.
desc.zh-CN:
纹理 ID。

此纹理似乎会完全隐藏扭曲效果。除非你想弄清楚如何正确使用它，否则最好将其保留为 0。

desc.en-US:
Normal map texture ID.

Only used if the distortion [mode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.mode) is set to something that uses it.
desc.zh-CN:
法线贴图纹理 ID。

仅当扭曲 [模式](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.mode) 设置为使用它的内容时才使用。

desc.en-US: Mask texture ID. This texture is used to control the color and opacity of the particle.
desc.zh-CN: 遮罩纹理 ID。此纹理用于控制粒子的颜色和不透明度。

desc.en-US:
Each particle will pick a random number between this value and 1, and the width of the particle will be multiplied by this number. For example, setting this to 0.5 will make the particles randomly thinner, down to half width. Setting it to 2 will make them randomly wider, up to double width.

If [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.uniformScale) is enabled, this also affects the height.
desc.zh-CN:
每个粒子将在此值和 1 之间选取一个随机数，粒子的宽度将乘以该数。例如，将其设置为 0.5 将使粒子随机变细，最细为一半宽度。将其设置为 2 将使它们随机变宽，最宽为两倍宽度。

如果启用了 [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.uniformScale)，这也会影响高度。

desc.en-US:
Each particle will pick a random number between this value and 1, and the height of the particle will be multiplied by this number. For example, setting this to 0.5 will make the particles randomly shorter, down to half height. Setting it to 2 will make them randomly taller, up to double height.

If [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.uniformScale) is enabled, [scaleVariationX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.scaleVariationX) also affects the height, and this field is ignored.
desc.zh-CN:
每个粒子将在此值和 1 之间选取一个随机数，粒子的高度将乘以该数。例如，将其设置为 0.5 将使粒子随机变矮，最矮为一半高度。将其设置为 2 将使它们随机变高，最高为两倍高度。

如果启用了 [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.uniformScale)，[scaleVariationX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.scaleVariationX) 也会影响高度，此字段将被忽略。

desc.en-US:
Each particle will pick a random number between this value and 1, and the depth of the particle will be multiplied by this number. For example, setting this to 0.5 will make the particles randomly shallower, down to half depth. Setting it to 2 will make them randomly deeper, up to double depth. 

If [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.uniformScale) is enabled, [scaleVariationX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.scaleVariationX) also affects the depth, and this field is ignored.
desc.zh-CN:
每个粒子将在此值和 1 之间选取一个随机数，粒子的深度将乘以该数。例如，将其设置为 0.5 将使粒子随机变浅，最浅为一半深度。将其设置为 2 将使它们随机变深，最深为两倍深度。

如果启用了 [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.uniformScale)，[scaleVariationX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.scaleVariationX) 也会影响深度，此字段将被忽略。

desc.en-US: If enabled, the particle X scale-related properties and fields will control the scale in all axes, and the Y and Z counterparts will be ignored.
desc.zh-CN: 如果启用，粒子 X 轴缩放相关的属性和字段将控制所有轴的缩放，Y 和 Z 轴对应的属性将被忽略。

desc.en-US:
Controls the color of the additional bloom effect. The colors of the particle will be multiplied with this color to get the final color of the bloom effect.

Note:
- This has no effect if the "Effects Quality" setting is set to "Low".
- This does not affect the natural bloom effect from high color values.
desc.zh-CN:
控制额外泛光效果的颜色。粒子的颜色将与此颜色相乘，以获得泛光效果的最终颜色。

注意：
- 如果“特效质量”设置设为“低”，则此项无效。
- 这不影响高颜色值产生的自然泛光效果。

desc.en-US:
This controls a point where the opacity of a particle will start to fade to 0 near the [minimum view distance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.minDistance). At [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.minDistance), the opacity will be 0, and it will linearly approach 1 as the distance between the camera and the particle approaches this distance.

This requires [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.minDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0. This distance limit can be disabled by setting this and minDistance to -1.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子不透明度开始在 [最小视图距离](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.minDistance) 附近衰减为 0 的点。在 [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.minDistance) 处，不透明度为 0，随着摄像机与粒子之间的距离接近此距离，不透明度将线性接近 1。

这要求 [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.minDistance) 设置为正值或 0。可以通过将此值和 minDistance 设置为 -1 来禁用此距离限制。

desc.en-US:
Minimum view distance. If a particle is closer than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.

This requires [minFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.minFadeDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0.

This is different from [minDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.minDistanceThreshold), as this controls the start of a distance range that has smooth transitions at each end, while the threshold value is a hard cut-off.
desc.zh-CN:
最小视图距离。如果粒子与摄像机的距离小于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

这要求 [minFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.minFadeDistance) 设置为正值或 0。

这与 [minDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.minDistanceThreshold) 不同，因为此项控制的是两端具有平滑过渡的距离范围的起点，而阈值是硬性截止。

desc.en-US:
This controls a point where the opacity of a particle will start to fade to 0 near the [maximum view distance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.maxDistance). At [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.maxDistance), the opacity will be 0, and it will linearly approach 1 as the distance between the camera and the particle approaches this distance.

This requires [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.maxDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0. This distance limit can be disabled by setting this and maxDistance to -1.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子不透明度开始在 [最大视图距离](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.maxDistance) 附近衰减为 0 的点。在 [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.maxDistance) 处，不透明度为 0，随着摄像机与粒子之间的距离接近此距离，不透明度将线性接近 1。

这要求 [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.maxDistance) 设置为正值或 0。可以通过将此值和 maxDistance 设置为 -1 来禁用此距离限制。

desc.en-US:
Minimum view distance. If a particle is farther away than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.

This requires [maxFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.maxFadeDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0.

This is different from [maxDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.maxDistanceThreshold), as this controls the start of a distance range that has smooth transitions at each end, while the threshold value is a hard cut-off.
desc.zh-CN:
最小视图距离。如果粒子与摄像机的距离大于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

这要求 [maxFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.maxFadeDistance) 设置为正值或 0。

这与 [maxDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Distortion.maxDistanceThreshold) 不同，因为此项控制的是两端具有平滑过渡的距离范围的起点，而阈值是硬性截止。

desc.en-US: A hard cut-off point for the distance between the camera and the particle. If a particle is closer than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 摄像机与粒子之间距离的硬性截止点。如果粒子与摄像机的距离小于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US: A hard cut-off point for the distance between the camera and the particle. If a particle is farther away than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 摄像机与粒子之间距离的硬性截止点。如果粒子与摄像机的距离大于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US:
Unknown float.

This seems to be something distance or depth-related. It's using the same length units as everything else (meters), and seems to be some sort of threshold or maybe offset for something. When the camera is within this distance from the node, the distortion will also affect other particles seen through it.
desc.zh-CN:
未知浮点数。

这似乎与距离或深度有关。它使用与其他所有内容相同的长度单位（米），并且似乎是某种阈值或偏移量。当摄像机与节点的距离在此范围内时，扭曲也会影响透过它看到的其他粒子。

desc.en-US:
Defines a particle that applies a radial blur to anything seen through it.

Note: This particle is not visible if the "Effects" setting is set to "Low".

The name is from Elden Ring's RTTI, where it is named "GXFXCGAppearanceRadialBlur".
desc.zh-CN:
定义一个粒子，它会对透过它看到的任何物体应用径向模糊。

注意：如果“效果”设置为“低”，则此粒子不可见。

该名称来自《艾尔登法环》的 RTTI，其中名称为“GXFXCGAppearanceRadialBlur”。

desc.en-US: Mask texture ID. This texture is used to control the opacity of the particle.
desc.zh-CN: 遮罩纹理 ID。此纹理用于控制粒子的不透明度。

desc.en-US:
The width of the particle.

If [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RadialBlur.uniformScale) is enabled, this also controls the height.
desc.zh-CN:
粒子的宽度。

如果启用了 [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RadialBlur.uniformScale)，这也会控制高度。

desc.en-US:
The height of the particle.

If [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RadialBlur.uniformScale) is enabled, [width](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RadialBlur.width) also controls the height, and this property is ignored.
desc.zh-CN:
粒子的高度。

如果启用了 [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RadialBlur.uniformScale)，[width](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RadialBlur.width) 也会控制高度，此属性将被忽略。

desc.en-US:
Color multiplier.

Values in this will be clamped to the 0-1 range. There are no unrestricted color properties in this action, but [rgbMultiplier](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RadialBlur.rgbMultiplier) and [alphaMultiplier](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RadialBlur.alphaMultiplier) can be used to scale the colors.
desc.zh-CN:
颜色乘数。

此处的数值将被限制在 0-1 范围内。此动作中没有不受限制的颜色属性，但可以使用 [rgbMultiplier](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RadialBlur.rgbMultiplier) 和 [alphaMultiplier](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RadialBlur.alphaMultiplier) 来缩放颜色。
未知 四维向量 属性。

desc.en-US: Controls the amount of blur to apply. Values greater than 1 may appear glitchy.
desc.zh-CN: 控制应用的模糊量。大于 1 的值可能会出现故障。

desc.en-US: Scalar multiplier for the color that does not affect the alpha. Effectively a brightness multiplier.
desc.zh-CN: 不影响 Alpha 的颜色标量乘数。实际上是亮度乘数。
未知 标量 属性。
未知 四维向量 属性。
未知 四维向量 属性。
未知 四维向量 属性。

desc.en-US:
Parts of the particle with less opacity than this threshold will be invisible. The range is 0-255.

This threshold creates a hard cut-off between visible and not visible, which is unlike the alpha *fade* threshold properties in some similar actions.
desc.zh-CN:
不透明度低于此阈值的粒子部分将不可见。范围是 0-255。

此阈值在可见和不可见之间创建一个硬性截止，这与某些类似动作中的 alpha *淡入淡出* 阈值属性不同。

desc.en-US: If enabled, the particle width-related properties and fields will control both the width and height of the particles, and the height counterparts will be ignored.
desc.zh-CN: 如果启用，粒子宽度相关的属性和字段将同时控制粒子的宽度和高度，而高度对应的属性将被忽略。

desc.en-US: Controls how many times to apply the effect. Higher values can have a significant impact on performance.
desc.zh-CN: 控制应用效果的次数。较高的值会对性能产生重大影响。

desc.en-US:
Controls the color of the additional bloom effect. The colors of the particle will be multiplied with this color to get the final color of the bloom effect.

Note:
- This has no effect if the "Effects Quality" setting is set to "Low".
- This does not affect the natural bloom effect from high color values.
desc.zh-CN:
控制额外泛光效果的颜色。粒子的颜色将与此颜色相乘，以获得泛光效果的最终颜色。

注意：
- 如果“特效质量”设置设为“低”，则此项无效。
- 这不影响高颜色值产生的自然泛光效果。

desc.en-US: A hard cut-off point for the distance between the camera and the particle. If a particle is closer than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 摄像机与粒子之间距离的硬性截止点。如果粒子与摄像机的距离小于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US: A hard cut-off point for the distance between the camera and the particle. If a particle is farther away than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 摄像机与粒子之间距离的硬性截止点。如果粒子与摄像机的距离大于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US:
Controls the diffuse color of the light.

Values in this are unrestricted and can go above 1.

If [separateSpecular](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointLight.separateSpecular) is disabled, this also controls the specular color of the light.
desc.zh-CN:
控制灯光的漫反射颜色。

此处的数值不设限，可以超过 1。

如果禁用了 [separateSpecular](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointLight.separateSpecular)，此属性也会控制灯光的镜面反射颜色。

desc.en-US:
Controls the specular color of the light.

Values in this are unrestricted and can go above 1.

If [separateSpecular](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointLight.separateSpecular) is disabled, this property is ignored and [diffuseColor](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointLight.diffuseColor) controls both the diffuse as well as the specular color.
desc.zh-CN:
控制灯光的镜面反射颜色。

此处的数值不设限，可以超过 1。

如果禁用了 [separateSpecular](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointLight.separateSpecular)，此属性将被忽略，由 [diffuseColor](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointLight.diffuseColor) 同时控制漫反射和镜面反射颜色。

desc.en-US: The maximum distance that the light may travel from the source, and the radius of the sphere in which other effects caused by the light source (for example [volumeDensity](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointLight.volumeDensity) and its related fields) may act.
desc.zh-CN: 光线从光源传播的最大距离，同时也是受光源影响的其他效果（例如 [volumeDensity](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointLight.volumeDensity) 及其相关字段）生效的球体半径。
未知 标量 属性。
未知 标量 属性。
未知 标量 属性。

desc.en-US:
Affects the falloff of the light in some way, and how the normal of surfaces affect the intensity of the light.
- At 0 or negative values, this completely disables the light.
- At 1, the light behaves normally, like you would expect it to.
- At values between 0 and 1, it seemingly makes the falloff of the light over distance stronger, so the light will sooner fade to nothing.
- At values greater than 1, it will make the falloff weaker until near the [maximum distance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointLight.radius), and then it will very quickly fade to nothing. It also makes the normal of the surfaces hit by the light matter less. At very high values, anything within the radius basically becomes full bright.
desc.zh-CN:
影响光线的衰减方式，以及表面法线如何影响光照强度。
- 值为 0 或负数时，完全禁用灯光。
- 值为 1 时，灯光表现正常，符合预期。
- 值在 0 到 1 之间时，似乎会增强光线随距离的衰减，使光线更快消失。
- 值大于 1 时，会减弱衰减，直到接近 [最大距离](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointLight.radius)，然后迅速消失。它还会减少被光照表面的法线的影响。在极高数值下，半径内的任何物体基本上都会变成全亮。
未知 标量 属性。
未知 标量 属性。

desc.en-US:
A scalar multiplier for the [diffuse color](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointLight.diffuseColor). Good for easily adjusting the brightness of the light without changing the color.

If [separateSpecular](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointLight.separateSpecular) is disabled, this also affects the specular color of the light.
desc.zh-CN:
[漫反射颜色](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointLight.diffuseColor)的标量乘数。便于在不改变颜色的情况下调整灯光亮度。

如果禁用了 [separateSpecular](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointLight.separateSpecular)，这也会影响灯光的镜面反射颜色。

desc.en-US:
A scalar multiplier for the [specular color](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointLight.specularColor).

If [separateSpecular](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointLight.separateSpecular) is disabled, this property is ignored.
desc.zh-CN:
[镜面反射颜色](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointLight.specularColor)的标量乘数。

如果禁用了 [separateSpecular](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointLight.separateSpecular)，此属性将被忽略。

desc.zh-CN: 开启或关闭灯光的抖动和闪烁动画。

Controls how much the light should move around randomly on the X-axis.
desc.zh-CN: 控制灯光在 X 轴上随机移动的幅度。

desc.en-US: Controls how much the light should move around randomly on the Y-axis.
desc.zh-CN: 控制灯光在 Y 轴上随机移动的幅度。

desc.en-US: Controls how much the light should move around randomly on the Z-axis.
desc.zh-CN: 控制灯光在 Z 轴上随机移动的幅度。

desc.en-US: Controls the minimum interval for flickering.
Controls the maximum interval for flickering.
Brightness multiplier for the light when it flickers.
desc.zh-CN: 灯光闪烁时的亮度乘数。

desc.en-US:
Controls if the light should have shadows or not.

Note: Map objects also have a setting for casting shadows, and both must be enabled for an object to cast shadows from the light source.
desc.zh-CN:
控制灯光是否产生阴影。

注意：地图物体也有一个投射阴影的设置，必须同时启用两者，物体才能投射该光源的阴影。

desc.en-US: When enabled, this allows other properties and fields of the action to control the specular color independently of the diffuse color. When disabled, the diffuse counterpart of the properties or fields will affect both the diffuse and specular color.
desc.zh-CN: 启用时，允许 Action 的其他属性和字段独立于漫反射颜色来控制镜面反射颜色。禁用时，对应的漫反射属性或字段将同时影响漫反射和镜面反射颜色。

desc.en-US:
The number of seconds the light takes to fade to nothing after being destroyed.

Due to how the field this represents works, the time will be rounded to the nearest multiple of 1/30s.
desc.zh-CN:
灯光在被销毁后衰减消失所需的秒数。

由于该字段的工作原理，时间将四舍五入为最接近 1/30 秒的倍数。

desc.en-US: Controls how dark shadows from this light source are. At 0, the shadows will be entirely invisible.
desc.zh-CN: 控制此光源产生的阴影的暗度。值为 0 时，阴影将完全不可见。

desc.en-US:
Controls the maximum distance for the light source to be active. If the camera is farther away from the light source than this distance, it will stop emitting light.

Setting this to `0` will disable the distance limit.
desc.zh-CN:
控制光源处于活动状态的最大距离。如果摄像机与光源的距离超过此值，光源将停止发光。

设置为 `0` 将禁用距离限制。

desc.en-US: Controls the density of some sort of fake fog in the volume hit by the light. The fog does not affect the actual light produced by the source and is not affected by shadows.
desc.zh-CN: 控制光照范围内某种模拟雾的密度。这种雾不影响光源产生的实际光线，也不受阴影影响。

desc.en-US: Controls whether or not [asymmetryParam](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointLight.asymmetryParam) affects the fake fog from [volumeDensity](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointLight.volumeDensity).
desc.zh-CN: 控制 [asymmetryParam](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointLight.asymmetryParam) 是否影响来自 [volumeDensity](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointLight.volumeDensity) 的伪雾。

desc.en-US:
Controls how the fake fog from [volumeDensity](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointLight.volumeDensity) scatters the light. This value is ignored if [phaseFunction](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointLight.phaseFunction) is disabled, and the fog will scatter the light equally in all directions.

- At 0, the light is scattered equally in every direction.
- As the value approaches 1, the light is scattered more and more forward, in the same direction as the light was already traveling. This means that the fake fog will be less visible from the side or behind, and more visible from in front of the light.
- At 1, the fog will not scatter the light at all, so it will be entirely invisible.
- Values above 1 produce unnatural-looking effects where the light darkens the fog instead.
desc.zh-CN:
控制来自 [volumeDensity](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointLight.volumeDensity) 的模拟雾如何散射光线。如果禁用了 [phaseFunction](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PointLight.phaseFunction)，此值将被忽略，雾将向所有方向均匀散射光线。

- 值为 0 时，光线向各个方向均匀散射。
- 随着值接近 1，光线会越来越向前散射（沿光线传播方向）。这意味着伪雾从侧面或后面看不太明显，从正面看更明显。
- 值为 1 时，雾完全不散射光线，因此完全不可见。
- 值大于 1 会产生看起来不自然的效果，光线反而会使雾变暗。

desc.en-US: When not in a dark enough area, the brightness of the light will be multiplied by 0.1^α, where α is this exponent value. The light will have normal brightness when the area it's in is sufficiently dark.
desc.zh-CN: 当不在足够黑暗的区域时，灯光亮度将乘以 0.1^α，其中 α 是此指数值。当所在区域足够黑暗时，灯光将保持正常亮度。

desc.en-US: Unknown. Only used in Dark Souls 3.
desc.zh-CN: 未知。仅在《黑暗之魂 3》中使用。

desc.en-US:
Allows the effect to play out once it terminates. Particle emitters will stop emitting new particles, but particles with a finite duration that have already been emitted will stay around for as long as their duration allows them to.

Note: An effect terminates when it reaches [State](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#State) -1.
desc.zh-CN:
允许特效在终止后继续播放完。粒子发射器将停止发射新粒子，但已经发射且持续时间有限的粒子将在其持续时间允许的范围内继续存在。

注意：当特效达到 [状态](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#State) -1 时即为终止。

desc.en-US:

Note: An effect terminates when it reaches [State](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#State) -1.
desc.zh-CN:

注意：当特效达到 [状态](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#State) -1 时即为终止。

desc.en-US: The duration of the fade out in seconds.

Makes the effect instantly disappear when it terminates.

使特效在终止时立即消失。
