desc.en-US:
Enables particles emitted by the node to collide with surfaces, and controls how those collisions affect the movement of the particles.

Note that this works very differently from the collision-related fields in the GPU particle appearance actions. The collision detection for those are entriely based on the distances between the camera and everything in its view, so if a particle is farther away from the camera than an object, the particle will be able to collide with it. The collision detection used in this action is based on the real 3D geometry of the scene, so particles can collide with anything, even while they are out of view.

Also note that this action seems to cause the game to crash very easily. If a particle affected by this action despawns due to its limited duration, the game will crash no matter what.
desc.zh-CN:
使节点发射的粒子能够与表面碰撞，并控制这些碰撞如何影响粒子的运动。

请注意，这与 GPU 粒子外观动作中与碰撞相关的字段的工作方式截然不同。后者的碰撞检测完全基于摄像机与其视野中所有物体之间的距离，因此如果粒子比物体离摄像机更远，粒子将能够与其碰撞（深度缓冲碰撞）。而此动作中使用的碰撞检测是基于场景的真实 3D 几何体的，因此粒子可以与任何物体碰撞，即使它们在视野之外。

另请注意，此行为似乎很容易导致游戏崩溃。如果受此动作影响的粒子因其有限的持续时间而消失，游戏无论如何都会崩溃。

desc.en-US: The collision radius of the particles. This controls the maximum distance between the particles and a surface they can collide with for a collision to be detected.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子的碰撞半径。这控制粒子与它们可以碰撞的表面之间的最大距离，以便检测到碰撞。

desc.en-US:
The friction coefficient of the particles. This controls how quickly particles stop while sliding against a surface.
| Values | Behavior |
|-|-|
| <0 | The particles will accelerate as they slide, going faster and faster over time. |
| 0 | The particles will not decelerate at all as they slide. They will just keep sliding forever unless something else stops them. |
| 0-1 | The particles will decelerate as they slide, causing them to eventually come to a stop. |
| ≥1 | The particles will stop immediately if they contact a surface. They may still [bounce](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleForceCollision.bounciness), but they will never slide along the surface. |
desc.zh-CN:
粒子的摩擦系数。这控制粒子在表面滑动时停止的速度。
| 值 | 行为 |
|-|-|
| <0 | 粒子在滑动时会加速，随着时间的推移越来越快。 |
| 0 | 粒子在滑动时完全不会减速。除非有其他东西阻止它们，否则它们将永远滑动。 |
| 0-1 | 粒子在滑动时会减速，最终停止。 |
| ≥1 | 如果粒子接触表面，它们将立即停止。它们可能仍会[反弹](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ParticleForceCollision.bounciness)，但绝不会沿表面滑动。 |

desc.en-US:
The coefficient of restitution of the particles, or how "bouncy" they are.
| Values | Behavior |
|-|-|
| ≤0 | Completely inelastic collision. The particles will not bounce if they hit something. They will just stop or slide.
| 0-1 | Partially elastic collision. The particles will bounce, but they will lose some energy from the collision, causing them to bounce back at a reduced speed compared to the speed they had before the collision. |
| 1 | Perfectly elastic collision. No energy is lost from any collision, causing the particles to bounce off at the same speed they hit the surface. |
| >1 | Hyper-elastic collision. The particles will gain energy from every collision, causing them to speed up every time they collide with something. Hitting something at an angle may in some cases still cause them to lose some energy. |
desc.zh-CN:
粒子的恢复系数，即它们的“弹性”程度。
| 值 | 行为 |
|-|-|
| ≤0 | 完全非弹性碰撞。粒子如果击中某物不会反弹。它们只会停止或滑动。
| 0-1 | 部分弹性碰撞。粒子会反弹，但会在碰撞中损失一些能量，导致反弹速度低于碰撞前的速度。 |
| 1 | 完全弹性碰撞。碰撞中没有任何能量损失，粒子以撞击表面时的相同速度反弹。 |
| >1 | 超弹性碰撞。粒子将从每次碰撞中获得能量，导致它们每次与某物碰撞时都会加速。以一定角度撞击某物在某些情况下可能仍会导致它们损失一些能量。 |

desc.en-US:
Defines a GPU particle system. This emits GPU particles, which means thousands of particles can be rendered without much impact on performance.

Note that while this emits particles, it is itself not a particle, and the particles emitted by this action are not affected by everything that affects regular particles.

The name of this action is from Elden Ring's RTTI, where it's called "GXVfxStandardParticleAppearance".
desc.zh-CN:
定义一个GPU粒子系统。这会发射GPU粒子，意味着可以渲染数千个粒子，而对性能影响不大。

请注意，虽然它会发射粒子，但它本身并不是一个粒子，并且由此动作发射的粒子不受影响常规粒子的所有因素影响。

此行为的名称来自《艾尔登法环》的RTTI，在那里它被称为“GXVfxStandardParticleAppearance”。

desc.en-US: The ID of the texture of the particles.
Controls the shape of the particle emitter. See [EmitterShape](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape) for more details.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子发射器的形状。有关更多详细信息，请参阅 [EmitterShape](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape)。

desc.en-US:
Unknown integer.

When set to `1`, this seems to allow the emitter to be rotated, but it also limits the direction particles can move. For example, with a box emitter shape, this makes the particles only able to move along one of the three axes of the box.
desc.zh-CN:
未知整数。

当设置为 `1` 时，这似乎允许旋转发射器，但也限制了粒子可以移动的方向。例如，对于盒形发射器，这使得粒子只能沿盒子的三个轴之一移动。

desc.en-US:
Controls how the random emission points are distributed within the [shape of the emitter](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.emitterShape). How this works depend on the emitter shape: | Shape | Behavior | |-|-| | [Line](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Line) | A fraction of the line where particles can not be emitted from.
At 0, particles can be emitted from any point on the line.
At 1, they can only be emitted from the far end of the line. | | [Box](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Box) | A fraction of the box's size where the particles can not be emitted from. Basically an inner box that blocks emission. | | [Box2](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Box2) | At 1, any point within the box is equally likely to be picked.
At 0, particles are more likely to be emitted near the center, but it's not a 100% chance. | | [Unk3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Unk3) | Exactly the same as [Line](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Line)? | | [Cylinder](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Cylinder) | A fraction of the radius of the cylinder where the particles can not be emitted from. Basically an inner cylinder that blocks emission. |
desc.zh-CN:
控制随机发射点在[发射器形状](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.emitterShape)内的分布方式。其工作原理取决于发射器形状： | 形状 | 行为 | |-|-| | [线形](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Line) | 线上不能发射粒子的比例。
为 0 时，粒子可从线上任意点发射。
为 1 时，只能从线的远端发射。 | | [盒形](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Box) | 盒子尺寸中不能发射粒子的比例。基本上是一个阻挡发射的内部盒子。 | | [盒形2](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Box2) | 为 1 时，盒子内任何点被选中的几率相等。
为 0 时，粒子更有可能在中心附近发射，但不是 100% 的几率。 | | [Unk3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Unk3) | 似乎与 [线形](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Line) 完全相同？ | | [圆柱形](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Cylinder) | 圆柱体半径中不能发射粒子的比例。基本上是一个阻挡发射的内部圆柱体。 |

desc.en-US: The number of particles to emit per emission.

The minimum number of particles to emit per emission. A new random value is picked for each emission, and the random value is added to the [base emission particle count](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.emissionParticleCount).
desc.zh-CN: 每次发射的最小粒子数量。每次发射都会选取一个新的随机值，该随机值将添加到[基础发射粒子计数](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.emissionParticleCount)中。

desc.en-US: The maximum number of particles to emit per emission. A new random value is picked for each emission, and the random value is added to the [base emission particle count](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.emissionParticleCount).
desc.zh-CN: 每次发射的最大粒子数量。每次发射都会选取一个新的随机值，该随机值将添加到[基础发射粒子计数](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.emissionParticleCount)中。

desc.en-US: The minimum time between emissions in seconds. Due to the way this field works, the value will be rounded to the nearest 1/30s.
desc.zh-CN: 发射之间的最小间隔时间（秒）。由于此字段的工作方式，该值将四舍五入到最接近的 1/30 秒。

desc.en-US: The maximum time between emissions in seconds. Due to the way this field works, the value will be rounded to the nearest 1/30s.
desc.zh-CN: 发射之间的最大间隔时间（秒）。由于此字段的工作方式，该值将四舍五入到最接近的 1/30 秒。

desc.en-US: If enabled, the number of emissions will be limited by [emissionCountLimit](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.emissionCountLimit).
desc.zh-CN: 如果启用，发射次数将受到 [emissionCountLimit](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.emissionCountLimit) 的限制。

desc.en-US: The total number of emissions. This limit is only applied if [limitEmissionCount](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.limitEmissionCount) is enabled.
desc.zh-CN: 总发射次数。此限制仅在启用 [limitEmissionCount](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.limitEmissionCount) 时应用。

desc.en-US: The duration of each particle in seconds. Due to the way this field works, the value will be rounded to the nearest 1/30s.
desc.zh-CN: 每个粒子的持续时间（秒）。由于此字段的工作方式，该值将四舍五入到最接近的 1/30 秒。

desc.en-US: Minimum particle position offset. A random value between this and [particleOffsetMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleOffsetMax) will be added to [particleOffset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleOffset) to get the final position offset.
desc.zh-CN: 最小粒子位置偏移。将在此值和 [particleOffsetMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleOffsetMax) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [particleOffset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleOffset) 以获得最终位置偏移。

desc.en-US: Maximum particle position offset. A random value between this and [particleOffsetMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleOffsetMin) will be added to [particleOffset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleOffset) to get the final position offset.
desc.zh-CN: 最大粒子位置偏移。将在此值和 [particleOffsetMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleOffsetMin) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [particleOffset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleOffset) 以获得最终位置偏移。

desc.en-US: Minimum particle speed. A random value between this and [particleSpeedMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleSpeedMax) will be added to [particleSpeed](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleSpeed) to get the final speed.
desc.zh-CN: 最小粒子速度。将在此值和 [particleSpeedMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleSpeedMax) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [particleSpeed](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleSpeed) 以获得最终速度。

desc.en-US: Maximum particle speed. A random value between this and [particleSpeedMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleSpeedMin) will be added to [particleSpeed](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleSpeed) to get the final speed.
desc.zh-CN: 最大粒子速度。将在此值和 [particleSpeedMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleSpeedMin) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [particleSpeed](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleSpeed) 以获得最终速度。

desc.en-US: Minimum particle acceleration. A random value between this and [particleAccelerationMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleAccelerationMax) will be added to the three acceleration properties to get the final acceleration.
desc.zh-CN: 最小粒子加速度。将在此值和 [particleAccelerationMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleAccelerationMax) 之间取一个随机值添加到三个加速度属性中以获得最终加速度。

desc.en-US: Maximum particle acceleration. A random value between this and [particleAccelerationMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleAccelerationMin) will be added to the three acceleration properties to get the final acceleration.
desc.zh-CN: 最大粒子加速度。将在此值和 [particleAccelerationMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleAccelerationMin) 之间取一个随机值添加到三个加速度属性中以获得最终加速度。

desc.en-US: Maximum amount of random rotation for each particle in degrees.
desc.zh-CN: 每个粒子的最大随机旋转量（度）。

desc.en-US: Maximum amount of random angular speed for each particle in degrees per second.
desc.zh-CN: 每个粒子的最大随机角速度（度/秒）。

desc.en-US: Minimum amount of random angular acceleration for each particle in degrees per second squared.
desc.zh-CN: 每个粒子的最小随机角加速度（度/平方秒）。

desc.en-US: Maximum amount of random angular acceleration for each particle in degrees per second squared.
desc.zh-CN: 每个粒子的最大随机角加速度（度/平方秒）。

desc.en-US: When enabled, the height of the particles will be based on the [width](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleSizeX) instead of the [height field](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleSizeY), and the height field is ignored.
desc.zh-CN: 启用时，粒子的高度将基于 [宽度](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleSizeX) 而不是 [高度字段](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleSizeY)，高度字段将被忽略。

desc.en-US: The minimum width of the particle. A random value between this and [particleSizeXMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleSizeXMin) will be added to [particleSizeX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleSizeX) to get the final width.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子的最小宽度。将在此值和 [particleSizeXMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleSizeXMin) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [particleSizeX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleSizeX) 以获得最终宽度。

desc.en-US: The minimum height of the particle. A random value between this and [particleSizeYMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleSizeYMin) will be added to [particleSizeY](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleSizeY) to get the final height.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子的最小高度。将在此值和 [particleSizeYMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleSizeYMin) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [particleSizeY](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleSizeY) 以获得最终高度。

desc.en-US: The maximum width of the particle. A random value between this and [particleSizeXMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleSizeXMax) will be added to [particleSizeX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleSizeX) to get the final width.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子的最大宽度。将在此值和 [particleSizeXMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleSizeXMax) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [particleSizeX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleSizeX) 以获得最终宽度。

desc.en-US: The maximum height of the particle. A random value between this and [particleSizeYMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleSizeYMax) will be added to [particleSizeY](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleSizeY) to get the final height.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子的最大高度。将在此值和 [particleSizeYMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleSizeYMax) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [particleSizeY](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleSizeY) 以获得最终高度。

desc.en-US: The rate of change for the width of the particles.
The rate of change for the height of the particles.

Minimum rate of change for the width of the particles. A random value between this and [particleGrowthRateXMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthRateXMax) will be added to [particleGrowthRateX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthRateX) and [particleGrowthRateXStatic](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthRateXStatic) to get the final growth rate.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子宽度的最小变化率。将在此值和 [particleGrowthRateXMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthRateXMax) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [particleGrowthRateX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthRateX) 和 [particleGrowthRateXStatic](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthRateXStatic) 以获得最终增长率。

desc.en-US: Minimum rate of change for the height of the particles. A random value between this and [particleGrowthRateYMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthRateYMax) will be added to [particleGrowthRateY](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthRateY) and [particleGrowthRateYStatic](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthRateYStatic) to get the final growth rate.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子高度的最小变化率。将在此值和 [particleGrowthRateYMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthRateYMax) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [particleGrowthRateY](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthRateY) 和 [particleGrowthRateYStatic](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthRateYStatic) 以获得最终增长率。

desc.en-US: Maximum rate of change for the width of the particles. A random value between this and [particleGrowthRateXMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthRateXMax) will be added to [particleGrowthRateX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthRateX) and [particleGrowthRateXStatic](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthRateXStatic) to get the final growth rate.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子宽度的最大变化率。将在此值和 [particleGrowthRateXMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthRateXMax) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [particleGrowthRateX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthRateX) 和 [particleGrowthRateXStatic](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthRateXStatic) 以获得最终增长率。

desc.en-US: Maximum rate of change for the height of the particles. A random value between this and [particleGrowthRateYMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthRateYMax) will be added to [particleGrowthRateY](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthRateY) and [particleGrowthRateYStatic](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthRateYStatic) to get the final growth rate.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子高度的最大变化率。将在此值和 [particleGrowthRateYMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthRateYMax) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [particleGrowthRateY](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthRateY) 和 [particleGrowthRateYStatic](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthRateYStatic) 以获得最终增长率。

desc.en-US: Minimum acceleration of change for the width of the particles. A random value between this and [particleGrowthAccelerationXMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthAccelerationXMax) will be the final growth acceleration.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子宽度变化的最小加速度。将在此值和 [particleGrowthAccelerationXMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthAccelerationXMax) 之间取一个随机值作为最终增长加速度。

desc.en-US: Minimum acceleration of change for the height of the particles. A random value between this and [particleGrowthAccelerationYMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthAccelerationYMax) will be the final growth acceleration.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子高度变化的最小加速度。将在此值和 [particleGrowthAccelerationYMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthAccelerationYMax) 之间取一个随机值作为最终增长加速度。

desc.en-US: Minimum acceleration of change for the width of the particles. A random value between this and [particleGrowthAccelerationXMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthAccelerationXMin) will be the final growth acceleration.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子宽度变化的最大加速度。将在此值和 [particleGrowthAccelerationXMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthAccelerationXMin) 之间取一个随机值作为最终增长加速度。

desc.en-US: Minimum acceleration of change for the height of the particles. A random value between this and [particleGrowthAccelerationYMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthAccelerationYMin) will be the final growth acceleration.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子高度变化的最大加速度。将在此值和 [particleGrowthAccelerationYMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleGrowthAccelerationYMin) 之间取一个随机值作为最终增长加速度。

desc.en-US: Scalar multiplier for the color that does not affect the alpha. Effectively a brightness multiplier.
desc.zh-CN: 不影响 Alpha 的颜色标量乘数。实际上是亮度乘数。

desc.en-US: Minimum random variation for the particle color. A random value between this and [colorMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.colorMax) will be added to the base [color](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.color), but it fades out over the life of the particle.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子颜色的最小随机变化。将在此值和 [colorMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.colorMax) 之间取一个随机值添加到基础 [color](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.color) 中，但它会在粒子寿命期间逐渐消失。

desc.en-US: Maximum random variation for the particle color. A random value between this and [colorMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.colorMin) will be added to the base [color](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.color), but it fades out over the life of the particle.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子颜色的最大随机变化。将在此值和 [colorMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.colorMin) 之间取一个随机值添加到基础 [color](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.color) 中，但它会在粒子寿命期间逐渐消失。

desc.en-US: To split the texture into multiple animation frames, this value must be set to the number of columns in the texture. It should equal `textureWidth / frameWidth`.
desc.zh-CN: 要将纹理分割成多个动画帧，必须将此值设置为纹理中的列数。它应等于 `textureWidth / frameWidth`。

desc.en-US: To split the texture into multiple animation frames, this value must be set to the total number of frames in the texture.
desc.zh-CN: 要将纹理分割成多个动画帧，必须将此值设置为纹理中的总帧数。

desc.en-US: When enabled, this makes each particle pick a random frame from the animation and only display that one frame.
desc.zh-CN: 当启用时，这会使每个粒子从动画中选取一个随机帧并仅显示该帧。

desc.en-US: Controls the maximum frame index when [picking a random frame to display](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.randomTextureFrame).
desc.zh-CN: 当 [选取随机帧进行显示](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.randomTextureFrame) 时，控制最大帧索引。

desc.en-US: Scalar multiplier for the size of the particles.

If enabled, the particle system stops updating if the camera is beyond the distance specified by [updateDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.updateDistance) from the node.

It will not stop updating immediately after the action becomes active. Instead, it will wait for a little while before stopping if the camera is too far away.
desc.zh-CN:
如果启用，当摄像机距离节点的距离超过 [updateDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.updateDistance) 指定的距离时，粒子系统将停止更新。

动作激活后，它不会立即停止更新。相反，如果摄像机太远，它会等待一小会儿再停止。

desc.en-US: Controls how close the camera needs to be to the node for the particle system to update. Requires [limitUpdateDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.limitUpdateDistance) to be enabled.
desc.zh-CN: 控制摄像机需要离节点多近，粒子系统才会更新。需要启用 [limitUpdateDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.limitUpdateDistance)。

desc.en-US: When enabled, this makes the particles bounce off of any surface they hit. This collision detection is just based on the depth buffer, not the full 3D scene, so it is not always perfect.
desc.zh-CN: 当启用时，这会使粒子从它们撞击的任何表面反弹。此碰撞检测仅基于深度缓冲区，而不是完整的 3D 场景，因此并不总是完美的。

desc.en-US: Controls how strong the rebound from hitting a surface is when [particleCollision](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleCollision) is enabled.
desc.zh-CN: 当启用 [particleCollision](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleCollision) 时，控制撞击表面反弹的强度。

desc.en-US: If enabled, particles will randomly make sharp turns that affect the direction of various speed and acceleration properties. Both the time between turns and the turn angle are randomized for each turn and for each particle, and they are based on [particleRandomTurnIntervalMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleRandomTurnIntervalMax) and [particleRandomTurnAngle](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleRandomTurnAngle) respectively.
desc.zh-CN: 如果启用，粒子将随机进行急转弯，影响各种速度和加速度属性的方向。每次转向的时间间隔和转向角度对于每个粒子和每次转向都是随机的，并且分别基于 [particleRandomTurnIntervalMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleRandomTurnIntervalMax) 和 [particleRandomTurnAngle](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleRandomTurnAngle)。

desc.en-US: The maximum amount of time in seconds to wait between making random turns. Due to the way this field works, the value will be rounded to the nearest 1/30s. Requires [particleRandomTurns](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleRandomTurns) to be enabled.
desc.zh-CN: 进行随机转向之间等待的最大时间（秒）。由于此字段的工作方式，该值将四舍五入到最接近的 1/30 秒。需要启用 [particleRandomTurns](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.particleRandomTurns)。

desc.en-US: If enabled, this causes the particles to orient themselves and stretch in the direction they are moving on the screen, making them almost resemble [Tracer](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionType.Tracer) particles.
desc.zh-CN: 如果启用，这将导致粒子调整方向并在屏幕上移动的方向上拉伸，使它们几乎类似于 [Tracer](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionType.Tracer) 粒子。

desc.en-US: Controls how much the particles are stretched when [traceParticles](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.traceParticles) is enabled.
desc.zh-CN: 当启用 [traceParticles](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.traceParticles) 时，控制粒子的拉伸程度。

desc.en-US: A central fraction of the emitter volume where the particles will not be trace particles. In this volume, the particles act as if [traceParticles](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.traceParticles) is disabled.
desc.zh-CN: 发射器体积的中心部分比例，在此部分中的粒子不会成为拖尾粒子。在此体积中，粒子的行为就像 [traceParticles](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.traceParticles) 被禁用一样。

desc.en-US: If enabled, this will add a billboarding sprite to the leading end of trace particles.
desc.zh-CN: 如果启用，这将向拖尾粒子的前端添加一个公告板精灵。

desc.en-US: Controls whether or not the particles have a bloom effect.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子是否具有泛光效果。

desc.en-US:
Controls the color of the additional bloom effect. The colors of the particle will be multiplied with this color to get the final color of the bloom effect.

Note:
- This has no effect if the "Effects Quality" setting is set to "Low".
- This does not affect the natural bloom effect from high color values.
desc.zh-CN:
控制额外泛光效果的颜色。粒子的颜色将与此颜色相乘，以获得泛光效果的最终颜色。

注意：
- 如果“特效质量”设置设为“低”，则此项无效。
- 这不影响高颜色值产生的自然泛光效果。

desc.en-US: Desaturates the particles, making them more grayscale. At 0, the particles will have their regular colors. At 1, they will be entirely grayscale.
desc.zh-CN: 降低粒子的饱和度，使其更接近灰度。为 0 时，粒子将具有常规颜色。为 1 时，它们将完全变为灰度。

desc.en-US:
This controls a point where the opacity of a particle will start to fade to 0 near the [minimum view distance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.minDistance). At [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.minDistance), the opacity will be 0, and it will linearly approach 1 as the distance between the camera and the particle approaches this distance.

This requires [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.minDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0. This distance limit can be disabled by setting this and minDistance to -1.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子不透明度开始在 [最小视图距离](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.minDistance) 附近衰减为 0 的点。在 [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.minDistance) 处，不透明度为 0，随着摄像机与粒子之间的距离接近此距离，不透明度将线性接近 1。

这要求 [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.minDistance) 设置为正值或 0。可以通过将此值和 minDistance 设置为 -1 来禁用此距离限制。

desc.en-US:
Minimum view distance. If a particle is closer than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.

This requires [minFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.minFadeDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0.

This is different from [minDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.minDistanceThreshold), as this controls the start of a distance range that has smooth transitions at each end, while the threshold value is a hard cut-off.
desc.zh-CN:
最小视图距离。如果粒子与摄像机的距离小于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

这要求 [minFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.minFadeDistance) 设置为正值或 0。

这与 [minDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.minDistanceThreshold) 不同，因为此项控制的是两端具有平滑过渡的距离范围的起点，而阈值是硬性截止。

desc.en-US:
This controls a point where the opacity of a particle will start to fade to 0 near the [maximum view distance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.maxDistance). At [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.maxDistance), the opacity will be 0, and it will linearly approach 1 as the distance between the camera and the particle approaches this distance.

This requires [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.maxDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0. This distance limit can be disabled by setting this and maxDistance to -1.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子不透明度开始在 [最大视图距离](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.maxDistance) 附近衰减为 0 的点。在 [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.maxDistance) 处，不透明度为 0，随着摄像机与粒子之间的距离接近此距离，不透明度将线性接近 1。

这要求 [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.maxDistance) 设置为正值或 0。可以通过将此值和 maxDistance 设置为 -1 来禁用此距离限制。

desc.en-US:
Minimum view distance. If a particle is farther away than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.

This requires [maxFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.maxFadeDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0.

This is different from [maxDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.maxDistanceThreshold), as this controls the start of a distance range that has smooth transitions at each end, while the threshold value is a hard cut-off.
desc.zh-CN:
最小视图距离。如果粒子与摄像机的距离大于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

这要求 [maxFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.maxFadeDistance) 设置为正值或 0。

这与 [maxDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.maxDistanceThreshold) 不同，因为此项控制的是两端具有平滑过渡的距离范围的起点，而阈值是硬性截止。

desc.en-US: A hard cut-off point for the distance between the camera and the particle. If a particle is closer than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 摄像机与粒子之间距离的硬性截止点。如果粒子与摄像机的距离小于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US: A hard cut-off point for the distance between the camera and the particle. If a particle is farther away than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 摄像机与粒子之间距离的硬性截止点。如果粒子与摄像机的距离大于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US: Controls how dark shaded parts of the particle are.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子阴影部分的暗度。

desc.en-US:
When set to 1, this stops the particles from being shown indoors.

Other values are used in AC6, but what they do is unknown.
desc.zh-CN:
当设置为 1 时，这将停止粒子在室内显示。

AC6 中使用了其他值，但具体作用未知。

desc.en-US:
Unknown boolean.

Like in most other actions with this field, when enabled, it may stop [unk_sdt_f2_29](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.unk_sdt_f2_29) from doing whatever it is doing, but that field may also not work exactly the same in this action, so it's tricky to confirm. It can also cause some ugly "outline" effects on things seen through particles, and it may also fix an issue where some other particles can be seen through particles emitted by this action.
desc.zh-CN:
未知布尔值。

与大多数其他具有此字段的动作一样，启用时，它可能会停止 [unk_sdt_f2_29](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle.unk_sdt_f2_29) 的作用，但该字段在此动作中的工作方式可能也不完全相同，因此难以确认。它也可能会对透过粒子看到的内容产生一些难看的“轮廓”效果，并且它可能还修复了某些其他粒子可以透过此动作发射的粒子看到的问题。

desc.en-US: Controls how sharp the specular highlights are.
desc.zh-CN: 控制高光亮点的清晰度。

desc.en-US: Controls how bright the specular highlights are.

Defines a GPU particle system. Very similar to [GPUStandardParticle](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle), with no known differences.

The name of this action is from Elden Ring's RTTI, where it's called "GXVfxStandardCorrectParticleAppearance". An action with the same ID had the name "WanderingVision" in Dark Souls 3, and that action could still exist in DS3, but it is not found in the vanilla game, so testing it is difficult.

Note: This action does not exist in Dark Souls 3 or Sekiro, but it still has unknown fields and properties named after those games. This is because it makes the conversion between this action and [GPUStandardParticle](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle) much simpler. When written for those two games, this action will be converted to the other action automatically.
desc.zh-CN:
定义了一个 GPU 粒子系统。与 [GPUStandardParticle](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle) 非常相似，没有已知差异。

此行为的名称来自《艾尔登法环》的 RTTI，其中它被称为“GXVfxStandardCorrectParticleAppearance”。在《黑暗之魂3》中，一个具有相同 ID 的行为名为“WanderingVision”，并且该行为可能仍存在于《黑暗之魂3》中，但在原版游戏中未找到，因此难以进行测试。

注意：此行为在《黑暗之魂3》或《只狼》中不存在，但它仍然包含以这两款游戏命名的未知字段和属性。这是因为这样可以简化此操作与 [GPUStandardParticle](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle) 之间的转换。当为这两款游戏编写时，此操作将被自动转换为另一个操作。

desc.en-US: Controls how well the particles follow the node if it moves.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子在节点移动时的跟随程度。

desc.en-US: Maximum random turn angle for particles. Requires [particleRandomTurns](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleRandomTurns) to be enabled.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子的最大随机转向角度。需要启用 [particleRandomTurns](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleRandomTurns)。

desc.en-US: The ID of the texture of the particles.
Controls the shape of the particle emitter. See [EmitterShape](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape) for more details.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子发射器的形状。有关更多详细信息，请参阅 [EmitterShape](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape)。

desc.en-US:
Controls how the random emission points are distributed within the [shape of the emitter](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.emitterShape). How this works depend on the emitter shape: | Shape | Behavior | |-|-| | [Line](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Line) | A fraction of the line where particles can not be emitted from.
At 0, particles can be emitted from any point on the line.
At 1, they can only be emitted from the far end of the line. | | [Box](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Box) | A fraction of the box's size where the particles can not be emitted from. Basically an inner box that blocks emission. | | [Box2](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Box2) | At 1, any point within the box is equally likely to be picked.
At 0, particles are more likely to be emitted near the center, but it's not a 100% chance. | | [Unk3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Unk3) | Exactly the same as [Line](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Line)? | | [Cylinder](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Cylinder) | A fraction of the radius of the cylinder where the particles can not be emitted from. Basically an inner cylinder that blocks emission. |
desc.zh-CN:
控制随机发射点在[发射器形状](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.emitterShape)内的分布方式。其工作原理取决于发射器形状： | 形状 | 行为 | |-|-| | [线形](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Line) | 线上不能发射粒子的比例。
为 0 时，粒子可从线上任意点发射。
为 1 时，只能从线的远端发射。 | | [盒形](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Box) | 盒子尺寸中不能发射粒子的比例。基本上是一个阻挡发射的内部盒子。 | | [盒形2](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Box2) | 为 1 时，盒子内任何点被选中的几率相等。
为 0 时，粒子更有可能在中心附近发射，但不是 100% 的几率。 | | [Unk3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Unk3) | 似乎与 [线形](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Line) 完全相同？ | | [圆柱形](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Cylinder) | 圆柱体半径中不能发射粒子的比例。基本上是一个阻挡发射的内部圆柱体。 |

desc.en-US: The number of particles to emit per emission.

The minimum number of particles to emit per emission. A new random value is picked for each emission, and the random value is added to the [base emission particle count](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.emissionParticleCount).
desc.zh-CN: 每次发射的最小粒子数量。每次发射都会选取一个新的随机值，该随机值将添加到[基础发射粒子计数](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.emissionParticleCount)中。

desc.en-US: The maximum number of particles to emit per emission. A new random value is picked for each emission, and the random value is added to the [base emission particle count](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.emissionParticleCount).
desc.zh-CN: 每次发射的最大粒子数量。每次发射都会选取一个新的随机值，该随机值将添加到[基础发射粒子计数](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.emissionParticleCount)中。

desc.en-US: The minimum time between emissions in seconds. Due to the way this field works, the value will be rounded to the nearest 1/30s.
desc.zh-CN: 发射之间的最小间隔时间（秒）。由于此字段的工作方式，该值将四舍五入到最接近的 1/30 秒。

desc.en-US: The maximum time between emissions in seconds. Due to the way this field works, the value will be rounded to the nearest 1/30s.
desc.zh-CN: 发射之间的最大间隔时间（秒）。由于此字段的工作方式，该值将四舍五入到最接近的 1/30 秒。

desc.en-US: If enabled, the number of emissions will be limited by [emissionCountLimit](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.emissionCountLimit).
desc.zh-CN: 如果启用，发射次数将受到 [emissionCountLimit](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.emissionCountLimit) 的限制。

desc.en-US: The total number of emissions. This limit is only applied if [limitEmissionCount](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.limitEmissionCount) is enabled.
desc.zh-CN: 总发射次数。此限制仅在启用 [limitEmissionCount](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.limitEmissionCount) 时应用。

desc.en-US: The duration of each particle in seconds. Due to the way this field works, the value will be rounded to the nearest 1/30s.
desc.zh-CN: 每个粒子的持续时间（秒）。由于此字段的工作方式，该值将四舍五入到最接近的 1/30 秒。

desc.en-US: Minimum particle position offset. A random value between this and [particleOffsetMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleOffsetMax) will be added to [particleOffset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleOffset) to get the final position offset.
desc.zh-CN: 最小粒子位置偏移。将在此值和 [particleOffsetMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleOffsetMax) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [particleOffset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleOffset) 以获得最终位置偏移。

desc.en-US: Maximum particle position offset. A random value between this and [particleOffsetMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleOffsetMin) will be added to [particleOffset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleOffset) to get the final position offset.
desc.zh-CN: 最大粒子位置偏移。将在此值和 [particleOffsetMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleOffsetMin) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [particleOffset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleOffset) 以获得最终位置偏移。

desc.en-US: Minimum particle speed. A random value between this and [particleSpeedMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleSpeedMax) will be added to [particleSpeed](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleSpeed) to get the final speed.
desc.zh-CN: 最小粒子速度。将在此值和 [particleSpeedMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleSpeedMax) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [particleSpeed](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleSpeed) 以获得最终速度。

desc.en-US: Maximum particle speed. A random value between this and [particleSpeedMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleSpeedMin) will be added to [particleSpeed](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleSpeed) to get the final speed.
desc.zh-CN: 最大粒子速度。将在此值和 [particleSpeedMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleSpeedMin) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [particleSpeed](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleSpeed) 以获得最终速度。

desc.en-US: Minimum particle acceleration. A random value between this and [particleAccelerationMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleAccelerationMax) will be added to the three acceleration properties to get the final acceleration.
desc.zh-CN: 最小粒子加速度。将在此值和 [particleAccelerationMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleAccelerationMax) 之间取一个随机值添加到三个加速度属性中以获得最终加速度。

desc.en-US: Maximum particle acceleration. A random value between this and [particleAccelerationMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleAccelerationMin) will be added to the three acceleration properties to get the final acceleration.
desc.zh-CN: 最大粒子加速度。将在此值和 [particleAccelerationMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleAccelerationMin) 之间取一个随机值添加到三个加速度属性中以获得最终加速度。

desc.en-US: Maximum amount of random rotation for each particle in degrees.
desc.zh-CN: 每个粒子的最大随机旋转量（度）。

desc.en-US: Maximum amount of random angular speed for each particle in degrees per second.
desc.zh-CN: 每个粒子的最大随机角速度（度/秒）。

desc.en-US: Minimum amount of random angular acceleration for each particle in degrees per second squared.
desc.zh-CN: 每个粒子的最小随机角加速度（度/平方秒）。

desc.en-US: Maximum amount of random angular acceleration for each particle in degrees per second squared.
desc.zh-CN: 每个粒子的最大随机角加速度（度/平方秒）。

desc.en-US: When enabled, the height of the particles will be based on the [width](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleSizeX) instead of the [height field](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleSizeY), and the height field is ignored.
desc.zh-CN: 启用时，粒子的高度将基于 [宽度](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleSizeX) 而不是 [高度字段](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleSizeY)，高度字段将被忽略。

desc.en-US: The minimum width of the particle. A random value between this and [particleSizeXMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleSizeXMin) will be added to [particleSizeX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleSizeX) to get the final width.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子的最小宽度。将在此值和 [particleSizeXMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleSizeXMin) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [particleSizeX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleSizeX) 以获得最终宽度。

desc.en-US: The minimum height of the particle. A random value between this and [particleSizeYMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleSizeYMin) will be added to [particleSizeY](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleSizeY) to get the final height.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子的最小高度。将在此值和 [particleSizeYMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleSizeYMin) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [particleSizeY](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleSizeY) 以获得最终高度。

desc.en-US: The maximum width of the particle. A random value between this and [particleSizeXMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleSizeXMax) will be added to [particleSizeX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleSizeX) to get the final width.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子的最大宽度。将在此值和 [particleSizeXMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleSizeXMax) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [particleSizeX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleSizeX) 以获得最终宽度。

desc.en-US: The maximum height of the particle. A random value between this and [particleSizeYMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleSizeYMax) will be added to [particleSizeY](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleSizeY) to get the final height.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子的最大高度。将在此值和 [particleSizeYMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleSizeYMax) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [particleSizeY](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleSizeY) 以获得最终高度。

desc.en-US: The rate of change for the width of the particles.
The rate of change for the height of the particles.

Minimum rate of change for the width of the particles. A random value between this and [particleGrowthRateXMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthRateXMax) will be added to [particleGrowthRateX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthRateX) and [particleGrowthRateXStatic](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthRateXStatic) to get the final growth rate.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子宽度的最小变化率。将在此值和 [particleGrowthRateXMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthRateXMax) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [particleGrowthRateX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthRateX) 和 [particleGrowthRateXStatic](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthRateXStatic) 以获得最终增长率。

desc.en-US: Minimum rate of change for the height of the particles. A random value between this and [particleGrowthRateYMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthRateYMax) will be added to [particleGrowthRateY](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthRateY) and [particleGrowthRateYStatic](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthRateYStatic) to get the final growth rate.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子高度的最小变化率。将在此值和 [particleGrowthRateYMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthRateYMax) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [particleGrowthRateY](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthRateY) 和 [particleGrowthRateYStatic](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthRateYStatic) 以获得最终增长率。

desc.en-US: Maximum rate of change for the width of the particles. A random value between this and [particleGrowthRateXMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthRateXMax) will be added to [particleGrowthRateX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthRateX) and [particleGrowthRateXStatic](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthRateXStatic) to get the final growth rate.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子宽度的最大变化率。将在此值和 [particleGrowthRateXMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthRateXMax) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [particleGrowthRateX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthRateX) 和 [particleGrowthRateXStatic](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthRateXStatic) 以获得最终增长率。

desc.en-US: Maximum rate of change for the height of the particles. A random value between this and [particleGrowthRateYMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthRateYMax) will be added to [particleGrowthRateY](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthRateY) and [particleGrowthRateYStatic](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthRateYStatic) to get the final growth rate.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子高度的最大变化率。将在此值和 [particleGrowthRateYMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthRateYMax) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [particleGrowthRateY](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthRateY) 和 [particleGrowthRateYStatic](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthRateYStatic) 以获得最终增长率。

desc.en-US: Minimum acceleration of change for the width of the particles. A random value between this and [particleGrowthAccelerationXMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthAccelerationXMax) will be the final growth acceleration.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子宽度变化的最小加速度。将在此值和 [particleGrowthAccelerationXMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthAccelerationXMax) 之间取一个随机值作为最终增长加速度。

desc.en-US: Minimum acceleration of change for the height of the particles. A random value between this and [particleGrowthAccelerationYMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthAccelerationYMax) will be the final growth acceleration.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子高度变化的最小加速度。将在此值和 [particleGrowthAccelerationYMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthAccelerationYMax) 之间取一个随机值作为最终增长加速度。

desc.en-US: Minimum acceleration of change for the width of the particles. A random value between this and [particleGrowthAccelerationXMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthAccelerationXMin) will be the final growth acceleration.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子宽度变化的最大加速度。将在此值和 [particleGrowthAccelerationXMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthAccelerationXMin) 之间取一个随机值作为最终增长加速度。

desc.en-US: Minimum acceleration of change for the height of the particles. A random value between this and [particleGrowthAccelerationYMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthAccelerationYMin) will be the final growth acceleration.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子高度变化的最大加速度。将在此值和 [particleGrowthAccelerationYMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleGrowthAccelerationYMin) 之间取一个随机值作为最终增长加速度。

desc.en-US: Scalar multiplier for the color that does not affect the alpha. Effectively a brightness multiplier.
desc.zh-CN: 不影响 Alpha 的颜色标量乘数。实际上是亮度乘数。

desc.en-US: Minimum random variation for the particle color. A random value between this and [colorMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.colorMax) will be added to the base [color](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.color), but it fades out over the life of the particle.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子颜色的最小随机变化。将在此值和 [colorMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.colorMax) 之间取一个随机值添加到基础 [color](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.color) 中，但它会在粒子寿命期间逐渐消失。

desc.en-US: Maximum random variation for the particle color. A random value between this and [colorMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.colorMin) will be added to the base [color](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.color), but it fades out over the life of the particle.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子颜色的最大随机变化。将在此值和 [colorMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.colorMin) 之间取一个随机值添加到基础 [color](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.color) 中，但它会在粒子寿命期间逐渐消失。

desc.en-US: To split the texture into multiple animation frames, this value must be set to the number of columns in the texture. It should equal `textureWidth / frameWidth`.
desc.zh-CN: 要将纹理分割成多个动画帧，必须将此值设置为纹理中的列数。它应等于 `textureWidth / frameWidth`。

desc.en-US: To split the texture into multiple animation frames, this value must be set to the total number of frames in the texture.
desc.zh-CN: 要将纹理分割成多个动画帧，必须将此值设置为纹理中的总帧数。

desc.en-US: When enabled, this makes each particle pick a random frame from the animation and only display that one frame.
desc.zh-CN: 当启用时，这会使每个粒子从动画中选取一个随机帧并仅显示该帧。

desc.en-US: Controls the maximum frame index when [picking a random frame to display](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.randomTextureFrame).
desc.zh-CN: 当 [选取随机帧进行显示](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.randomTextureFrame) 时，控制最大帧索引。

desc.en-US: Scalar multiplier for the size of the particles.

If enabled, the particle system stops updating if the camera is beyond the distance specified by [updateDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.updateDistance) from the node.

It will not stop updating immediately after the action becomes active. Instead, it will wait for a little while before stopping if the camera is too far away.
desc.zh-CN:
如果启用，当摄像机距离节点的距离超过 [updateDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.updateDistance) 指定的距离时，粒子系统将停止更新。

动作激活后，它不会立即停止更新。相反，如果摄像机太远，它会等待一小会儿再停止。

desc.en-US: Controls how close the camera needs to be to the node for the particle system to update. Requires [limitUpdateDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.limitUpdateDistance) to be enabled.
desc.zh-CN: 控制摄像机需要离节点多近，粒子系统才会更新。需要启用 [limitUpdateDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.limitUpdateDistance)。

desc.en-US: When enabled, this makes the particles bounce off of any surface they hit. This collision detection is just based on the depth buffer, not the full 3D scene, so it is not always perfect.
desc.zh-CN: 当启用时，这会使粒子从它们撞击的任何表面反弹。此碰撞检测仅基于深度缓冲区，而不是完整的 3D 场景，因此并不总是完美的。

desc.en-US: Controls how strong the rebound from hitting a surface is when [particleCollision](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleCollision) is enabled.
desc.zh-CN: 当启用 [particleCollision](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleCollision) 时，控制撞击表面反弹的强度。

desc.en-US: If enabled, particles will randomly make sharp turns that affect the direction of various speed and acceleration properties. Both the time between turns and the turn angle are randomized for each turn and for each particle, and they are based on [particleRandomTurnIntervalMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleRandomTurnIntervalMax) and [particleRandomTurnAngle](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleRandomTurnAngle) respectively.
desc.zh-CN: 如果启用，粒子将随机进行急转弯，影响各种速度和加速度属性的方向。每次转向的时间间隔和转向角度对于每个粒子和每次转向都是随机的，并且分别基于 [particleRandomTurnIntervalMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleRandomTurnIntervalMax) 和 [particleRandomTurnAngle](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleRandomTurnAngle)。

desc.en-US: The maximum amount of time in seconds to wait between making random turns. Due to the way this field works, the value will be rounded to the nearest 1/30s. Requires [particleRandomTurns](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleRandomTurns) to be enabled.
desc.zh-CN: 进行随机转向之间等待的最大时间（秒）。由于此字段的工作方式，该值将四舍五入到最接近的 1/30 秒。需要启用 [particleRandomTurns](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.particleRandomTurns)。

desc.en-US: If enabled, this causes the particles to orient themselves and stretch in the direction they are moving on the screen, making them almost resemble [Tracer](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionType.Tracer) particles.
desc.zh-CN: 如果启用，这将导致粒子调整方向并在屏幕上移动的方向上拉伸，使它们几乎类似于 [Tracer](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionType.Tracer) 粒子。

desc.en-US: Controls how much the particles are stretched when [traceParticles](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.traceParticles) is enabled.
desc.zh-CN: 当启用 [traceParticles](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.traceParticles) 时，控制粒子的拉伸程度。

desc.en-US: A central fraction of the emitter volume where the particles will not be trace particles. In this volume, the particles act as if [traceParticles](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.traceParticles) is disabled.
desc.zh-CN: 发射器体积的中心部分比例，在此部分中的粒子不会成为拖尾粒子。在此体积中，粒子的行为就像 [traceParticles](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.traceParticles) 被禁用一样。

desc.en-US: If enabled, this will add a billboarding sprite to the leading end of trace particles.
desc.zh-CN: 如果启用，这将向拖尾粒子的前端添加一个公告板精灵。

desc.en-US: Controls whether or not the particles have a bloom effect.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子是否具有泛光效果。

desc.en-US:
Controls the color of the additional bloom effect. The colors of the particle will be multiplied with this color to get the final color of the bloom effect.

Note:
- This has no effect if the "Effects Quality" setting is set to "Low".
- This does not affect the natural bloom effect from high color values.
desc.zh-CN:
控制额外泛光效果的颜色。粒子的颜色将与此颜色相乘，以获得泛光效果的最终颜色。

注意：
- 如果“特效质量”设置设为“低”，则此项无效。
- 这不影响高颜色值产生的自然泛光效果。

desc.en-US:
This controls a point where the opacity of a particle will start to fade to 0 near the [minimum view distance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.minDistance). At [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.minDistance), the opacity will be 0, and it will linearly approach 1 as the distance between the camera and the particle approaches this distance.

This requires [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.minDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0. This distance limit can be disabled by setting this and minDistance to -1.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子不透明度开始在 [最小视图距离](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.minDistance) 附近衰减为 0 的点。在 [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.minDistance) 处，不透明度为 0，随着摄像机与粒子之间的距离接近此距离，不透明度将线性接近 1。

这要求 [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.minDistance) 设置为正值或 0。可以通过将此值和 minDistance 设置为 -1 来禁用此距离限制。

desc.en-US:
Minimum view distance. If a particle is closer than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.

This requires [minFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.minFadeDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0.

This is different from [minDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.minDistanceThreshold), as this controls the start of a distance range that has smooth transitions at each end, while the threshold value is a hard cut-off.
desc.zh-CN:
最小视图距离。如果粒子与摄像机的距离小于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

这要求 [minFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.minFadeDistance) 设置为正值或 0。

这与 [minDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.minDistanceThreshold) 不同，因为此项控制的是两端具有平滑过渡的距离范围的起点，而阈值是硬性截止。

desc.en-US:
This controls a point where the opacity of a particle will start to fade to 0 near the [maximum view distance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.maxDistance). At [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.maxDistance), the opacity will be 0, and it will linearly approach 1 as the distance between the camera and the particle approaches this distance.

This requires [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.maxDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0. This distance limit can be disabled by setting this and maxDistance to -1.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子不透明度开始在 [最大视图距离](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.maxDistance) 附近衰减为 0 的点。在 [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.maxDistance) 处，不透明度为 0，随着摄像机与粒子之间的距离接近此距离，不透明度将线性接近 1。

这要求 [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.maxDistance) 设置为正值或 0。可以通过将此值和 maxDistance 设置为 -1 来禁用此距离限制。

desc.en-US:
Minimum view distance. If a particle is farther away than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.

This requires [maxFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.maxFadeDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0.

This is different from [maxDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.maxDistanceThreshold), as this controls the start of a distance range that has smooth transitions at each end, while the threshold value is a hard cut-off.
desc.zh-CN:
最小视图距离。如果粒子与摄像机的距离大于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

这要求 [maxFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.maxFadeDistance) 设置为正值或 0。

这与 [maxDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.maxDistanceThreshold) 不同，因为此项控制的是两端具有平滑过渡的距离范围的起点，而阈值是硬性截止。

desc.en-US: A hard cut-off point for the distance between the camera and the particle. If a particle is closer than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 摄像机与粒子之间距离的硬性截止点。如果粒子与摄像机的距离小于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US: A hard cut-off point for the distance between the camera and the particle. If a particle is farther away than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 摄像机与粒子之间距离的硬性截止点。如果粒子与摄像机的距离大于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US: Controls how dark shaded parts of the particle are.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子阴影部分的暗度。

desc.en-US:
When set to 1, this stops the particles from being shown indoors.

Other values are used in AC6, but what they do is unknown.
desc.zh-CN:
当设置为 1 时，这将停止粒子在室内显示。

AC6 中使用了其他值，但具体作用未知。

desc.en-US:
Unknown boolean.

Like in most other actions with this field, when enabled, it may stop [unk_sdt_f2_29](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.unk_sdt_f2_29) from doing whatever it is doing, but that field may also not work exactly the same in this action, so it's tricky to confirm. It can also cause some ugly "outline" effects on things seen through particles, and it may also fix an issue where some other particles can be seen through particles emitted by this action.
desc.zh-CN:
未知布尔值。

与大多数其他具有此字段的动作一样，启用时，它可能会停止 [unk_sdt_f2_29](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle.unk_sdt_f2_29) 的作用，但该字段在此动作中的工作方式可能也不完全相同，因此难以确认。它也可能会对透过粒子看到的内容产生一些难看的“轮廓”效果，并且它可能还修复了某些其他粒子可以透过此动作发射的粒子看到的问题。

desc.en-US: Controls how sharp the specular highlights are.
desc.zh-CN: 控制高光亮点的清晰度。

desc.en-US: Controls how bright the specular highlights are.

Defines a simple light shafts effect.

This is only used in Dark Souls 3. It shows up if converted for Sekiro, but it doesn't seem to work correctly in that game. It does not seem to work at all in Elden Ring or later games.
desc.zh-CN:
定义一个简单的光束效果。

这仅在《黑暗之魂3》中使用。如果转换为《只狼》会显示，但似乎在该游戏中无法正常工作。在《艾尔登法环》或后续游戏中似乎完全无法使用。
未知 标量 属性。
未知 标量 属性。
未知 四维向量 属性。
未知 四维向量 属性。
未知 四维向量 属性。
未知 标量 属性。
未知 标量 属性。
未知 标量 属性。
未知 标量 属性。
未知 标量 属性。

desc.en-US: The number of layers to use for the light shaft effect. Higher values will look better, but will probably perform worse.
desc.zh-CN: 用于光束效果的层数。较高的值看起来更好，但可能会降低性能。

desc.en-US:
Defines a GPU particle system. Similar to [GPUStandardParticle](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle), but rather than billboard particles like the other action uses, this uses "spark" particles, similar to the line particles from the [QuadLine](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#QuadLine) action, though the sparks may bend, more like the trail from a [Tracer](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer) particle. The particles emitted by this action are GPU particles, which means that a lot of them can be rendered at the same time without much impact on performance. The particles are also not affected by most things that affect regular particles, like [ParticleMovement actions](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionSlots.ParticleMovementAction).

The name is from Elden Ring's RTTI, where it is named "GXVfxSparkParticleAppearance".

This action was first used in Armored Core 6, but definitely also works in Sekiro and Elden Ring. It might work in Dark Souls 3, but its structure is at least somewhat different there, and what that structure looks like is unknown. AC6's structure is compatible with Sekiro and ER, but some features may not work due to having been added in later versions.
desc.zh-CN:
定义了一个 GPU 粒子系统。与 [GPUStandardParticle](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle) 类似，但它不像其他行为那样使用公告牌粒子，而是使用“火花”粒子，类似于 [QuadLine](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#QuadLine) 行为的线粒子，尽管火花可能会弯曲，更像 [Tracer](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer) 粒子的轨迹。此动作发射的粒子是 GPU 粒子，这意味着可以同时渲染大量粒子，而对性能影响不大。这些粒子也不受大多数影响普通粒子的事物的影响，例如 [ParticleMovement actions](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionSlots.ParticleMovementAction)。

其名称源自《艾尔登法环》的 RTTI，在那里它被命名为“GXVfxSparkParticleAppearance”。

此行为首次用于《装甲核心6》，但也肯定适用于《只狼》和《艾尔登法环》。它可能在《黑暗之魂3》中也能使用，但其结构至少在那里有所不同，并且该结构的具体情况未知。《装甲核心6》的结构与《只狼》和《艾尔登法环》兼容，但由于某些功能是在后续版本中添加的，因此可能无法正常工作。

desc.en-US: The ID of the texture of the particles.
Controls the shape of the particle emitter. See [EmitterShape](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape) for more details.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子发射器的形状。有关更多详细信息，请参阅 [EmitterShape](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape)。

desc.en-US:
Controls how the random emission points are distributed within the [shape of the emitter](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.emitterShape). How this works depend on the emitter shape: | Shape | Behavior | |-|-| | [Line](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Line) | A fraction of the line where particles can not be emitted from.
At 0, particles can be emitted from any point on the line.
At 1, they can only be emitted from the far end of the line. | | [Box](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Box) | A fraction of the box's size where the particles can not be emitted from. Basically an inner box that blocks emission. | | [Box2](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Box2) | At 1, any point within the box is equally likely to be picked.
At 0, particles are more likely to be emitted near the center, but it's not a 100% chance. | | [Unk3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Unk3) | Exactly the same as [Line](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Line)? | | [Cylinder](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Cylinder) | A fraction of the radius of the cylinder where the particles can not be emitted from. Basically an inner cylinder that blocks emission. |
desc.zh-CN:
控制随机发射点在[发射器形状](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.emitterShape)内的分布方式。其工作原理取决于发射器形状： | 形状 | 行为 | |-|-| | [线形](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Line) | 线上不能发射粒子的比例。
为 0 时，粒子可从线上任意点发射。
为 1 时，只能从线的远端发射。 | | [盒形](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Box) | 盒子尺寸中不能发射粒子的比例。基本上是一个阻挡发射的内部盒子。 | | [盒形2](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Box2) | 为 1 时，盒子内任何点被选中的几率相等。
为 0 时，粒子更有可能在中心附近发射，但不是 100% 的几率。 | | [Unk3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Unk3) | 似乎与 [线形](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Line) 完全相同？ | | [圆柱形](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Cylinder) | 圆柱体半径中不能发射粒子的比例。基本上是一个阻挡发射的内部圆柱体。 |

desc.en-US: The number of particles to emit per emission.

The minimum number of particles to emit per emission. A new random value is picked for each emission, and the random value is added to the [base emission particle count](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.emissionParticleCount).
desc.zh-CN: 每次发射的最小粒子数量。每次发射都会选取一个新的随机值，该随机值将添加到[基础发射粒子计数](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.emissionParticleCount)中。

desc.en-US: The maximum number of particles to emit per emission. A new random value is picked for each emission, and the random value is added to the [base emission particle count](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.emissionParticleCount).
desc.zh-CN: 每次发射的最大粒子数量。每次发射都会选取一个新的随机值，该随机值将添加到[基础发射粒子计数](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.emissionParticleCount)中。

desc.en-US: The time between emissions in seconds. Due to the way this field works, the value will be rounded to the nearest 1/30s.
desc.zh-CN: 发射之间的间隔时间（秒）。由于此字段的工作方式，该值将四舍五入到最接近的 1/30 秒。

desc.en-US: The minimum time between emissions in seconds. A random value between this and [emissionIntervalMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.emissionIntervalMax) will be added to [emissionInterval](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.emissionInterval) to get the final emission interval. Due to the way this field works, the value will be rounded to the nearest 1/30s.
desc.zh-CN: 发射之间的最小间隔时间（秒）。将在此值和 [emissionIntervalMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.emissionIntervalMax) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [emissionInterval](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.emissionInterval) 以获得最终发射间隔。由于此字段的工作方式，该值将四舍五入到最接近的 1/30 秒。

desc.en-US: The maximum time between emissions in seconds. A random value between this and [emissionIntervalMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.emissionIntervalMin) will be added to [emissionInterval](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.emissionInterval) to get the final emission interval. Due to the way this field works, the value will be rounded to the nearest 1/30s.
desc.zh-CN: 发射之间的最大间隔时间（秒）。将在此值和 [emissionIntervalMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.emissionIntervalMin) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [emissionInterval](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.emissionInterval) 以获得最终发射间隔。由于此字段的工作方式，该值将四舍五入到最接近的 1/30 秒。

desc.en-US: If enabled, the number of emissions will be limited by [concurrentEmissionsLimit](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.concurrentEmissionsLimit).
desc.zh-CN: 如果启用，发射次数将受到 [concurrentEmissionsLimit](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.concurrentEmissionsLimit) 的限制。

desc.en-US: The total number of emissions. This limit is only applied if [limitConcurrentEmissions](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.limitConcurrentEmissions) is enabled.
desc.zh-CN: 总发射次数。此限制仅在启用 [limitConcurrentEmissions](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.limitConcurrentEmissions) 时应用。

desc.en-US: The duration of each particle in seconds. Due to the way this field works, the value will be rounded to the nearest 1/30s.
desc.zh-CN: 每个粒子的持续时间（秒）。由于此字段的工作方式，该值将四舍五入到最接近的 1/30 秒。

desc.en-US: Minimum particle position offset. A random value between this and [particleOffsetMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.particleOffsetMax) will be added to [particleOffset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.particleOffset) to get the final position offset.
desc.zh-CN: 最小粒子位置偏移。将在此值和 [particleOffsetMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.particleOffsetMax) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [particleOffset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.particleOffset) 以获得最终位置偏移。

desc.en-US: Maximum particle position offset. A random value between this and [particleOffsetMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.particleOffsetMin) will be added to [particleOffset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.particleOffset) to get the final position offset.
desc.zh-CN: 最大粒子位置偏移。将在此值和 [particleOffsetMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.particleOffsetMin) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [particleOffset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.particleOffset) 以获得最终位置偏移。

desc.en-US: Scalar multiplier for the color that does not affect the alpha. Effectively a brightness multiplier.
desc.zh-CN: 不影响 Alpha 的颜色标量乘数。实际上是亮度乘数。

desc.en-US: Minimum random variation for the particle color. A random value between this and [colorMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.colorMax) will be added to the base [color](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.color), but it fades out over the life of the particle.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子颜色的最小随机变化。将在此值和 [colorMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.colorMax) 之间取一个随机值添加到基础 [color](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.color) 中，但它会在粒子寿命期间逐渐消失。

desc.en-US: Maximum random variation for the particle color. A random value between this and [colorMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.colorMin) will be added to the base [color](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.color), but it fades out over the life of the particle.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子颜色的最大随机变化。将在此值和 [colorMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.colorMin) 之间取一个随机值添加到基础 [color](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.color) 中，但它会在粒子寿命期间逐渐消失。

desc.en-US: Minimum particle length. A random value between this and [particleLengthMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.particleLengthMax) will be **multiplied** by [particleLength](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.particleLength) to get the final particle length.
desc.zh-CN: 最小粒子长度。将在此值和 [particleLengthMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.particleLengthMax) 之间取一个随机值并**乘以** [particleLength](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.particleLength) 以获得最终粒子长度。

desc.en-US: Maximum particle length. A random value between this and [particleLengthMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.particleLengthMin) will be **multiplied** by [particleLength](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.particleLength) to get the final particle length.
desc.zh-CN: 最大粒子长度。将在此值和 [particleLengthMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.particleLengthMin) 之间取一个随机值并**乘以** [particleLength](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.particleLength) 以获得最终粒子长度。

desc.en-US: Minimum particle width. A random value between this and [particleWidthMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.particleWidthMax) will be **multiplied** by [particleWidth](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.particleWidth) to get the final particle width.
desc.zh-CN: 最小粒子宽度。将在此值和 [particleWidthMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.particleWidthMax) 之间取一个随机值并**乘以** [particleWidth](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.particleWidth) 以获得最终粒子宽度。

desc.en-US: Maximum particle width. A random value between this and [particleWidthMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.particleWidthMin) will be **multiplied** by [particleWidth](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.particleWidth) to get the final particle width.
desc.zh-CN: 最大粒子宽度。将在此值和 [particleWidthMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.particleWidthMin) 之间取一个随机值并**乘以** [particleWidth](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.particleWidth) 以获得最终粒子宽度。

desc.en-US: Unknown float. Seems to make the particles fly around somewhat randomly, but with a specific average direction. [unk_ac6_f1_85](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.unk_ac6_f1_85) works in a similar way, but has the opposite average direction.
desc.zh-CN: 未知浮点数。似乎使粒子在某种程度上随机飞来飞去，但具有特定的平均方向。[unk_ac6_f1_85](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.unk_ac6_f1_85) 以类似的方式工作，但平均方向相反。

desc.en-US: Unknown float. Seems to make the particles fly around somewhat randomly, but with a specific average direction. [unk_ac6_f1_84](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.unk_ac6_f1_84) works in a similar way, but has the opposite average direction.
desc.zh-CN: 未知浮点数。似乎使粒子在某种程度上随机飞来飞去，但具有特定的平均方向。[unk_ac6_f1_84](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.unk_ac6_f1_84) 以类似的方式工作，但平均方向相反。

desc.en-US:
If enabled, the particle system stops updating if the camera is beyond the distance specified by [updateDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.updateDistance) from the node.

It will not stop updating immediately after the action becomes active. Instead, it will wait for a little while before stopping if the camera is too far away.
desc.zh-CN:
如果启用，当摄像机距离节点的距离超过 [updateDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.updateDistance) 指定的距离时，粒子系统将停止更新。

动作激活后，它不会立即停止更新。相反，如果摄像机太远，它会等待一小会儿再停止。

desc.en-US: Controls how close the camera needs to be to the node for the particle system to update. Requires [limitUpdateDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.limitUpdateDistance) to be enabled.
desc.zh-CN: 控制摄像机需要离节点多近，粒子系统才会更新。需要启用 [limitUpdateDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.limitUpdateDistance)。

desc.en-US: When enabled, this makes the particles bounce off of any surface they hit. This collision detection is just based on the depth buffer, not the full 3D scene, so it is not always perfect.
desc.zh-CN: 当启用时，这会使粒子从它们撞击的任何表面反弹。此碰撞检测仅基于深度缓冲区，而不是完整的 3D 场景，因此并不总是完美的。

desc.en-US: Controls how strong the rebound from hitting a surface is when [particleCollision](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.particleCollision) is enabled.
desc.zh-CN: 当启用 [particleCollision](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.particleCollision) 时，控制撞击表面反弹的强度。

desc.en-US: Controls whether or not the particles have a bloom effect.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子是否具有泛光效果。

desc.en-US:
Controls the color of the additional bloom effect. The colors of the particle will be multiplied with this color to get the final color of the bloom effect.

Note:
- This has no effect if the "Effects Quality" setting is set to "Low".
- This does not affect the natural bloom effect from high color values.
desc.zh-CN:
控制额外泛光效果的颜色。粒子的颜色将与此颜色相乘，以获得泛光效果的最终颜色。

注意：
- 如果“特效质量”设置设为“低”，则此项无效。
- 这不影响高颜色值产生的自然泛光效果。

desc.en-US:
Minimum view distance. If a particle is closer than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.

This requires [minFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.minFadeDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0.

This is different from [minDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.minDistanceThreshold), as this controls the start of a distance range that has smooth transitions at each end, while the threshold value is a hard cut-off.
desc.zh-CN:
最小视图距离。如果粒子与摄像机的距离小于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

这要求 [minFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.minFadeDistance) 设置为正值或 0。

这与 [minDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.minDistanceThreshold) 不同，因为此项控制的是两端具有平滑过渡的距离范围的起点，而阈值是硬性截止。

desc.en-US:
This controls a point where the opacity of a particle will start to fade to 0 near the [minimum view distance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.minDistance). At [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.minDistance), the opacity will be 0, and it will linearly approach 1 as the distance between the camera and the particle approaches this distance.

This requires [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.minDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0. This distance limit can be disabled by setting this and minDistance to -1.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子不透明度开始在 [最小视图距离](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.minDistance) 附近衰减为 0 的点。在 [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.minDistance) 处，不透明度为 0，随着摄像机与粒子之间的距离接近此距离，不透明度将线性接近 1。

这要求 [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.minDistance) 设置为正值或 0。可以通过将此值和 minDistance 设置为 -1 来禁用此距离限制。

desc.en-US:
This controls a point where the opacity of a particle will start to fade to 0 near the [maximum view distance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.maxDistance). At [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.maxDistance), the opacity will be 0, and it will linearly approach 1 as the distance between the camera and the particle approaches this distance.

This requires [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.maxDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0. This distance limit can be disabled by setting this and maxDistance to -1.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子不透明度开始在 [最大视图距离](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.maxDistance) 附近衰减为 0 的点。在 [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.maxDistance) 处，不透明度为 0，随着摄像机与粒子之间的距离接近此距离，不透明度将线性接近 1。

这要求 [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.maxDistance) 设置为正值或 0。可以通过将此值和 maxDistance 设置为 -1 来禁用此距离限制。

desc.en-US:
Minimum view distance. If a particle is farther away than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.

This requires [maxFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.maxFadeDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0.

This is different from [maxDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.maxDistanceThreshold), as this controls the start of a distance range that has smooth transitions at each end, while the threshold value is a hard cut-off.
desc.zh-CN:
最小视图距离。如果粒子与摄像机的距离大于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

这要求 [maxFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.maxFadeDistance) 设置为正值或 0。

这与 [maxDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle.maxDistanceThreshold) 不同，因为此项控制的是两端具有平滑过渡的距离范围的起点，而阈值是硬性截止。

desc.en-US: A hard cut-off point for the distance between the camera and the particle. If a particle is closer than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 摄像机与粒子之间距离的硬性截止点。如果粒子与摄像机的距离小于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US: A hard cut-off point for the distance between the camera and the particle. If a particle is farther away than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 摄像机与粒子之间距离的硬性截止点。如果粒子与摄像机的距离大于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US: Controls how dark shaded parts of the particle are.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子阴影部分的暗度。
