desc.en-US:
Defines a GPU particle system. Very similar to [GPUSparkParticle](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle), just like how [GPUStandardCorrectParticle](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle) is similar to [GPUStandardParticle](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle), except these two spark actions have some known differences.

Not all of the differences have been documented yet, but this is some of them:
- This action seems to have swapped some axes of rotation, causing some confusing things to happen when the node is spinning.
- The particles from this action are smaller.
- The particles from this action move slower. It's possible that this action uses a different unit of distance, since that would explain both the slower movement and the smaller particles.

The name is from Elden Ring's RTTI, where it is named "GXVfxSparkCorrectParticleAppearance".
desc.zh-CN:
定义了一个GPU粒子系统。它与[GPUSparkParticle](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkParticle)非常相似，就像[GPUStandardCorrectParticle](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardCorrectParticle)与[GPUStandardParticle](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUStandardParticle)的相似关系一样，只是这两种火花行为有一些已知的差异。

并非所有的差异都有记录，但以下是一些已知的差异：
- 此行为作似乎交换了一些旋转轴，导致节点旋转时发生一些令人困惑的事情。
- 此行为产生的粒子更小。
-  此行为产生的粒子移动更慢。可能是因为此行为使用了不同的距离单位，因为这样既能解释移动更慢，也能解释粒子更小。

该名称来自《艾尔登法环》的RTTI，其中它被命名为“GXVfxSparkCorrectParticleAppearance”。

desc.en-US: The ID of the texture of the particles.
Controls the shape of the particle emitter. See [EmitterShape](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape) for more details.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子发射器的形状。有关更多详细信息，请参阅 [EmitterShape](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape)。

desc.en-US:
Controls how the random emission points are distributed within the [shape of the emitter](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.emitterShape). How this works depend on the emitter shape: | Shape | Behavior | |-|-| | [Line](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Line) | A fraction of the line where particles can not be emitted from.
At 0, particles can be emitted from any point on the line.
At 1, they can only be emitted from the far end of the line. | | [Box](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Box) | A fraction of the box's size where the particles can not be emitted from. Basically an inner box that blocks emission. | | [Box2](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Box2) | At 1, any point within the box is equally likely to be picked.
At 0, particles are more likely to be emitted near the center, but it's not a 100% chance. | | [Unk3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Unk3) | Exactly the same as [Line](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Line)? | | [Cylinder](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Cylinder) | A fraction of the radius of the cylinder where the particles can not be emitted from. Basically an inner cylinder that blocks emission. |
desc.zh-CN:
控制随机发射点在[发射器形状](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.emitterShape)内的分布方式。其工作原理取决于发射器形状： | 形状 | 行为 | |-|-| | [线形](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Line) | 线上不能发射粒子的比例。
为 0 时，粒子可从线上任意点发射。
为 1 时，只能从线的远端发射。 | | [盒形](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Box) | 盒子尺寸中不能发射粒子的比例。基本上是一个阻挡发射的内部盒子。 | | [盒形2](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Box2) | 为 1 时，盒子内任何点被选中的几率相等。
为 0 时，粒子更有可能在中心附近发射，但不是 100% 的几率。 | | [Unk3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Unk3) | 似乎与 [线形](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Line) 完全相同？ | | [圆柱形](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#EmitterShape.Cylinder) | 圆柱体半径中不能发射粒子的比例。基本上是一个阻挡发射的内部圆柱体。 |

desc.en-US: The number of particles to emit per emission.

The minimum number of particles to emit per emission. A new random value is picked for each emission, and the random value is added to the [base emission particle count](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.emissionParticleCount).
desc.zh-CN: 每次发射的最小粒子数量。每次发射都会选取一个新的随机值，该随机值将添加到[基础发射粒子计数](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.emissionParticleCount)中。

desc.en-US: The maximum number of particles to emit per emission. A new random value is picked for each emission, and the random value is added to the [base emission particle count](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.emissionParticleCount).
desc.zh-CN: 每次发射的最大粒子数量。每次发射都会选取一个新的随机值，该随机值将添加到[基础发射粒子计数](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.emissionParticleCount)中。

desc.en-US: The time between emissions in seconds. Due to the way this field works, the value will be rounded to the nearest 1/30s.
desc.zh-CN: 发射之间的间隔时间（秒）。由于此字段的工作方式，该值将四舍五入到最接近的 1/30 秒。

desc.en-US: The minimum time between emissions in seconds. A random value between this and [emissionIntervalMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.emissionIntervalMax) will be added to [emissionInterval](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.emissionInterval) to get the final emission interval. Due to the way this field works, the value will be rounded to the nearest 1/30s.
desc.zh-CN: 发射之间的最小间隔时间（秒）。将在此值和 [emissionIntervalMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.emissionIntervalMax) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [emissionInterval](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.emissionInterval) 以获得最终发射间隔。由于此字段的工作方式，该值将四舍五入到最接近的 1/30 秒。

desc.en-US: The maximum time between emissions in seconds. A random value between this and [emissionIntervalMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.emissionIntervalMin) will be added to [emissionInterval](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.emissionInterval) to get the final emission interval. Due to the way this field works, the value will be rounded to the nearest 1/30s.
desc.zh-CN: 发射之间的最大间隔时间（秒）。将在此值和 [emissionIntervalMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.emissionIntervalMin) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [emissionInterval](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.emissionInterval) 以获得最终发射间隔。由于此字段的工作方式，该值将四舍五入到最接近的 1/30 秒。

desc.en-US: If enabled, the number of emissions will be limited by [concurrentEmissionsLimit](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.concurrentEmissionsLimit).
desc.zh-CN: 如果启用，发射次数将受到 [concurrentEmissionsLimit](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.concurrentEmissionsLimit) 的限制。

desc.en-US: The total number of emissions. This limit is only applied if [limitConcurrentEmissions](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.limitConcurrentEmissions) is enabled.
desc.zh-CN: 总发射次数。此限制仅在启用 [limitConcurrentEmissions](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.limitConcurrentEmissions) 时应用。

desc.en-US: The duration of each particle in seconds. Due to the way this field works, the value will be rounded to the nearest 1/30s.
desc.zh-CN: 每个粒子的持续时间（秒）。由于此字段的工作方式，该值将四舍五入到最接近的 1/30 秒。

desc.en-US: Minimum particle position offset. A random value between this and [particleOffsetMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.particleOffsetMax) will be added to [particleOffset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.particleOffset) to get the final position offset.
desc.zh-CN: 最小粒子位置偏移。将在此值和 [particleOffsetMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.particleOffsetMax) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [particleOffset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.particleOffset) 以获得最终位置偏移。

desc.en-US: Maximum particle position offset. A random value between this and [particleOffsetMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.particleOffsetMin) will be added to [particleOffset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.particleOffset) to get the final position offset.
desc.zh-CN: 最大粒子位置偏移。将在此值和 [particleOffsetMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.particleOffsetMin) 之间取一个随机值添加到 [particleOffset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.particleOffset) 以获得最终位置偏移。

desc.en-US: Scalar multiplier for the color that does not affect the alpha. Effectively a brightness multiplier.
desc.zh-CN: 不影响 Alpha 的颜色标量乘数。实际上是亮度乘数。

desc.en-US: Minimum random variation for the particle color. A random value between this and [colorMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.colorMax) will be added to the base [color](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.color), but it fades out over the life of the particle.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子颜色的最小随机变化。将在此值和 [colorMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.colorMax) 之间取一个随机值添加到基础 [color](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.color) 中，但它会在粒子寿命期间逐渐消失。

desc.en-US: Maximum random variation for the particle color. A random value between this and [colorMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.colorMin) will be added to the base [color](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.color), but it fades out over the life of the particle.
desc.zh-CN: 粒子颜色的最大随机变化。将在此值和 [colorMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.colorMin) 之间取一个随机值添加到基础 [color](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.color) 中，但它会在粒子寿命期间逐渐消失。

desc.en-US: Minimum particle length. A random value between this and [particleLengthMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.particleLengthMax) will be **multiplied** by [particleLength](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.particleLength) to get the final particle length.
desc.zh-CN: 最小粒子长度。将在此值和 [particleLengthMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.particleLengthMax) 之间取一个随机值并**乘以** [particleLength](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.particleLength) 以获得最终粒子长度。

desc.en-US: Maximum particle length. A random value between this and [particleLengthMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.particleLengthMin) will be **multiplied** by [particleLength](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.particleLength) to get the final particle length.
desc.zh-CN: 最大粒子长度。将在此值和 [particleLengthMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.particleLengthMin) 之间取一个随机值并**乘以** [particleLength](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.particleLength) 以获得最终粒子长度。

desc.en-US: Minimum particle width. A random value between this and [particleWidthMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.particleWidthMax) will be **multiplied** by [particleWidth](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.particleWidth) to get the final particle width.
desc.zh-CN: 最小粒子宽度。将在此值和 [particleWidthMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.particleWidthMax) 之间取一个随机值并**乘以** [particleWidth](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.particleWidth) 以获得最终粒子宽度。

desc.en-US: Maximum particle width. A random value between this and [particleWidthMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.particleWidthMin) will be **multiplied** by [particleWidth](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.particleWidth) to get the final particle width.
desc.zh-CN: 最大粒子宽度。将在此值和 [particleWidthMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.particleWidthMin) 之间取一个随机值并**乘以** [particleWidth](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.particleWidth) 以获得最终粒子宽度。

desc.en-US: Unknown float. Seems to make the particles fly around somewhat randomly, but with a specific average direction. [unk_ac6_f1_85](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.unk_ac6_f1_85) works in a similar way, but has the opposite average direction.
desc.zh-CN: 未知浮点数。似乎使粒子在某种程度上随机飞来飞去，但具有特定的平均方向。[unk_ac6_f1_85](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.unk_ac6_f1_85) 以类似的方式工作，但平均方向相反。

desc.en-US: Unknown float. Seems to make the particles fly around somewhat randomly, but with a specific average direction. [unk_ac6_f1_84](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.unk_ac6_f1_84) works in a similar way, but has the opposite average direction.
desc.zh-CN: 未知浮点数。似乎使粒子在某种程度上随机飞来飞去，但具有特定的平均方向。[unk_ac6_f1_84](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.unk_ac6_f1_84) 以类似的方式工作，但平均方向相反。

desc.en-US:
If enabled, the particle system stops updating if the camera is beyond the distance specified by [updateDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.updateDistance) from the node.

It will not stop updating immediately after the action becomes active. Instead, it will wait for a little while before stopping if the camera is too far away.
desc.zh-CN:
如果启用，当摄像机距离节点的距离超过 [updateDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.updateDistance) 指定的距离时，粒子系统将停止更新。

动作激活后，它不会立即停止更新。相反，如果摄像机太远，它会等待一小会儿再停止。

desc.en-US: Controls how close the camera needs to be to the node for the particle system to update. Requires [limitUpdateDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.limitUpdateDistance) to be enabled.
desc.zh-CN: 控制摄像机需要离节点多近，粒子系统才会更新。需要启用 [limitUpdateDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.limitUpdateDistance)。

desc.en-US: When enabled, this makes the particles bounce off of any surface they hit. This collision detection is just based on the depth buffer, not the full 3D scene, so it is not always perfect.
desc.zh-CN: 当启用时，这会使粒子从它们撞击的任何表面反弹。此碰撞检测仅基于深度缓冲区，而不是完整的 3D 场景，因此并不总是完美的。

desc.en-US: Controls how strong the rebound from hitting a surface is when [particleCollision](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.particleCollision) is enabled.
desc.zh-CN: 当启用 [particleCollision](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.particleCollision) 时，控制撞击表面反弹的强度。

desc.en-US: Controls whether or not the particles have a bloom effect.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子是否具有泛光效果。

desc.en-US:
Controls the color of the additional bloom effect. The colors of the particle will be multiplied with this color to get the final color of the bloom effect.

Note:
- This has no effect if the "Effects Quality" setting is set to "Low".
- This does not affect the natural bloom effect from high color values.
desc.zh-CN:
控制额外泛光效果的颜色。粒子的颜色将与此颜色相乘，以获得泛光效果的最终颜色。

注意：
- 如果“特效质量”设置设为“低”，则此项无效。
- 这不影响高颜色值产生的自然泛光效果。

desc.en-US:
Minimum view distance. If a particle is closer than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.

This requires [minFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.minFadeDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0.

This is different from [minDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.minDistanceThreshold), as this controls the start of a distance range that has smooth transitions at each end, while the threshold value is a hard cut-off.
desc.zh-CN:
最小视图距离。如果粒子与摄像机的距离小于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

这要求 [minFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.minFadeDistance) 设置为正值或 0。

这与 [minDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.minDistanceThreshold) 不同，因为此项控制的是两端具有平滑过渡的距离范围的起点，而阈值是硬性截止。

desc.en-US:
This controls a point where the opacity of a particle will start to fade to 0 near the [minimum view distance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.minDistance). At [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.minDistance), the opacity will be 0, and it will linearly approach 1 as the distance between the camera and the particle approaches this distance.

This requires [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.minDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0. This distance limit can be disabled by setting this and minDistance to -1.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子不透明度开始在 [最小视图距离](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.minDistance) 附近衰减为 0 的点。在 [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.minDistance) 处，不透明度为 0，随着摄像机与粒子之间的距离接近此距离，不透明度将线性接近 1。

这要求 [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.minDistance) 设置为正值或 0。可以通过将此值和 minDistance 设置为 -1 来禁用此距离限制。

desc.en-US:
This controls a point where the opacity of a particle will start to fade to 0 near the [maximum view distance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.maxDistance). At [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.maxDistance), the opacity will be 0, and it will linearly approach 1 as the distance between the camera and the particle approaches this distance.

This requires [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.maxDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0. This distance limit can be disabled by setting this and maxDistance to -1.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子不透明度开始在 [最大视图距离](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.maxDistance) 附近衰减为 0 的点。在 [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.maxDistance) 处，不透明度为 0，随着摄像机与粒子之间的距离接近此距离，不透明度将线性接近 1。

这要求 [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.maxDistance) 设置为正值或 0。可以通过将此值和 maxDistance 设置为 -1 来禁用此距离限制。

desc.en-US:
Minimum view distance. If a particle is farther away than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.

This requires [maxFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.maxFadeDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0.

This is different from [maxDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.maxDistanceThreshold), as this controls the start of a distance range that has smooth transitions at each end, while the threshold value is a hard cut-off.
desc.zh-CN:
最小视图距离。如果粒子与摄像机的距离大于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

这要求 [maxFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.maxFadeDistance) 设置为正值或 0。

这与 [maxDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GPUSparkCorrectParticle.maxDistanceThreshold) 不同，因为此项控制的是两端具有平滑过渡的距离范围的起点，而阈值是硬性截止。

desc.en-US: A hard cut-off point for the distance between the camera and the particle. If a particle is closer than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 摄像机与粒子之间距离的硬性截止点。如果粒子与摄像机的距离小于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US: A hard cut-off point for the distance between the camera and the particle. If a particle is farther away than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 摄像机与粒子之间距离的硬性截止点。如果粒子与摄像机的距离大于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US: Controls how dark shaded parts of the particle are.
desc.zh-CN: 控制粒子阴影部分的暗度。

desc.en-US:
When set to 1, this stops the particles from being shown indoors.

Other values are used in AC6, but what they do is unknown.
desc.zh-CN:
当设置为 1 时，这将停止粒子在室内显示。

AC6 中使用了其他值，但具体作用未知。

desc.en-US:
Defines a tracer particle, which leaves a textured trail where it moves.

This is a newer version of [LegacyTracer](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer) with more features, like being able to make the opacity of the trail be based on the movement speed of the particle.

The name is from Elden Ring's RTTI, where it is named "GXFfxAppearanceTracer".
desc.zh-CN:
定义一个追踪粒子，粒子移动时会留下带有纹理的轨迹。

这是 [LegacyTracer](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LegacyTracer) 的新版本，具有更多功能，例如可以使轨迹的不透明度基于粒子的移动速度。
  
该名称来自艾尔登法环的 RTTI，在那里它被命名为 “GXFfxAppearanceTracer”。

desc.en-US:
Percentage along the trail from the start of the trail where the trail's opacity will start fading out towards the start. The trail will have 0 opacity at the start, and it will linearly increase towards full opacity at the point represented by this percentage.

The percentage is of the way from the start of the trail to the end of it, so if the trail gets longer or shorter, this point will move with it.

Values greater than 100 will make the trail never reach full opacity. For example, a value of 200 will make the trail fade from 0 opacity at the start to 50% (100% / 200%) at the end of the trail.

If this value and [endFadeEndpoint](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.endFadeEndpoint) sum to a value greater than 100, the trail will be "split" at the point controlled by this value and each part will fade separately based on the repsective value. For example, if this is set to 50 and [endFadeEndpoint](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.endFadeEndpoint) is 1000, the first half of the trail will fade normally from 0 opacity at the start to full opacity at the mid point, but the other half will fade from 5% opacity ((100% - 50%) / 1000%) at the mid point to 0 at the end. Where the two parts meet, the opacity will fade from one to the other across a single segment of the trail.
desc.zh-CN:
沿拖尾从起点开始的百分比，拖尾的不透明度将在此处开始向起点衰减。拖尾在起点的透明度为 0，并将在该百分比代表的点线性增加到完全不透明。

该百分比是从拖尾起点到终点的路程，因此如果拖尾变长或变短，该点也会随之移动。

大于 100 的值将使拖尾永远无法达到完全不透明。例如，值为 200 将使拖尾从起点的 0 不透明度淡化到终点的 50% (100% / 200%)。

如果此值与 [endFadeEndpoint](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.endFadeEndpoint) 之和大于 100，拖尾将在此值控制的点处“分裂”，每部分将根据各自的值单独衰减。例如，如果此值设置为 50 而 [endFadeEndpoint](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.endFadeEndpoint) 为 1000，则拖尾的前半部分将正常地从起点的 0 不透明度淡化到中点的完全不透明，但另一半将从中点的 5% 不透明度 ((100% - 50%) / 1000%) 淡化到终点的 0。在两部分相遇的地方，不透明度将在拖尾的单个段上从一个过渡到另一个。

desc.en-US:
Percentage along the trail from the end of the trail where the trail's opacity will start fading out towards the end. The trail will have full opacity at the point represented by this percentage, and it will linearly decrease towards 0 opacity at the end.

The percentage is of the way from the end of the trail to the start of it, so if the trail gets longer or shorter, this point will move with it.

Values greater than 100 will make the trail never reach full opacity. For example, a value of 200 will make the trail fade from 0 opacity at the end to 50% (100% / 200%) at the start of the trail.

If this value and [startFadeEndpoint](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.startFadeEndpoint) sum to a value greater than 100, the trail will be "split" at the point controlled by [startFadeEndpoint](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.startFadeEndpoint) and each part will fade separately based on the repsective value. For example, if [startFadeEndpoint](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.startFadeEndpoint) is set to 50 and this is 1000, the first half of the trail will fade normally from 0 opacity at the start to full opacity at the mid point, but the other half will fade from 5% opacity ((100% - 50%) / 1000%) at the mid point to 0 at the end. Where the two parts meet, the opacity will fade from one to the other across a single segment of the trail.
desc.zh-CN:
沿拖尾从终点开始的百分比，拖尾的不透明度将在此处开始向终点衰减。拖尾在该百分比代表的点处将完全不透明，并在终点处线性减少到 0 不透明度。

该百分比是从拖尾终点到起点的路程，因此如果拖尾变长或变短，该点也会随之移动。

大于 100 的值将使拖尾永远无法达到完全不透明。例如，值为 200 将使拖尾从终点的 0 不透明度淡化到起点的 50% (100% / 200%)。

如果此值与 [startFadeEndpoint](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.startFadeEndpoint) 之和大于 100，拖尾将在 [startFadeEndpoint](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.startFadeEndpoint) 控制的点处“分裂”，每部分将根据各自的值单独衰减。例如，如果 [startFadeEndpoint](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.startFadeEndpoint) 设置为 50 而此值为 1000，则拖尾的前半部分将正常地从起点的 0 不透明度淡化到中点的完全不透明，但另一半将从中点的 5% 不透明度 ((100% - 50%) / 1000%) 淡化到终点的 0。在两部分相遇的地方，不透明度将在拖尾的单个段上从一个过渡到另一个。

desc.en-US:
Color multiplier.

Values in this will be clamped to the 0-1 range. To use values outside of this range, see [color3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.color3).
desc.zh-CN:
颜色乘数。

此处的数值将被限制在 0-1 范围内。要使用超出此范围的值，请参阅 [color3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.color3)。

desc.en-US:
Color multiplier.

Values in this will be clamped to the 0-1 range. There is no equivalent property with unrestricted values based on the emission time of the particle, but [color3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.color3) is still multiplicative with this and can be used to scale the values indirectly.
desc.zh-CN:
颜色乘数。

此处的数值将被限制在 0-1 范围内。虽然没有基于粒子发射时间的不受限制值的等效属性，但 [color3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.color3) 仍可与其相乘，并可用于间接缩放数值。

desc.en-US:
Color multiplier.

Values in this are unrestricted and can go above 1. If you want values to be clamped to the 0-1 range, see [color1](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.color1).
desc.zh-CN:
颜色乘数。

此处的数值不设限，可以超过 1。如果希望将数值限制在 0-1 范围内，请参阅 [color1](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.color1)。

desc.en-US:
Parts of the particle with less opacity than this threshold will be invisible. The range is 0-255.

Values above this threshold will be stretched to fill the alpha range, so values near the threshold will be less visible, creating a smooth transition between the parts that have been hidden by the threshold and the ones that are still visible.
desc.zh-CN:
不透明度低于此阈值的粒子部分将不可见。范围是 0-255。

高于此阈值的值将被拉伸以填充 Alpha 范围，因此接近阈值的值将不太明显，从而在被阈值隐藏的部分和仍然可见的部分之间创建平滑过渡。

desc.en-US:
The index of the frame to show from the texture atlas. Can be animated using a [linear property](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PropertyFunction.Linear) or similar.

Seemingly identical to [frameIndexOffset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.frameIndexOffset)? The sum of these two properties is the actual frame index that gets used.
desc.zh-CN:
要从纹理图集中显示的帧索引。可以使用 [线性属性](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#PropertyFunction.Linear)或类似属性进行动画处理。

似乎与 [frameIndexOffset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.frameIndexOffset) 相同？这两个属性的总和是实际使用的帧索引。

desc.en-US: Seemingly identical to [frameIndex](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.frameIndex)? The sum of these two properties is the actual frame index that gets used.
desc.zh-CN: 似乎与 [frameIndex](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.frameIndex) 相同？这两个属性的总和是实际使用的帧索引。

desc.en-US: Controls how much of the texture's width is used per segment. If [attachedUV](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.attachedUV) is enabled, this instead controls how much of the texture's width to use for the entire trail.
desc.zh-CN: 控制每一段使用的纹理宽度比例。如果启用了 [attachedUV](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.attachedUV)，则改为控制整个拖尾使用的纹理宽度比例。

desc.en-US: Controls how fast the UV coordinates should move horizontally.
desc.zh-CN: 控制 UV 坐标水平移动的速度。

desc.en-US: Controls how much the UV coordinates should be randomly offset by per segment.
desc.zh-CN: 控制每段 UV 坐标随机偏移的量。
未知 标量 属性。

desc.en-US: Scalar multiplier for the color that does not affect the alpha. Effectively a brightness multiplier.
desc.zh-CN: 不影响 Alpha 的颜色标量乘数。实际上是亮度乘数。

desc.en-US: Controls the intensity of the distortion effect. At 0, there is no distortion at all.
desc.zh-CN: 控制扭曲效果的强度。为 0 时，完全没有扭曲。
未知 四维向量 属性。
未知 四维向量 属性。
未知 四维向量 属性。

desc.en-US:
Parts of the particle with less opacity than this threshold will be invisible. The range is 0-255.

This threshold creates a hard cut-off between visible and not visible, which is unlike the [alphaFadeThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.alphaFadeThreshold).
desc.zh-CN:
不透明度低于此阈值的粒子部分将不可见。范围是 0-255。

此阈值在可见和不可见之间创建一个硬性截止，这与 [alphaFadeThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.alphaFadeThreshold) 不同。

desc.en-US: Tracer orientation mode. See [TracerOrientationMode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TracerOrientationMode) for more information.
desc.zh-CN: 拖尾朝向模式。有关更多信息，请参阅 [TracerOrientationMode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TracerOrientationMode)。

desc.en-US:
Normal map texture ID.

This is used to control the distortion effect of the trail.
desc.zh-CN:
法线贴图纹理 ID。

这用于控制拖尾的扭曲效果。

desc.en-US: The trail is made up of multiple quads, or *segments*. This controls how many seconds to wait between new segments being created. Lower values produce a smoother trail.
desc.zh-CN: 拖尾由多个四边形或*段*组成。此项控制创建新段之间等待的秒数。较低的值会产生更平滑的拖尾。

desc.en-US: The trail is made up of multiple quads, or *segments*. This controls how long each segment should last in seconds.
desc.zh-CN: 拖尾由多个四边形或*段*组成。此项控制每个段应持续的秒数。

desc.en-US: The trail is made up of multiple quads, or *segments*. This controls how many segments may exist at the same time.
desc.zh-CN: 拖尾由多个四边形或*段*组成。此项控制同一时间可能存在的段数。

desc.en-US:
The trail is made up of multiple quads, or *segments*. This controls how many times each completed segment should be subdivided. Higher values makes the trail look smoother.

A "completed" segment is any segment that is not the leading one. The leading segment has one side attached to the end of the previous segment and the other attached to the tracer source, and is always a simple quad.
desc.zh-CN:
拖尾由多个四边形或*段*组成。此项控制每个完成的段应细分的次数。较高的值使拖尾看起来更平滑。

“完成”的段是指除引导段以外的任何段。引导段的一侧连接到前一段的末端，另一侧连接到拖尾源，并且始终是一个简单的四边形。

desc.en-US: When the particle is meant to terminate, the trail will linger for this many seconds and its opacity will fade to 0 in that time.
desc.zh-CN: 当粒子即将终止时，拖尾将停留这么多秒，并且其不透明度将在这段时间内衰减为 0。

desc.en-US: To split the texture into multiple animation frames, this value must be set to the number of columns in the texture. It should equal `textureWidth / frameWidth`.
desc.zh-CN: 要将纹理分割成多个动画帧，必须将此值设置为纹理中的列数。它应等于 `textureWidth / frameWidth`。

desc.en-US: To split the texture into multiple animation frames, this value must be set to the total number of frames in the texture.
desc.zh-CN: 要将纹理分割成多个动画帧，必须将此值设置为纹理中的总帧数。

desc.en-US: Controls whether or not the UV of the trail should be attached to the node or not. If it is attached, the texture will slide along the segments to follow the source wherever it moves, as if it was a flag attached to a pole. If it is not attached, the texture will stay where it was when the segment was created, like a skid mark on a road where the road is the segments and the mark is the texture, it wouldn't follow the car/node that made it.
desc.zh-CN: 控制拖尾的 UV 是否应附着到节点。如果附着，纹理将沿着段滑动以跟随源的移动，就像旗帜附着在旗杆上一样。如果不附着，纹理将停留在创建段时的位置，就像道路上的刹车痕迹，道路是段，痕迹是纹理，它不会跟随制造它的汽车/节点。

desc.en-US: When `true`, this will cause the trail's opacity to be based on the speed it's moving at. This dynamic opacity is per-segment, so each segment will remember what speed the tracer source had when the segment was created.
desc.zh-CN: 当为 `true` 时，这将导致拖尾的不透明度基于其移动速度。此动态不透明度是基于段的，因此每个段都将记住创建该段时拖尾源的速度。

desc.en-US: Maximum random horizontal offset for the UV.
desc.zh-CN: UV 的最大随机水平偏移。
未知整数。可能是布尔值？

desc.en-US:
Controls whether or not the particles have an additional bloom effect controlled by [bloomColor](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.bloomColor).

When enabled, this also allows bloom from other particles to be seen through this particle.

Note:
- This has no effect if the "Effects Quality" setting is set to "Low".
- This does not affect the natural bloom effect from high color values.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子是否具有由 [bloomColor](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.bloomColor) 控制的额外泛光效果。

启用时，这也允许透过此粒子看到其他粒子的泛光。

注意：
- 如果“特效质量”设置设为“低”，则此项无效。
- 这不影响高颜色值产生的自然泛光效果。

desc.en-US:
Controls the color of the additional bloom effect. The colors of the particle will be multiplied with this color to get the final color of the bloom effect.

Note:
- This has no effect if the "Effects Quality" setting is set to "Low".
- This does not affect the natural bloom effect from high color values.
desc.zh-CN:
控制额外泛光效果的颜色。粒子的颜色将与此颜色相乘，以获得泛光效果的最终颜色。

注意：
- 如果“特效质量”设置设为“低”，则此项无效。
- 这不影响高颜色值产生的自然泛光效果。

desc.en-US:
This controls a point where the opacity of a particle will start to fade to 0 near the [minimum view distance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.minDistance). At [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.minDistance), the opacity will be 0, and it will linearly approach 1 as the distance between the camera and the particle approaches this distance.

This requires [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.minDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0. This distance limit can be disabled by setting this and minDistance to -1.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子不透明度开始在 [最小视图距离](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.minDistance) 附近衰减为 0 的点。在 [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.minDistance) 处，不透明度为 0，随着摄像机与粒子之间的距离接近此距离，不透明度将线性接近 1。

这要求 [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.minDistance) 设置为正值或 0。可以通过将此值和 minDistance 设置为 -1 来禁用此距离限制。

desc.en-US:
Minimum view distance. If a particle is closer than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.

This requires [minFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.minFadeDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0.

This is different from [minDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.minDistanceThreshold), as this controls the start of a distance range that has smooth transitions at each end, while the threshold value is a hard cut-off.
desc.zh-CN:
最小视图距离。如果粒子与摄像机的距离小于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

这要求 [minFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.minFadeDistance) 设置为正值或 0。

这与 [minDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.minDistanceThreshold) 不同，因为此项控制的是两端具有平滑过渡的距离范围的起点，而阈值是硬性截止。

desc.en-US:
This controls a point where the opacity of a particle will start to fade to 0 near the [maximum view distance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.maxDistance). At [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.maxDistance), the opacity will be 0, and it will linearly approach 1 as the distance between the camera and the particle approaches this distance.

This requires [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.maxDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0. This distance limit can be disabled by setting this and maxDistance to -1.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子不透明度开始在 [最大视图距离](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.maxDistance) 附近衰减为 0 的点。在 [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.maxDistance) 处，不透明度为 0，随着摄像机与粒子之间的距离接近此距离，不透明度将线性接近 1。

这要求 [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.maxDistance) 设置为正值或 0。可以通过将此值和 maxDistance 设置为 -1 来禁用此距离限制。

desc.en-US:
Minimum view distance. If a particle is farther away than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.

This requires [maxFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.maxFadeDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0.

This is different from [maxDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.maxDistanceThreshold), as this controls the start of a distance range that has smooth transitions at each end, while the threshold value is a hard cut-off.
desc.zh-CN:
最小视图距离。如果粒子与摄像机的距离大于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

这要求 [maxFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.maxFadeDistance) 设置为正值或 0。

这与 [maxDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.maxDistanceThreshold) 不同，因为此项控制的是两端具有平滑过渡的距离范围的起点，而阈值是硬性截止。

desc.en-US: A hard cut-off point for the distance between the camera and the particle. If a particle is closer than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 摄像机与粒子之间距离的硬性截止点。如果粒子与摄像机的距离小于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US: A hard cut-off point for the distance between the camera and the particle. If a particle is farther away than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 摄像机与粒子之间距离的硬性截止点。如果粒子与摄像机的距离大于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US: If enabled, the texture's color will be multiplied by its alpha value, making more transparent parts of the texture darker.
desc.zh-CN: 如果启用，纹理的颜色将乘以其 Alpha 值，使纹理更透明的部分变暗。

desc.en-US:
Unknown float.

This seems to be some sort of distance threshold. When the camera is within this distance, some things will look different in some ways. For example, when within the distance and the [blend mode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.blendMode) is set to [BlendMode.Subtract](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BlendMode.Subtract), the opacity doesn't work the way it normally does. Other effects have been found as well, but what exactly this threshold is for is unknown.
desc.zh-CN:
未知浮点数。

这似乎是某种距离阈值。当摄像机在此距离内时，某些东西看起来会有所不同。例如，当在距离内且 [混合模式](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.blendMode) 设置为 [减去](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BlendMode.Subtract) 时，不透明度不会按正常方式工作。还发现了其他影响，但此阈值的具体作用未知。

desc.en-US: Controls how dark shaded parts of the trail are.
desc.zh-CN: 控制拖尾阴影部分的暗度。

desc.en-US:
Unknown boolean.

When enabled, it seems to stop [unk_ds3_f2_29](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.unk_ds3_f2_29) from doing whatever it is doing, and it can also cause some ugly "outline" effects on things seen through particles, but it also fixes an issue where some other particles can be seen through this particle.
desc.zh-CN:
未知布尔值。

当启用时，它似乎会停止 [unk_ds3_f2_29](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Tracer.unk_ds3_f2_29) 的作用，并且可能会对透过粒子看到的内容产生一些难看的“轮廓”效果，但它也修复了某些其他粒子可以透过此粒子看到的问题。

desc.en-US: Controls how sharp the specular highlights are.
desc.zh-CN: 控制高光亮点的清晰度。

desc.en-US: Controls how the trail is lit. See [LightingMode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LightingMode) for more information.
desc.zh-CN: 控制拖尾的光照方式。有关更多信息，请参阅 [LightingMode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LightingMode)。

desc.en-US: Controls how bright the specular highlights are.

Defines a simulated interaction with water, allowing effects to create ripples in nearby water. The interaction basically pushes water in a shape controlled by a texture down to a given depth and holds it there for a duration before releasing it.

The name is from Elden Ring's RTTI, where it is named "GXFfxWaterInteractionSimulationAppearance".
desc.zh-CN:
定义了与水的模拟交互，允许效果在附近的水中产生涟漪。该交互基本上会使用一个由纹理控制的形状将水向下推至给定深度，并保持一段时间，然后释放它。

该名称来自《艾尔登法环》的 RTTI，其中名为 “GXFfxWaterInteractionSimulationAppearance”。

desc.en-US: The ID for a texture that controls the shape of the interaction.
desc.zh-CN: 控制交互形状的纹理 ID。

desc.en-US: Controls how deep to push the water, or how intense the ripples caused by the interaction are.
desc.zh-CN: 控制将水向下推的深度，或交互引起的涟漪强度。

desc.en-US: Controls the size of the interaction area. Ripples caused by the interaction may go outside of the area.
desc.zh-CN: 控制交互区域的大小。交互引起的涟漪可能会超出该区域。

desc.en-US: The time it takes for the water to be pushed down to the [depth](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WaterInteraction.depth) in seconds.
desc.zh-CN: 将水推至[深度](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WaterInteraction.depth)所需的时间（秒）。

desc.en-US: The duration of the interaction in seconds. Basically how long to hold the water pressed down.
desc.zh-CN: 交互的持续时间（秒）。基本上是保持水被按压的时间长度。

desc.en-US:
Defines a lens flare effect with up to four textured layers with different colors and sizes.

The name is from Elden Ring's RTTI, where it is named "GXFfxLensFlareAppearance".
desc.zh-CN:
定义一个镜头光晕效果，最多可包含四个具有不同颜色和大小的纹理层。

该名称来自《艾尔登法环》的RTTI，其中名为“GXFfxLensFlareAppearance”。

desc.en-US:
Layer 1 color.

Values in this will be clamped to the 0-1 range. To use values outside of this range, see [layer1ColorMultiplier](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1ColorMultiplier).
desc.zh-CN:
第 1 层颜色。

此处的数值将被限制在 0-1 范围内。要使用超出此范围的值，请参阅 [layer1ColorMultiplier](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1ColorMultiplier)。

desc.en-US:
Layer 2 color.

Values in this will be clamped to the 0-1 range. To use values outside of this range, see [layer2ColorMultiplier](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer2ColorMultiplier).
desc.zh-CN:
第 2 层颜色。

此处的数值将被限制在 0-1 范围内。要使用超出此范围的值，请参阅 [layer2ColorMultiplier](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer2ColorMultiplier)。

desc.en-US:
Layer 3 color.

Values in this will be clamped to the 0-1 range. To use values outside of this range, see [layer3ColorMultiplier](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer3ColorMultiplier).
desc.zh-CN:
第 3 层颜色。

此处的数值将被限制在 0-1 范围内。要使用超出此范围的值，请参阅 [layer3ColorMultiplier](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer3ColorMultiplier)。

desc.en-US:
Layer 4 color.

Values in this will be clamped to the 0-1 range. To use values outside of this range, see [layer4ColorMultiplier](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4ColorMultiplier).
desc.zh-CN:
第 4 层颜色。

此处的数值将被限制在 0-1 范围内。要使用超出此范围的值，请参阅 [layer4ColorMultiplier](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4ColorMultiplier)。

desc.en-US:
Layer 4 texture ID.

This layer seems to work a bit differently from the others in Sekiro.
desc.zh-CN:
第 4 层纹理 ID。

在《只狼》中，此层的工作方式似乎与其他层略有不同。

desc.en-US:
Diameter of the lens flare source sphere.

The opacity of the lens flare depends on how much of the source is in view.
desc.zh-CN:
镜头光晕源球体的直径。

镜头光晕的不透明度取决于源在视野中的比例。

desc.en-US: The time in seconds it takes for the opacity of the lens flare to transition when the source comes more into or goes more out of view.
desc.zh-CN: 当源进入或离开视野时，镜头光晕不透明度过渡所需的时间（秒）。

desc.en-US:
The number of flares to create from [layer1](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1). Unless given [random offsets](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1OffsetVariation), they will all just stack on top of each other in the same spot.

Setting it to very high values can have a significant impact on performance.
desc.zh-CN:
从 [layer1](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1) 创建的光晕数量。除非给予 [随机偏移](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1OffsetVariation)，否则它们将全部堆叠在同一位置。

将其设置为非常高的值会对性能产生重大影响。

desc.en-US: The [width](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Width) of [each flare](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Count) is multiplied by a random value between this and 1.
desc.zh-CN: [每个光晕](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Count)的 [宽度](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Width) 乘以该值和 1 之间的随机值。

desc.en-US: The [height](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Height) of [each flare](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Count) is multiplied by a random value between this and 1.
desc.zh-CN: [每个光晕](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Count)的 [高度](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Height) 乘以该值和 1 之间的随机值。

desc.en-US: When enabled, the [layer's width](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Width) also controls the [height](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Height), and the height property is ignored. The same is also true for the scale variation fields.
desc.zh-CN: 启用时，[层的宽度](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Width) 也控制 [高度](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Height)，高度属性被忽略。缩放变化字段也是如此。

desc.en-US:
Multiplier for the [layer's color](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Color).

Values in this are unrestricted and can go above 1.
desc.zh-CN:
[层的颜色](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Color) 的乘数。

此处的数值不设限，可以超过 1。

desc.en-US: Controls how the offset vector is calculated for [layer1](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1). See [ReflectionMode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ReflectionMode) for more details.
desc.zh-CN: 控制如何计算 [layer1](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1) 的偏移向量。有关更多详细信息，请参阅 [ReflectionMode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ReflectionMode)。

desc.en-US:
Controls where the lens flare(s) from [layer1](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1) will appear on the screen relative to the source and the center of the screen.

This is basically a scalar multiplier for the [offset vector](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Reflection).

This requires [layer1Reflection](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Reflection) to not be set to [ReflectionMode.None](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ReflectionMode.None).
desc.zh-CN:
控制来自 [layer1](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1) 的镜头光晕相对于源和屏幕中心在屏幕上显示的位置。

这基本上是 [偏移向量](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Reflection) 的标量乘数。

这要求 [layer1Reflection](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Reflection) 不设置为 [ReflectionMode.None](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ReflectionMode.None)。

desc.en-US:
For [each flare](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Count) of [layer1](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1), a random number is picked between this value and 1, and this random number is then multiplied with [layer1Offset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Offset) to get the final offset for the flare.

This requires [layer1Reflection](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Reflection) to not be set to [ReflectionMode.None](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ReflectionMode.None).
desc.zh-CN:
对于 [layer1](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1) 的 [每个光晕](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Count)，在此值和 1 之间选取一个随机数，然后将此随机数与 [layer1Offset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Offset) 相乘以获得光晕的最终偏移。

这要求 [layer1Reflection](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Reflection) 不设置为 [ReflectionMode.None](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ReflectionMode.None)。

desc.en-US:
This controls the radius of a sphere around the source for [layer1](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1). [Each flare](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Count) has its own radius, which calculated by dividing this radius by the absolute value of the flare's [offset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Offset). If the center of the screen is not within the projection of this sphere on the screen, the flare will not be visible, and it fades out gradually as the center of the screen moves from within the sphere to outside it.

In other words, this fades out flares based on their offset and the distance from the source to the center of the screen, which means it's harder to see flares farther away from the source, and if the source is far away from the center of the screen.

Can be set to -1 to disable this limit and always display the flare(s).
desc.zh-CN:
控制 [layer1](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1) 围绕源的球体半径。[每个光晕](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Count) 都有其自己的半径，该半径是通过将此半径除以光晕的 [偏移](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Offset) 的绝对值来计算的。如果屏幕中心不在该球体在屏幕上的投影内，则光晕不可见，并且随着屏幕中心从球体内移出到球体外，光晕会逐渐淡出。

换句话说，这基于光晕的偏移以及源到屏幕中心的距离来淡出光晕，这意味着离源越远的光晕越难看到，而且如果源离屏幕中心很远也更难看到。

可以设置为 -1 以禁用此限制并始终显示光晕。

desc.en-US:
The number of flares to create from [layer2](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer2). Unless given [random offsets](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer2OffsetVariation), they will all just stack on top of each other in the same spot.

Setting it to very high values can have a significant impact on performance.

从 [layer2](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer2) 创建的光晕数量。除非给予 [随机偏移](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer2OffsetVariation)，否则它们将全部堆叠在同一位置。

将其设置为非常高的值会对性能产生重大影响。

desc.en-US: The [width](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer2Width) of [each flare](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer2Count) is multiplied by a random value between this and 1.
desc.zh-CN: [每个光晕](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer2Count)的 [宽度](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer2Width) 乘以该值和 1 之间的随机值。

desc.en-US: The [height](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer2Height) of [each flare](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer2Count) is multiplied by a random value between this and 1.

对于 [layer3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer3) 的 [每个光晕](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer3Count)，在此值和 1 之间选取一个随机数，然后将此随机数与 [layer3Offset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer3Offset) 相乘以获得光晕的最终偏移。

这要求 [layer3Reflection](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer3Reflection) 不设置为 [ReflectionMode.None](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ReflectionMode.None)。

desc.en-US:
This controls the radius of a sphere around the source for [layer3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer3). [Each flare](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer3Count) has its own radius, which calculated by dividing this radius by the absolute value of the flare's [offset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer3Offset). If the center of the screen is not within the projection of this sphere on the screen, the flare will not be visible, and it fades out gradually as the center of the screen moves from within the sphere to outside it.

In other words, this fades out flares based on their offset and the distance from the source to the center of the screen, which means it's harder to see flares farther away from the source, and if the source is far away from the center of the screen.

Can be set to -1 to disable this limit and always display the flare(s).
desc.zh-CN:
控制 [layer3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer3) 围绕源的球体半径。[每个光晕](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer3Count) 都有其自己的半径，该半径是通过将此半径除以光晕的 [偏移](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer3Offset) 的绝对值来计算的。如果屏幕中心不在该球体在屏幕上的投影内，则光晕不可见，并且随着屏幕中心从球体内移出到球体外，光晕会逐渐淡出。

换句话说，这基于光晕的偏移以及源到屏幕中心的距离来淡出光晕，这意味着离源越远的光晕越难看到，而且如果源离屏幕中心很远也更难看到。

可以设置为 -1 以禁用此限制并始终显示光晕。

desc.en-US:
The number of flares to create from [layer4](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4). Unless given [random offsets](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4OffsetVariation), they will all just stack on top of each other in the same spot.

Setting it to very high values can have a significant impact on performance.
desc.zh-CN:
从 [layer4](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4) 创建的光晕数量。除非给予 [随机偏移](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4OffsetVariation)，否则它们将全部堆叠在同一位置。

将其设置为非常高的值会对性能产生重大影响。

desc.en-US: The [width](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Width) of [each flare](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Count) is multiplied by a random value between this and 1.
desc.zh-CN: [每个光晕](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Count)的 [宽度](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Width) 乘以该值和 1 之间的随机值。

desc.en-US: The [height](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Height) of [each flare](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Count) is multiplied by a random value between this and 1.
desc.zh-CN: [每个光晕](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Count)的 [高度](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Height) 乘以该值和 1 之间的随机值。

desc.en-US: When enabled, the [layer's width](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Width) also controls the [height](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Height), and the height property is ignored. The same is also true for the scale variation fields.
desc.zh-CN: 启用时，[层的宽度](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Width) 也控制 [高度](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Height)，高度属性被忽略。缩放变化字段也是如此。

desc.en-US:
Multiplier for the [layer's color](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Color).

Values in this are unrestricted and can go above 1.
desc.zh-CN:
[层的颜色](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Color) 的乘数。

此处的数值不设限，可以超过 1。

desc.en-US: Controls how the offset vector is calculated for [layer4](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4). See [ReflectionMode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ReflectionMode) for more details.
desc.zh-CN: 控制如何计算 [layer4](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4) 的偏移向量。有关更多详细信息，请参阅 [ReflectionMode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ReflectionMode)。

desc.en-US:
Controls where the lens flare(s) from [layer4](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4) will appear on the screen relative to the source and the center of the screen.

This is basically a scalar multiplier for the [offset vector](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Reflection).

This requires [layer4Reflection](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Reflection) to not be set to [ReflectionMode.None](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ReflectionMode.None).
desc.zh-CN:
控制来自 [layer4](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4) 的镜头光晕相对于源和屏幕中心在屏幕上显示的位置。

这基本上是 [偏移向量](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Reflection) 的标量乘数。

这要求 [layer4Reflection](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Reflection) 不设置为 [ReflectionMode.None](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ReflectionMode.None)。

desc.en-US:
For [each flare](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Count) of [layer4](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4), a random number is picked between this value and 1, and this random number is then multiplied with [layer4Offset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Offset) to get the final offset for the flare.

This requires [layer4Reflection](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Reflection) to not be set to [ReflectionMode.None](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ReflectionMode.None).
desc.zh-CN:
对于 [layer4](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4) 的 [每个光晕](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Count)，在此值和 1 之间选取一个随机数，然后将此随机数与 [layer4Offset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Offset) 相乘以获得光晕的最终偏移。

这要求 [layer4Reflection](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Reflection) 不设置为 [ReflectionMode.None](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ReflectionMode.None)。

desc.en-US:
This controls the radius of a sphere around the source for [layer4](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4). [Each flare](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Count) has its own radius, which calculated by dividing this radius by the absolute value of the flare's [offset](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Offset). If the center of the screen is not within the projection of this sphere on the screen, the flare will not be visible, and it fades out gradually as the center of the screen moves from within the sphere to outside it.

In other words, this fades out flares based on their offset and the distance from the source to the center of the screen, which means it's harder to see flares farther away from the source, and if the source is far away from the center of the screen.

Can be set to -1 to disable this limit and always display the flare(s).
desc.zh-CN:
控制 [layer4](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4) 围绕源的球体半径。[每个光晕](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Count) 都有其自己的半径，该半径是通过将此半径除以光晕的 [偏移](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Offset) 的绝对值来计算的。如果屏幕中心不在该球体在屏幕上的投影内，则光晕不可见，并且随着屏幕中心从球体内移出到球体外，光晕会逐渐淡出。

换句话说，这基于光晕的偏移以及源到屏幕中心的距离来淡出光晕，这意味着离源越远的光晕越难看到，而且如果源离屏幕中心很远也更难看到。

可以设置为 -1 以禁用此限制并始终显示光晕。

desc.en-US:
When enabled, this allows the lens flare to have a bloom effect.

Does not seem to work in Sekiro.
desc.zh-CN:
如果启用，允许镜头光晕具有泛光效果。

在《只狼》中似乎无效。

desc.en-US: The bloom color for layer 1. This is multiplied with the [layer's color](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Color) to get the final color for the bloom.
desc.zh-CN: 第 1 层的泛光颜色。这与 [层的颜色](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer1Color) 相乘，以获得泛光的最终颜色。

desc.en-US: The bloom color for layer 2. This is multiplied with the [layer's color](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer2Color) to get the final color for the bloom.
desc.zh-CN: 第 2 层的泛光颜色。这与 [层的颜色](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer2Color) 相乘，以获得泛光的最终颜色。

desc.en-US: The bloom color for layer 3. This is multiplied with the [layer's color](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer3Color) to get the final color for the bloom.
desc.zh-CN: 第 3 层的泛光颜色。这与 [层的颜色](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer3Color) 相乘，以获得泛光的最终颜色。

desc.en-US: The bloom color for layer 4. This is multiplied with the [layer's color](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Color) to get the final color for the bloom.
desc.zh-CN: 第 4 层的泛光颜色。这与 [层的颜色](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#LensFlare.layer4Color) 相乘，以获得泛光的最终颜色。

desc.en-US:
Defines a particle with a 3D model. Similar to [Model](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model), but with some different options.

Some models only work properly with this action and not with the Model action for some unknown reason. A good example of this is the Carian greatsword model in Elden Ring (88300), which gets horribly stretched and distorted when used with the other action, but it works fine with this one.

The name is from Elden Ring's RTTI, where it is named "GXFfxAppearanceRichModel".
desc.zh-CN:
定义一个带有3D模型的粒子。与[Model](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Model)类似，但具有一些不同的选项。

有些模型仅适用于此行为，而不适用于Model行为（原因未知）。一个很好的例子是《艾尔登法环》中的卡利亚大剑模型（88300），当与其他行为一起使用时，它会变得极其拉伸和扭曲，但在此行为下则能正常工作。

该名称来源于《艾尔登法环》的RTTI，其中名为“GXFfxAppearanceRichModel”。

desc.en-US:
The width of the particle.

If [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.uniformScale) is enabled, this also controls the height and depth.
desc.zh-CN:
粒子的宽度。

如果启用了 [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.uniformScale)，这也会控制高度和深度。

desc.en-US:
The height of the particle.

If [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.uniformScale) is enabled, [sizeX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.sizeX) also controls the height, and this property is ignored.
desc.zh-CN:
粒子的高度。

如果启用了 [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.uniformScale)，[sizeX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.sizeX) 也会控制高度，此属性将被忽略。

desc.en-US:
The depth of the particle.

If [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.uniformScale) is enabled, [sizeX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.sizeX) also controls the depth, and this property is ignored.
desc.zh-CN:
粒子的深度。

如果启用了 [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.uniformScale)，[sizeX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.sizeX) 也会控制深度，此属性将被忽略。

desc.en-US: Rotation around the X-axis in degrees.
desc.zh-CN: 绕 X 轴的旋转角度（度）。

Color multiplier.

Values in this will be clamped to the 0-1 range. To use values outside of this range, see [color3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.color3).
desc.zh-CN:
颜色乘数。

此处的数值将被限制在 0-1 范围内。要使用超出此范围的值，请参阅 [color3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.color3)。

desc.en-US:
Color multiplier.

Values in this will be clamped to the 0-1 range. There is no equivalent property with unrestricted values based on the emission time of the particle, but [color3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.color3) is still multiplicative with this and can be used to scale the values indirectly.
desc.zh-CN:
颜色乘数。

此处的数值将被限制在 0-1 范围内。虽然没有基于粒子发射时间的不受限制值的等效属性，但 [color3](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.color3) 仍可与其相乘，并可用于间接缩放数值。

desc.en-US:
Color multiplier.

Values in this are unrestricted and can go above 1. If you want values to be clamped to the 0-1 range, see [color1](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.color1).
desc.zh-CN:
颜色乘数。

此处的数值不设限，可以超过 1。如果希望将数值限制在 0-1 范围内，请参阅 [color1](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.color1)。

desc.zh-CN: Rich Model 朝向模式。有关更多信息，请参阅 [RichModelOrientationMode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModelOrientationMode)。

desc.en-US:
Each particle will pick a random number between this value and 1, and the width of the particle will be multiplied by this number. For example, setting this to 0.5 will make the particles randomly thinner, down to half width. Setting it to 2 will make them randomly wider, up to double width.

If [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.uniformScale) is enabled, this also affects the height.
desc.zh-CN:
每个粒子将在此值和 1 之间选取一个随机数，粒子的宽度将乘以该数。例如，将其设置为 0.5 将使粒子随机变细，最细为一半宽度。将其设置为 2 将使它们随机变宽，最宽为两倍宽度。

如果启用了 [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.uniformScale)，这也会影响高度。

desc.en-US:
Each particle will pick a random number between this value and 1, and the height of the particle will be multiplied by this number. For example, setting this to 0.5 will make the particles randomly shorter, down to half height. Setting it to 2 will make them randomly taller, up to double height.

If [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.uniformScale) is enabled, [scaleVariationX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.scaleVariationX) also affects the height, and this field is ignored.
desc.zh-CN:
每个粒子将在此值和 1 之间选取一个随机数，粒子的高度将乘以该数。例如，将其设置为 0.5 将使粒子随机变矮，最矮为一半高度。将其设置为 2 将使它们随机变高，最高为两倍高度。

如果启用了 [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.uniformScale)，[scaleVariationX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.scaleVariationX) 也会影响高度，此字段将被忽略。

desc.en-US:
Each particle will pick a random number between this value and 1, and the depth of the particle will be multiplied by this number. For example, setting this to 0.5 will make the particles randomly shallower, down to half depth. Setting it to 2 will make them randomly deeper, up to double depth. 

If [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.uniformScale) is enabled, [scaleVariationX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.scaleVariationX) also affects the depth, and this field is ignored.
desc.zh-CN:
每个粒子将在此值和 1 之间选取一个随机数，粒子的深度将乘以该数。例如，将其设置为 0.5 将使粒子随机变浅，最浅为一半深度。将其设置为 2 将使它们随机变深，最深为两倍深度。

如果启用了 [uniformScale](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.uniformScale)，[scaleVariationX](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.scaleVariationX) 也会影响深度，此字段将被忽略。

desc.en-US: If enabled, the particle X scale-related properties and fields will control the scale in all axes, and the Y and Z counterparts will be ignored.
desc.zh-CN: 如果启用，粒子 X 轴缩放相关的属性和字段将控制所有轴的缩放，Y 和 Z 轴对应的属性将被忽略。

desc.en-US: If enabled, this allows control of the model's opacity regardless of its material by using dithered transparency. If disabled, changes to the alpha values that affect the particle will not have any effect unless the material allows it, but it will look better than the dithered transparency.
desc.zh-CN: 如果启用，这允许使用抖动透明度来控制模型的不透明度，而不管其材质如何。如果禁用，除非材质允许，否则影响粒子的 Alpha 值的更改将不会产生任何效果，但它看起来会比抖动透明度更好。

desc.en-US: Controls which animation in the [anibnd](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.anibnd) to play.
desc.zh-CN: 控制播放 [anibnd](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.anibnd) 中的哪个动画。

desc.en-US: If disabled, the [animation](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.animation) will only play once and then freeze on the last frame. If enabled, the animation will loop.
desc.zh-CN: 如果禁用，[animation](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.animation) 只会播放一次，然后冻结在最后一帧。如果启用，动画将循环播放。

desc.en-US: Controls the speed at which the [animation](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.animation) plays.

Unknown integer.

This is somewhat similar to the `blendMode` property of other appearance actions, but the values do not match the ones in [BlendMode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BlendMode).
desc.zh-CN:
未知整数。

这与其他外观动作的 `blendMode` 属性有些相似，但值与 [BlendMode](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#BlendMode) 中的值不匹配。

desc.en-US:
Controls the color of the additional bloom effect. The colors of the particle will be multiplied with this color to get the final color of the bloom effect.

Note:
- This has no effect if the "Effects Quality" setting is set to "Low".
- This does not affect the natural bloom effect from high color values.
desc.zh-CN:
控制额外泛光效果的颜色。粒子的颜色将与此颜色相乘，以获得泛光效果的最终颜色。

注意：
- 如果“特效质量”设置设为“低”，则此项无效。
- 这不影响高颜色值产生的自然泛光效果。

desc.en-US:
This controls a point where the opacity of a particle will start to fade to 0 near the [minimum view distance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.minDistance). At [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.minDistance), the opacity will be 0, and it will linearly approach 1 as the distance between the camera and the particle approaches this distance.

This requires [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.minDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0. This distance limit can be disabled by setting this and minDistance to -1.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子不透明度开始在 [最小视图距离](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.minDistance) 附近衰减为 0 的点。在 [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.minDistance) 处，不透明度为 0，随着摄像机与粒子之间的距离接近此距离，不透明度将线性接近 1。

这要求 [minDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.minDistance) 设置为正值或 0。可以通过将此值和 minDistance 设置为 -1 来禁用此距离限制。

desc.en-US:
Minimum view distance. If a particle is closer than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.

This requires [minFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.minFadeDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0.

This is different from [minDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.minDistanceThreshold), as this controls the start of a distance range that has smooth transitions at each end, while the threshold value is a hard cut-off.
desc.zh-CN:
最小视图距离。如果粒子与摄像机的距离小于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

这要求 [minFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.minFadeDistance) 设置为正值或 0。

这与 [minDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.minDistanceThreshold) 不同，因为此项控制的是两端具有平滑过渡的距离范围的起点，而阈值是硬性截止。

desc.en-US:
This controls a point where the opacity of a particle will start to fade to 0 near the [maximum view distance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.maxDistance). At [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.maxDistance), the opacity will be 0, and it will linearly approach 1 as the distance between the camera and the particle approaches this distance.

This requires [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.maxDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0. This distance limit can be disabled by setting this and maxDistance to -1.
desc.zh-CN:
控制粒子不透明度开始在 [最大视图距离](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.maxDistance) 附近衰减为 0 的点。在 [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.maxDistance) 处，不透明度为 0，随着摄像机与粒子之间的距离接近此距离，不透明度将线性接近 1。

这要求 [maxDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.maxDistance) 设置为正值或 0。可以通过将此值和 maxDistance 设置为 -1 来禁用此距离限制。

desc.en-US:
Minimum view distance. If a particle is farther away than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.

This requires [maxFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.maxFadeDistance) to be set to a positive value or 0.

This is different from [maxDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.maxDistanceThreshold), as this controls the start of a distance range that has smooth transitions at each end, while the threshold value is a hard cut-off.
desc.zh-CN:
最小视图距离。如果粒子与摄像机的距离大于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

这要求 [maxFadeDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.maxFadeDistance) 设置为正值或 0。

这与 [maxDistanceThreshold](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#RichModel.maxDistanceThreshold) 不同，因为此项控制的是两端具有平滑过渡的距离范围的起点，而阈值是硬性截止。

desc.en-US: A hard cut-off point for the distance between the camera and the particle. If a particle is closer than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 摄像机与粒子之间距离的硬性截止点。如果粒子与摄像机的距离小于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US: A hard cut-off point for the distance between the camera and the particle. If a particle is farther away than this distance from the camera, it will be hidden. Can be set to -1 to disable the limit.
desc.zh-CN: 摄像机与粒子之间距离的硬性截止点。如果粒子与摄像机的距离大于此距离，它将被隐藏。可以设置为 -1 以禁用限制。

desc.en-US: Unknown integer. The only known thing about this field is that setting it to 0 stops action 10300 from doing anything.
desc.zh-CN: 未知整数。关于此字段唯一已知的是将其设置为 0 会阻止行为 10300 产生任何效果。

desc.en-US:
Defines a volume that cancels all other SFX forces. This includes wind from weather, and forces from the following actions:
- [WindForce](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WindForce)
- [GravityForce](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GravityForce)
- [TurbulenceForce](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TurbulenceForce)

The name is from Elden Ring's RTTI, where it is named "GXForceFieldCancelAreaAppearance".
desc.zh-CN:
定义一个用于取消所有其他 SFX 力的体积。这包括来自天气的风力以及以下行为产生的力：
- [WindForce](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WindForce)
- [GravityForce](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GravityForce)
- [TurbulenceForce](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TurbulenceForce)

该名称源自艾尔登法环的 RTTI，其中它被命名为 "GXForceFieldCancelAreaAppearance"。

desc.en-US:
The shape of the volume.

Each shape has different fields controlling the size of the volume:
| Shape | Fields | Origin |
|-|-|-|
| [Boundless](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Boundless) | *n/a* | *n/a* |
| [Sphere](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Sphere) | [sphereRadius](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#CancelForce.sphereRadius) | Center of the sphere |
| [Box](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Box) | [boxSize](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#CancelForce.boxSize) | Center of the box |
| [Cylinder](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Cylinder) | [cylinderHeight](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#CancelForce.cylinderHeight), [cylinderRadius](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#CancelForce.cylinderRadius) | Center of the cylinder |
| [SquarePrism](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.SquarePrism) | [squarePrismHeight](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#CancelForce.squarePrismHeight), [squarePrismApothem](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#CancelForce.squarePrismApothem) | Center of the base of the prism |
desc.zh-CN:
体积的形状。

每种形状都有不同的字段控制体积的大小：
| 形状 | 字段 | 原点 |
|-|-|-|
| [Boundless (无限)](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Boundless) | *不适用* | *不适用* |
| [Sphere 球体](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Sphere) | [sphereRadius](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#CancelForce.sphereRadius) | 球体中心 |
| [Box 长方体](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Box) | [boxSize](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#CancelForce.boxSize) | 长方体中心 |
| [Cylinder 圆柱体](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Cylinder) | [cylinderHeight](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#CancelForce.cylinderHeight), [cylinderRadius](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#CancelForce.cylinderRadius) | 圆柱体中心 |
| [SquarePrism 四棱柱](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.SquarePrism) | [squarePrismHeight](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#CancelForce.squarePrismHeight), [squarePrismApothem](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#CancelForce.squarePrismApothem) | 棱柱底面中心 |

desc.en-US:
Defines a directional force in a volume, which is most often used for creating wind effects. The direction of the force is based on the direction of the node.

The name is from Elden Ring's RTTI, where it is named "GXForceFieldWindAreaAppearance".
desc.zh-CN:
定义一个体积内的定向力，通常用于创建风力效果。力的方向基于节点的方向。

该名称来自《艾尔登法环》的 RTTI，其中名为“GXForceFieldWindAreaAppearance”。

desc.en-US: The strength of the force applied in the volume.
desc.zh-CN: 施加在体积内的力的强度。

desc.en-US:
The shape of the volume.

Each shape has different fields controlling the size of the volume:
| Shape | Fields | Origin |
|-|-|-|
| [Boundless](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Boundless) | *n/a* | *n/a* |
| [Sphere](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Sphere) | [sphereRadius](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WindForce.sphereRadius) | Center of the sphere |
| [Box](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Box) | [boxSize](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WindForce.boxSize) | Center of the box |
| [Cylinder](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Cylinder) | [cylinderHeight](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WindForce.cylinderHeight), [cylinderRadius](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WindForce.cylinderRadius) | Center of the cylinder |
| [SquarePrism](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.SquarePrism) | [squarePrismHeight](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WindForce.squarePrismHeight), [squarePrismApothem](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WindForce.squarePrismApothem) | Center of the base of the prism |
desc.zh-CN:
体积的形状。

每种形状都有不同的字段控制体积的大小：
| 形状 | 字段 | 原点 |
|-|-|-|
| [Boundless 无限](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Boundless) | *不适用* | *不适用* |
| [Sphere 球体](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Sphere) | [sphereRadius](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WindForce.sphereRadius) | 球体中心 |
| [Box 长方体](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Box) | [boxSize](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WindForce.boxSize) | 长方体中心 |
| [Cylinder 圆柱体](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Cylinder) | [cylinderHeight](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WindForce.cylinderHeight), [cylinderRadius](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WindForce.cylinderRadius) | 圆柱体中心 |
| [SquarePrism 四棱柱](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.SquarePrism) | [squarePrismHeight](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WindForce.squarePrismHeight), [squarePrismApothem](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WindForce.squarePrismApothem) | 棱柱底面中心 |

desc.en-US: The radius of the [sphere](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Sphere) where the force is active.
The size of the [box](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Box) where the force is active.
The height of the [cylinder](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Cylinder) where the force is active.
The radius of the [cylinder](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Cylinder) where the force is active.
The height of the [square prism](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.SquarePrism) where the force is active.
The apothem of the [square prism](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.SquarePrism) where the force is active.

When this is set to 0, the wind will be able to affect sfx, including the one with this action. When it's set to 1, it seems to only affect non-sfx things, like plants and trees.

The way non-sfx are affected by the wind seems to also change a bit between values 0 and 1, but exactly how is unknown.

In DS3 and Sekiro, some effects have this set to 2, so it is not just a boolean. What 2 does is unknown.
desc.zh-CN:
当设置为 0 时，风将能够影响 SFX（特效），包括具有此动作的特效。当设置为 1 时，它似乎只影响非 SFX 物体，如植物和树木。

非 SFX 受风影响的方式似乎在值 0 和 1 之间也有所变化，但具体如何未知。

在《黑暗之魂 3》和《只狼》中，某些效果将此设置为 2，因此它不仅仅是一个布尔值。2 的作用未知。

desc.en-US:
The minimum random multiplier for [force](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WindForce.force). This multiplier will randomly change to different values in the range defined by this and [forceRandomMultiplierMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WindForce.forceRandomMultiplierMax).

This is multiplicative with both the base force and the [other multiplier](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WindForce.forceMultiplier).
desc.zh-CN:
[force](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WindForce.force) 的最小随机乘数。此乘数将在由此值和 [forceRandomMultiplierMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WindForce.forceRandomMultiplierMax) 定义的范围内随机变化。

这与基础力和[其他乘数](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WindForce.forceMultiplier)相乘。

desc.en-US:
The maximum random multiplier for [force](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WindForce.force). This multiplier will randomly change to different values in the range defined by this and [forceRandomMultiplierMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WindForce.forceRandomMultiplierMin).

This is multiplicative with both the base force and the [other multiplier](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WindForce.forceMultiplier).
desc.zh-CN:
[force](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WindForce.force) 的最大随机乘数。此乘数将在由此值和 [forceRandomMultiplierMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WindForce.forceRandomMultiplierMin) 定义的范围内随机变化。

这与基础力和[其他乘数](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WindForce.forceMultiplier)相乘。

desc.en-US:
A multiplier for [force](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WindForce.force).

This is multiplicative with both the base force and the random multiplier.
desc.zh-CN:
[force](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#WindForce.force) 的乘数。

这与基础力和随机乘数相乘。

desc.en-US: The time it takes for the force to fade out after the action has deactivated in seconds. Due to the way this value is stored, the time will be rounded to the nearest 1/30s.
desc.zh-CN: 动作失效后力场淡出所需的时间（秒）。由于此值的存储方式，时间将四舍五入到最接近的 1/30 秒。

desc.en-US:
Defines a radial force in a volume. This pulls things towards itself, or pushes away if the force is negative.

The name is from Elden Ring's RTTI, where it is named "GXForceFieldGravityAreaAppearance".
desc.zh-CN:
定义一个体积内的径向力。如果力为正，它会将物体拉向自身；如果力为负，则会将其推开。

该名称来自《艾尔登法环》的 RTTI，其中被命名为 "GXForceFieldGravityAreaAppearance"。

desc.en-US: The strength of the force applied in the volume.
desc.zh-CN: 施加在体积内的力的强度。

desc.en-US:
The shape of the volume.

Each shape has different fields controlling the size of the volume, and they also change where it scales from and what point things are being pulled towards:
| Shape | Fields | Origin | Center of mass |
|-|-|-|-|
| [Boundless](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Boundless) | *n/a* | *n/a* | Node position |
| [Sphere](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Sphere) | [sphereRadius](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GravityForce.sphereRadius) | Center of the sphere | Center of the sphere |
| [Box](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Box) | [boxSize](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GravityForce.boxSize) | Center of the box | Center of the box |
| [Cylinder](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Cylinder) | [cylinderHeight](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GravityForce.cylinderHeight), [cylinderRadius](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GravityForce.cylinderRadius) | Slightly +Z of the center of the cylinder? | Slightly +Z of the origin? |
| [SquarePrism](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.SquarePrism) | [squarePrismHeight](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GravityForce.squarePrismHeight), [squarePrismApothem](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GravityForce.squarePrismApothem) | Center of the base of the prism | Center of the prism |
desc.zh-CN:
体积的形状。

每种形状都有不同的字段控制体积的大小，它们还会改变缩放的基准点以及物体被拉向的点：
| 形状 | 字段 | 原点 | 质心 |
|-|-|-|-|
| [Boundless 无限](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Boundless) | *不适用* | *不适用* | 节点位置 |
| [Sphere 球体](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Sphere) | [sphereRadius](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GravityForce.sphereRadius) | 球体中心 | 球体中心 |
| [Box 长方体](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Box) | [boxSize](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GravityForce.boxSize) | 长方体中心 | 长方体中心 |
| [Cylinder 圆柱体](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Cylinder) | [cylinderHeight](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GravityForce.cylinderHeight), [cylinderRadius](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GravityForce.cylinderRadius) | 圆柱体中心略微 +Z 处？ | 原点略微 +Z 处？ |
| [SquarePrism 四棱柱](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.SquarePrism) | [squarePrismHeight](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GravityForce.squarePrismHeight), [squarePrismApothem](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GravityForce.squarePrismApothem) | 棱柱底面中心 | 棱柱中心 |

desc.en-US: The radius of the [sphere](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Sphere) where the force is active.
The size of the [box](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Box) where the force is active.
The height of the [cylinder](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Cylinder) where the force is active.
The radius of the [cylinder](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Cylinder) where the force is active.
The height of the [square prism](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.SquarePrism) where the force is active.
The apothem of the [square prism](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.SquarePrism) where the force is active.

The minimum "random" multiplier for [force](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GravityForce.force). This looks very similar to the same set of fields in the [WindForce action](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionType.WindForce), but this one doesn't seem to actually be random. It seems more like it will always just be the average of this and [forceRandomMultiplierMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GravityForce.forceRandomMultiplierMax).

This is multiplicative with both the base force and the [other multiplier](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GravityForce.forceMultiplier).
desc.zh-CN:
[force](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GravityForce.force) 的最小“随机”乘数。这看起来与 [WindForce 动作](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionType.WindForce) 中的相同字段集非常相似，但这一个似乎实际上并非随机的。它看起来更像是总是取此值和 [forceRandomMultiplierMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GravityForce.forceRandomMultiplierMax) 的平均值。

这与基础力和[其他乘数](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GravityForce.forceMultiplier)相乘。

desc.en-US:
