This looks very similar to the same set of fields in the [WindForce action](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionType.WindForce), but this one doesn't seem to actually be random. It seems more like it will always just be the average of this and [forceRandomMultiplierMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GravityForce.forceRandomMultiplierMin).

This is multiplicative with both the base force and the [other multiplier](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GravityForce.forceMultiplier).
desc.zh-CN:
[force](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GravityForce.force) 的最大“随机”乘数。这看起来与 [WindForce 动作](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ActionType.WindForce) 中的相同字段集非常相似，但这一个似乎实际上并非随机的。它看起来更像是总是取此值和 [forceRandomMultiplierMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GravityForce.forceRandomMultiplierMin) 的平均值。

这与基础力和[其他乘数](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GravityForce.forceMultiplier)相乘。

desc.en-US:
A multiplier for [force](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GravityForce.force).

This is multiplicative with both the base force and the "random" multiplier.
desc.zh-CN:
[force](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#GravityForce.force) 的乘数。

这与基础力和“随机”乘数相乘。

desc.en-US: The time it takes for the force to fade out after the action has deactivated in seconds. Due to the way this value is stored, the time will be rounded to the nearest 1/30s.
desc.zh-CN: 动作失效后力场淡出所需的时间（秒）。由于此值的存储方式，时间将四舍五入到最接近的 1/30 秒。

desc.en-US:
Defines a volume used to detect whether or not the node is inside a force volume.

The name is from Elden Ring's RTTI, where it is named "GXCollisionFieldAreaAppearance".
desc.zh-CN:
定义一个用于检测节点是否在力场体积内的体积。

该名称来自《艾尔登法环》的 RTTI，其中名为“GXCollisionFieldAreaAppearance”。

desc.en-US:
The shape of the volume.

Each shape has different fields controlling the size of the volume:
| Shape | Fields |
|-|-|
| [Boundless](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Boundless) | *n/a* |
| [Sphere](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Sphere) | [sphereRadius](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceCollision.sphereRadius) |
| [Box](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Box) | [boxSize](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceCollision.boxSize) |

**Note**: The [SquarePrism](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.SquarePrism) shape is not valid for this action.
desc.zh-CN:
体积的形状。

每种形状都有不同的字段控制体积的大小：
| 形状 | 字段 |
|-|-|
| [Boundless 无限](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Boundless) | *不适用* |
| [Sphere 球体](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Sphere) | [sphereRadius](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceCollision.sphereRadius) |
| [Box 长方体](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Box) | [boxSize](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceCollision.boxSize) |
| [Cylinder 圆柱体](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Cylinder) | [cylinderHeight](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceCollision.cylinderHeight), [cylinderRadius](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceCollision.cylinderRadius) |

**注意**：[SquarePrism 四棱柱](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.SquarePrism) 形状对此行为无效。

desc.en-US:
Defines a chaotic force in a volume.

The name is from Elden Ring's RTTI, where it is named "GXForceFieldTurbulenceAreaAppearance".
desc.zh-CN:
在体积中定义混乱的力（湍流）。

名称源自《艾尔登法环》的RTTI，其中被命名为“GXForceFieldTurbulenceAreaAppearance”。

desc.en-US: Offset along the X-axis for the 3D noise used to control the strength and direction of the force in the volume.
desc.zh-CN: 用于控制体积内力的强度和方向的 3D 噪声的 X 轴偏移。

desc.en-US: Offset along the Y-axis for the 3D noise used to control the strength and direction of the force in the volume.
desc.zh-CN: 用于控制体积内力的强度和方向的 3D 噪声的 Y 轴偏移。

desc.en-US: Offset along the Z-axis for the 3D noise used to control the strength and direction of the force in the volume.
desc.zh-CN: 用于控制体积内力的强度和方向的 3D 噪声的 Z 轴偏移。

desc.en-US: The strength of the force applied in the volume.
desc.zh-CN: 施加在体积内的力的强度。

desc.en-US:
The shape of the volume.

Each shape has different fields controlling the size of the volume, and they also change where it scales from and what point things are being pulled towards:
| Shape | Fields | Origin |
|-|-|-|
| [Boundless](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Boundless) | *n/a* | *n/a* |
| [Sphere](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Sphere) | [sphereRadius](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TurbulenceForce.sphereRadius) | Center of the sphere |
| [Box](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Box) | [boxSize](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TurbulenceForce.boxSize) | Center of the box |
| [Cylinder](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Cylinder) | [cylinderHeight](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TurbulenceForce.cylinderHeight), [cylinderRadius](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TurbulenceForce.cylinderRadius) | Slightly +Z of the center of the cylinder? |
| [SquarePrism](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.SquarePrism) | [squarePrismHeight](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TurbulenceForce.squarePrismHeight), [squarePrismApothem](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TurbulenceForce.squarePrismApothem) | Center of the base of the prism |
desc.zh-CN:
体积的形状。

每种形状都有不同的字段控制体积的大小，它们还会改变缩放的基准点以及物体被拉向的点：
| 形状 | 字段 | 原点 |
|-|-|-|
| {@link ForceVolumeShape.Boundless Boundless 无限) | *不适用* | *不适用* |
| [Sphere 球体](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Sphere) | [sphereRadius](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TurbulenceForce.sphereRadius) | 球体中心 |
| [Box 长方体](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Box) | [boxSize](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TurbulenceForce.boxSize) | 长方体中心 |
| [Cylinder 圆柱体](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Cylinder) | [cylinderHeight](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TurbulenceForce.cylinderHeight), [cylinderRadius](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TurbulenceForce.cylinderRadius) | 圆柱体中心略微 +Z 处？ |
| [SquarePrism 四棱柱](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.SquarePrism) | [squarePrismHeight](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TurbulenceForce.squarePrismHeight), [squarePrismApothem](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TurbulenceForce.squarePrismApothem) | 棱柱底面中心 |

desc.en-US: The radius of the [sphere](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Sphere) where the force is active.
The size of the [box](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Box) where the force is active.
The height of the [cylinder](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Cylinder) where the force is active.
The radius of the [cylinder](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.Cylinder) where the force is active.
The height of the [square prism](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.SquarePrism) where the force is active.
The apothem of the [square prism](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#ForceVolumeShape.SquarePrism) where the force is active.

The minimum random multiplier for [force](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TurbulenceForce.force). This multiplier will randomly change to different values in the range defined by this and [forceRandomMultiplierMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TurbulenceForce.forceRandomMultiplierMax).
desc.zh-CN: [force](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TurbulenceForce.force) 的最小随机乘数。此乘数将在由此值和 [forceRandomMultiplierMax](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TurbulenceForce.forceRandomMultiplierMax) 定义的范围内随机变化。

desc.en-US: The maximum random multiplier for [force](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TurbulenceForce.force). This multiplier will randomly change to different values in the range defined by this and [forceRandomMultiplierMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TurbulenceForce.forceRandomMultiplierMin).
desc.zh-CN: [force](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TurbulenceForce.force) 的最大随机乘数。此乘数将在由此值和 [forceRandomMultiplierMin](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TurbulenceForce.forceRandomMultiplierMin) 定义的范围内随机变化。

desc.en-US: The scale of the 3D noise used to control the strength and direction of the force in the volume. Lower values makes it more noisy, with small vortices forming everywhere. Higher values makes the noise smoother.
desc.zh-CN: 用于控制体积内力的强度和方向的 3D 噪声的比例。较低的值会使它更嘈杂，到处形成小漩涡。较高的值使噪声更平滑。

desc.en-US: Controls whether or not [softRadius](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TurbulenceForce.softRadius) is effective.

The radius of a sphere where the force gets weaker with the distance from the origin. Very similar to the [sphere radius](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TurbulenceForce.sphereRadius) when the [shape](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TurbulenceForce.shape) of the volume is a sphere, but this has a smooth transition from inside the radius to the outside.

This requires [enableSoftRadius](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TurbulenceForce.enableSoftRadius) to be enabled.
desc.zh-CN:
力的强度随距离原点的距离而减弱的球体半径。当体积的 [形状](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TurbulenceForce.shape) 为球体时，这与 [球体半径](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TurbulenceForce.sphereRadius) 非常相似，但此半径从内部到外部具有平滑过渡。

这要求启用 [enableSoftRadius](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#TurbulenceForce.enableSoftRadius)。

desc.en-US: The time it takes for the force to fade out after the action has deactivated in seconds. Due to the way this value is stored, the time will be rounded to the nearest 1/30s.
desc.zh-CN: 动作失效后力场淡出所需的时间（秒）。由于此值的存储方式，时间将四舍五入到最接近的 1/30 秒。

desc.en-US: Controls how fast time passes for the entire effect.
desc.zh-CN: 控制整个特效的时间流逝速度。

desc.en-US: When enabled, this limits visibility of nodes outside of the distance defined by [maxViewDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Unk10500.maxViewDistance).
desc.zh-CN: 启用时，限制 [maxViewDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Unk10500.maxViewDistance) 定义的距离之外的节点可见性。

desc.en-US: All nodes that are farther away from the camera than this will not be visible. This restriction requires [limitViewDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Unk10500.limitViewDistance) to be enabled.
desc.zh-CN: 所有距离摄像机超过此距离的节点将不可见。此限制需要启用 [limitViewDistance](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#Unk10500.limitViewDistance)。

desc.en-US:
The game will simulate playing the effect for this amount of time in seconds before actually displaying the effect. This does not mean that it will delay displaying the effect, just that the effect will start as if it had already been playing for this time, kind of like skipping ahead in the animation. This doesn't affect everything in the effect, and a list of things affected has not been made, but it does affect periodic emitters at least.

Setting this to very high values can cause noticeable stutters in the game when the effect is spawned due to it having to simulate playing the effect for so long.

In Dark Souls 3, Sekiro, Elden Ring, and Nightreign, this value will be rounded to the nearest 1/30s due to how it is stored in the file format. It is stored differently in Armored Core 6, and so no rounding will happen for that.
desc.zh-CN:
在实际显示特效之前，游戏将模拟播放特效这么长时间（秒）。这并不意味着会延迟显示特效，而是特效开始时就像已经播放了这么长时间一样，类似于动画中的快进。这不会影响特效中的所有内容（受影响内容的列表尚未制作），但至少会影响周期性发射器。

将此值设置得非常高可能会导致游戏在生成特效时出现明显的卡顿，因为它必须模拟播放特效这么长时间。

在《黑暗之魂 3》、《只狼》、《艾尔登法环》和《夜之统治》中，由于文件格式中的存储方式，此值将四舍五入到最接近的 1/30 秒。《装甲核心 6》中的存储方式不同，因此不会进行四舍五入。

desc.en-US: Defines a light source with an elliptic cone shape, a spot light.
desc.zh-CN: 定义了一个具有椭圆锥形状的光源，即聚光灯。

desc.en-US:
Controls the diffuse color of the light.

Values in this are unrestricted and can go above 1.

If [separateSpecular](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#SpotLight.separateSpecular) is disabled, this also controls the specular color of the light.
desc.zh-CN:
控制灯光的漫反射颜色。

此处的数值不设限，可以超过 1。

如果禁用了 [separateSpecular](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#SpotLight.separateSpecular)，此属性也会控制灯光的镜面反射颜色。

desc.en-US:
Controls the specular color of the light.

Values in this are unrestricted and can go above 1.

If [separateSpecular](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#SpotLight.separateSpecular) is disabled, this property is ignored and [diffuseColor](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#SpotLight.diffuseColor) controls both the diffuse as well as the specular color.
desc.zh-CN:
控制灯光的镜面反射颜色。

此处的数值不设限，可以超过 1。

如果禁用了 [separateSpecular](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#SpotLight.separateSpecular)，此属性将被忽略，由 [diffuseColor](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#SpotLight.diffuseColor) 同时控制漫反射和镜面反射颜色。

desc.en-US:
A scalar multiplier for the [diffuse color](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#SpotLight.diffuseColor). Good for easily adjusting the brightness of the light without changing the color.

If [separateSpecular](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#SpotLight.separateSpecular) is disabled, this also affects the specular color of the light.
desc.zh-CN:
[漫反射颜色](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#SpotLight.diffuseColor)的标量乘数。便于在不改变颜色的情况下调整灯光亮度。

如果禁用了 [separateSpecular](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#SpotLight.separateSpecular)，这也会影响灯光的镜面反射颜色。

desc.en-US:
A scalar multiplier for the [specular color](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#SpotLight.specularColor).

If [separateSpecular](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#SpotLight.separateSpecular) is disabled, this property is ignored.
desc.zh-CN:
[镜面反射颜色](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#SpotLight.specularColor)的标量乘数。

如果禁用了 [separateSpecular](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#SpotLight.separateSpecular)，此属性将被忽略。

desc.en-US: Controls where the light starts in the cone. It bascially "slices off" the tip of the cone. If set to 0, it acts as if it is set to 0.5.
desc.zh-CN: 控制光线在锥体中的起始位置。基本上就是“切掉”锥体的尖端。如果设置为 0，其行为类似于设置为 0.5。

desc.en-US: Controls how far away the base of the cone is from the light source.
desc.zh-CN: 控制锥体底面距离光源的距离。

desc.en-US: The X radius for the elliptic base of the cone.
desc.zh-CN: 锥体椭圆底面的 X 半径。

desc.en-US: The Y radius for the elliptic base of the cone.
desc.zh-CN: 锥体椭圆底面的 Y 半径。
未知 标量 属性。
未知 标量 属性。
未知 标量 属性。

desc.en-US: Toggles the jitter and flicker animations for the light.
desc.zh-CN: 开启或关闭灯光的抖动和闪烁动画。

desc.en-US: Controls the acceleration of the jittering.
Controls how much the light should move around randomly on the X-axis.
desc.zh-CN: 控制灯光在 X 轴上随机移动的幅度。

desc.en-US: Controls how much the light should move around randomly on the Y-axis.
desc.zh-CN: 控制灯光在 Y 轴上随机移动的幅度。

desc.en-US: Controls how much the light should move around randomly on the Z-axis.
desc.zh-CN: 控制灯光在 Z 轴上随机移动的幅度。

desc.en-US: Controls the minimum interval for flickering.
Controls the maximum interval for flickering.
Brightness multiplier for the light when it flickers.
desc.zh-CN: 灯光闪烁时的亮度乘数。

desc.en-US:
Controls if the light should have shadows or not.

Note: Map objects also have a setting for casting shadows, and both must be enabled for an object to cast shadows from the light source.
desc.zh-CN:
控制灯光是否产生阴影。

注意：地图物体也有一个投射阴影的设置，必须同时启用两者，物体才能投射该光源的阴影。

desc.en-US: When enabled, this allows other properties and fields of the action to control the specular color independently of the diffuse color. When disabled, the diffuse counterpart of the properties or fields will affect both the diffuse and specular color.
desc.zh-CN: 启用时，允许 Action 的其他属性和字段独立于漫反射颜色来控制镜面反射颜色。禁用时，对应的漫反射属性或字段将同时影响漫反射和镜面反射颜色。

desc.en-US: Controls how dark shadows from this light source are. At 0, the shadows will be entirely invisible.
desc.zh-CN: 控制此光源产生的阴影的暗度。值为 0 时，阴影将完全不可见。

desc.en-US:
The number of seconds the light takes to fade to nothing after being destroyed.

Due to how the field this represents works, the time will be rounded to the nearest multiple of 1/30s.
desc.zh-CN:
灯光在被销毁后衰减消失所需的秒数。

由于该字段代表的底层机制，时间将四舍五入为 1/30 秒的倍数。

desc.en-US: Controls the density of some sort of fake fog in the volume hit by the light. The fog does not affect the actual light produced by the source and is not affected by shadows.
desc.zh-CN: 控制光照范围内某种“伪雾”的密度。这种雾不影响光源产生的实际光线，也不受阴影影响。

desc.en-US: Controls whether or not [asymmetryParam](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#SpotLight.asymmetryParam) affects the fake fog from [volumeDensity](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#SpotLight.volumeDensity).
desc.zh-CN: 控制 [asymmetryParam](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#SpotLight.asymmetryParam) 是否影响来自 [volumeDensity](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#SpotLight.volumeDensity) 的伪雾。

desc.en-US:
Controls how the fake fog from [volumeDensity](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#SpotLight.volumeDensity) scatters the light. This value is ignored if [phaseFunction](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#SpotLight.phaseFunction) is disabled, and the fog will scatter the light equally in all directions.

- At 0, the light is scattered equally in every direction.
- As the value approaches 1, the light is scattered more and more forward, in the same direction as the light was already traveling. This means that the fake fog will be less visible from the side or behind, and more visible from in front of the light.
- At 1, the fog will not scatter the light at all, so it will be entirely invisible.
- Values above 1 produce unnatural-looking effects where the light darkens the fog instead.
desc.zh-CN:
控制来自 [volumeDensity](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#SpotLight.volumeDensity) 的模拟雾如何散射光线。如果禁用了 [phaseFunction](https://fxr-docs.pages.dev/~#SpotLight.phaseFunction)，此值将被忽略，雾将向所有方向均匀散射光线。

- 值为 0 时，光线向各个方向均匀散射。
- 随着值接近 1，光线会越来越向前散射（沿光线传播方向）。这意味着模拟雾从侧面或后面看不太明显，从正面看更明显。
- 值为 1 时，雾完全不散射光线，因此完全不可见。
- 值大于 1 会产生看起来不自然的效果，光线反而会使雾变暗。

desc.en-US: When not in a dark enough area, the brightness of the light will be multiplied by 0.1^α, where α is this exponent value. The light will have normal brightness when the area it's in is sufficiently dark.
desc.zh-CN: 当不在足够黑暗的区域时，灯光亮度将乘以 0.1^α，其中 α 是此指数值。当所在区域足够黑暗时，灯光将保持正常亮度。
